```diff
+import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';
+import { SELECT_COLUMN_WIDTH, checkFields, resolveColumns, selectColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { applyLayout, fillerIndex, pinPlaces, sameLayout, startLayout } from '../engine/layout';
+import type { WidthSpec } from '../engine/layout';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridColumnLayout, DataGridPin } from '../types';
+import { useColumnStartWarning } from './use-column-start-warning';
+import { sameList, sameMembers, useKept } from './use-kept';
+import { useColumnsWarning } from './use-renewal-warning';
+
+export interface ResolvedColumnsOptions<TRow> {
+  /** The caller's columns, made safe by `normalizeProps`. */
+  columns: readonly DataGridColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** The rows the field names of the columns are checked against. */
+  data: readonly TRow[];
+  locale: string;
+  timeZone: string;
+  /** The words of a boolean, which `resolveColumns` writes into the columns' texts. */
+  yes: string;
+  no: string;
+  /** The grid's `allow…` props: each one is the default of the same field of every column. */
+  allowSorting: boolean;
+  allowResizing: boolean;
+  allowReordering: boolean;
+  allowPinning: boolean;
+  allowHiding: boolean;
+  allowFiltering: boolean;
+  allowHeaderFiltering: boolean;
+  /** `defaultColumnLayout`, which an uncontrolled layout starts from. */
+  defaultColumnLayout: Partial<DataGridColumnLayout> | undefined;
+}
+
+export interface ResolvedColumns<TRow> {
+  /** Every column of the caller's, each with the grid's defaults laid in. */
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** Where an uncontrolled layout starts: the columns of the first render, and `defaultColumnLayout`. */
+  startedWith: DataGridColumnLayout;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The caller's columns as the grid reads them (spec phase 6 §3.1), and the layout the grid starts
+ * from. The columns are made again only when what they are made from changes, and a field that names
+ * nothing in the data warns once after the commit.
+ */
+export function useResolvedColumns<TRow>({
+  columns,
+  data,
+  locale,
+  timeZone,
+  yes,
+  no,
+  allowSorting,
+  allowResizing,
+  allowReordering,
+  allowPinning,
+  allowHiding,
+  allowFiltering,
+  allowHeaderFiltering,
+  defaultColumnLayout,
+}: ResolvedColumnsOptions<TRow>): ResolvedColumns<TRow> {
+  useColumnsWarning(columns);
+  const resolved = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      resolveColumns(columns, {
+        locale,
+        timeZone,
+        yes,
+        no,
+        allowSorting,
+        allowResizing,
+        allowReordering,
+        allowPinning,
+        allowHiding,
+        allowFiltering,
+        allowHeaderFiltering,
+      }),
+    [
+      columns,
+      locale,
+      timeZone,
+      yes,
+      no,
+      allowSorting,
+      allowResizing,
+      allowReordering,
+      allowPinning,
+      allowHiding,
+      allowFiltering,
+      allowHeaderFiltering,
+    ],
+  );
+  useEffect(() => checkFields(resolved, data), [resolved, data]);
+  // Where an uncontrolled layout starts: the columns of the first render, and `defaultColumnLayout`.
+  const [startedWith] = useState(() => startLayout(resolved, defaultColumnLayout));
+  return { resolved, startedWith };
+}
+
+export interface ShownColumnsOptions<TRow> {
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** The layout the state holds, as the caller gave it. */
+  layout: DataGridColumnLayout;
+  selectionMode: 'none' | 'single' | 'multiple';
+}
+
+export interface ShownColumns<TRow> {
+  /** The layout applied to the columns: the shown ones, their widths and zones, and the layout as shown. */
+  applied: ReturnType<typeof applyLayout<TRow>>;
+  /** The layout as it is shown (unknown ids dropped, new columns appended, widths held to their limits). */
+  shownLayout: DataGridColumnLayout;
+  /** The shown columns in order, without the column of boxes (the title and the rows read them). */
+  dataColumns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** The same columns in any order: the sort reads them, which an order does not change. */
+  sortColumns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  columnWidths: ReturnType<typeof applyLayout<TRow>>['widths'];
+  dataPins: ReturnType<typeof applyLayout<TRow>>['pins'];
+  boxColumn: ResolvedColumn<TRow>;
+  /** Every column of the keyboard and of the layout: the column of boxes first when there is one. */
+  columnsShown: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** The zone of each shown column, the column of boxes first. */
+  pinsShown: readonly (DataGridPin | undefined)[];
+  pins: ReturnType<typeof pinPlaces>;
+  fillerAt: number;
+  pinned: boolean;
+  widthSpecs: (WidthSpec & { id: string })[];
+  rowHeader: ResolvedColumn<TRow> | undefined;
+  /** The last data column shown cannot be hidden. */
+  hideable: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The columns the grid shows: the layout applied to the resolved columns, each part of it kept apart so
+ * a change of one draws only what reads it, and the column of boxes put in front of them. The layout
+ * the columns are laid out by is the one of an earlier render while the new one says the same, so a
+ * layout written in the JSX draws no row.
+ */
+export function useShownColumns<TRow>({
+  resolved,
+  layout: layoutHeld,
+  selectionMode,
+}: ShownColumnsOptions<TRow>): ShownColumns<TRow> {
+  const layout = useKept(layoutHeld, sameLayout);
+  const applied = useMemo(() => applyLayout(resolved, layout), [resolved, layout]);
+  // What reads each part of it is kept apart, so a change of one part draws only what reads it: the
+  // shown columns in order (the title and the rows), the same columns in any order (the sort, which
+  // an order does not change) and the widths (the table alone).
+  const dataColumns = useKept(applied.columns, sameList);
+  const sortColumns = useKept(applied.columns, sameMembers);
+  const columnWidths = useKept(applied.widths, sameList);
+  const dataPins = useKept(applied.pins, sameList);
+  // The layout as it is shown (unknown ids dropped, new columns appended, widths held to their limits):
+  // the one every change the user makes is built from, and the one the callbacks and `getState()` send.
+  // `layout` above is the caller's value as it came, kept by value; it is only for `applyLayout`.
+  const shownLayout = useKept(applied.layout, sameLayout);
+  useColumnStartWarning(resolved, shownLayout);
+
+  // Choosing rows. The column of boxes is a column of the grid like the others to the layout and the
+  // keyboard; the sort, the pipeline and the captions know only the caller's.
+  const boxColumn = useMemo(() => selectColumn<TRow>(), []);
+  const columnsShown = useMemo(
+    () => (selectionMode === 'multiple' ? [boxColumn, ...dataColumns] : dataColumns),
+    [selectionMode, boxColumn, dataColumns],
+  );
+  // The zone of each shown column, the column of boxes first. It is in the left zone when a data
+  // column is, so the boxes stay beside the first column that sticks (spec phase 6 §3.7).
+  const pinsShown = useMemo<(DataGridPin | undefined)[]>(
+    () =>
+      selectionMode === 'multiple'
+        ? [dataPins.includes('left') ? 'left' : undefined, ...dataPins]
+        : [...dataPins],
+    [selectionMode, dataPins],
+  );
+  const pins = useMemo(() => pinPlaces(pinsShown), [pinsShown]);
+  const fillerAt = fillerIndex(pinsShown);
+  const pinned = dataPins.some((pin) => pin !== undefined);
+  // The widths are the layout's, so they are given to the table alone and not to the parts that draw
+  // the cells: the columns of the context are the same objects when only a width changes.
+  const widthSpecs = useMemo<(WidthSpec & { id: string })[]>(
+    () => [
+      ...(selectionMode === 'multiple'
+        ? [{ id: boxColumn.id, width: SELECT_COLUMN_WIDTH, minWidth: SELECT_COLUMN_WIDTH }]
+        : []),
+      ...dataColumns.map((column, index) => ({
+        id: column.id,
+        width: columnWidths[index],
+        minWidth: column.minWidth,
+      })),
+    ],
+    [selectionMode, boxColumn, dataColumns, columnWidths],
+  );
+  const rowHeader = useMemo(() => dataColumns.find((column) => column.rowHeader), [dataColumns]);
+  // The last data column shown cannot be hidden, so its menu has no "Hide column" and, if that was all
+  // it had, no button.
+  const hideable = dataColumns.length > 1;
+  return {
+    applied,
+    shownLayout,
+    dataColumns,
+    sortColumns,
+    columnWidths,
+    dataPins,
+    boxColumn,
+    columnsShown,
+    pinsShown,
+    pins,
+    fillerAt,
+    pinned,
+    widthSpecs,
+    rowHeader,
+    hideable,
+  };
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-grid-filter.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-grid-filter.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1427f8b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-grid-filter.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,217 @@
+import { useCallback, useId, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { RefObject } from 'react';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { foldedSearch, hasConditions, isFiltering, sameRows } from '../engine/filter';
+import type { TextCache } from '../engine/values';
+import type { FilterView } from '../filter-context';
+import { popupHome as popupHomeOf } from '../grid-dom';
+import type { PopupOpener } from '../grid-dom';
+import type { DataGridFilter, DataGridPage } from '../types';
+import { useFilterPopover } from './use-filter-popover';
+import { useHeaderValues } from './use-header-values';
+import { sameList, useKept } from './use-kept';
+import { useOperatorMenu } from './use-operator-menu';
+import { useRowsFound } from './use-rows-found';
+import type { ShownColumns } from './use-grid-columns';
+
+const NO_COLUMNS: readonly never[] = [];
+
+export interface GridFilterOptions<TRow> {
+  filter: DataGridFilter;
+  /** Asks for a filter: the callbacks, and whether it differs from what is held. */
+  setFilter: (filter: DataGridFilter) => boolean;
+  setPage: (page: DataGridPage) => void;
+  /** The page the state holds, and its size as the grid reads it. */
+  pageIndex: number;
+  size: number;
+  paged: boolean;
+  data: readonly TRow[];
+  /** How many rows the filter keeps: every page of them, or `totalCount` in server mode. */
+  total: number;
+  loading: boolean;
+  remote: boolean;
+  /** The rows after the search, which the header filter lists from. */
+  searched: readonly TRow[];
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** The layout applied: the filter panel says its conditions in its order. */
+  applied: ShownColumns<TRow>['applied'];
+  textCache: TextCache<TRow>;
+  locale: string;
+  filterPanel: boolean;
+  headerFilter: boolean;
+  tableRef: RefObject<HTMLTableElement | null>;
+  /** The sentence of a count of rows found. */
+  say: (count: number) => string;
+  announce: (text: string) => void;
+}
+
+export interface GridFilter<TRow> {
+  /** Whether the filter keeps back any row of this grid's columns. */
+  filtering: boolean;
+  applyFilter: (next: DataGridFilter) => void;
+  clearFilter: () => void;
+  /** What the parts that filter read, through `FilterContext`. */
+  filterView: FilterView;
+  /** The columns the filter panel names, in its order, kept by their members. */
+  panelColumns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** The rows the panel reads to write a header value as the cells do. */
+  panelSource: { rows: readonly TRow[]; read: TextCache<TRow> };
+  panelShown: boolean;
+  /** What the cells mark: the search as the engine reads it. */
+  marked: string;
+  /**
+   * What the popups of the filter need to find where their focus goes, as of the last commit: the shown
+   * columns and the grid's active place. The grid writes it once its keyboard exists.
+   */
+  homeSources: {
+    current: { columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[]; active: () => HTMLElement | null };
+  };
+}
+
+/**
+ * The filter. Every change the user makes goes through `applyFilter`, so the callbacks, the page and
+ * what is said cannot differ between a search, a condition and a clear: `onFilterChange` and
+ * `onStateChange`, then the first page (a second change, with its own pair of callbacks, when the
+ * page was not the first), then the count of rows found. A filter that says what is held already
+ * does nothing at all. Server mode filters nothing here: the callbacks are how the app learns.
+ */
+export function useGridFilter<TRow>({
+  filter,
+  setFilter,
+  setPage,
+  pageIndex,
+  size,
+  paged,
+  data,
+  total,
+  loading,
+  remote,
+  searched,
+  resolved,
+  applied,
+  textCache,
+  locale,
+  filterPanel,
+  headerFilter,
+  tableRef,
+  say,
+  announce,
+}: GridFilterOptions<TRow>): GridFilter<TRow> {
+  const filtering = isFiltering(filter, resolved);
+  const askRowsFound = useRowsFound({ filter, total, remote, loading, data, say, announce });
+  const pageNow = useRef({ index: pageIndex, size, paged, data, filter });
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    pageNow.current = { index: pageIndex, size, paged, data, filter };
+  });
+  // A change that keeps the same rows (the spaces around a search) is stored and reported as typed, but it
+  // is no new filter for the user: it stays on its page and says nothing. The filter it is compared with
+  // is the one last asked, so two requests of one event see each other.
+  const applyFilter = useCallback(
+    (next: DataGridFilter) => {
+      if (!setFilter(next)) return;
+      const {
+        index,
+        size: pageSize,
+        paged: hasPages,
+        data: rowsNow,
+        filter: before,
+      } = pageNow.current;
+      pageNow.current = { ...pageNow.current, filter: next };
+      if (sameRows(before, next)) return;
+      askRowsFound(next, rowsNow);
+      if (hasPages && index !== 0) setPage({ index: 0, size: pageSize });
+    },
+    [setFilter, setPage, askRowsFound],
+  );
+  // A clear is told to the boxes that hold text they have not sent (the search field, the text cells): it
+  // would otherwise be sent after it, though the clear says there is no search and no condition.
+  const clearListeners = useRef(new Set<() => void>());
+  const onClear = useCallback((listener: () => void) => {
+    clearListeners.current.add(listener);
+    return () => {
+      clearListeners.current.delete(listener);
+    };
+  }, []);
+  const clearFilter = useCallback(() => {
+    for (const listener of clearListeners.current) listener();
+    applyFilter({});
+  }, [applyFilter]);
+  // The filter panel says the conditions in the order of the columns: the shown ones by their zones, then the
+  // hidden ones, which still filter. The list is kept by its members, so a width or a sort draws no panel.
+  const panelOrder = useMemo(() => {
+    if (!filterPanel) return NO_COLUMNS;
+    const byId = new Map(resolved.map((column) => [column.id, column]));
+    return [...applied.columns, ...applied.layout.hidden.flatMap((id) => byId.get(id) ?? [])];
+  }, [filterPanel, resolved, applied]);
+  const panelColumns = useKept(panelOrder, sameList);
+  // The rows the panel reads to write a header value as the cells do: the data and its text cache, so a
+  // search, which changes neither, does not draw the panel (in server mode the data is the page).
+  const panelSource = useMemo(() => ({ rows: data, read: textCache }), [data, textCache]);
+  const panelShown = filterPanel && hasConditions(filter, resolved);
+  // What the cells mark: the search as the engine reads it, in server mode too, where the page the
+  // server sent is marked and not filtered.
+  const marked = foldedSearch(filter.search);
+  const operatorMenuId = useId();
+  const operatorMenu = useOperatorMenu(operatorMenuId);
+  const filterPopoverId = useId();
+  const filterPopover = useFilterPopover(filterPopoverId);
+  const listValues = useHeaderValues({
+    enabled: headerFilter,
+    rows: searched,
+    filter,
+    resolved,
+    remote,
+    read: textCache,
+    locale,
+  });
+  // What the popups of the filter need to find where their focus goes, as of the last commit: the shown
+  // columns and the grid's active place (the keyboard is made after this hook).
+  const homeSources = useRef<GridFilter<TRow>['homeSources']['current']>({
+    columns: [],
+    active: () => null,
+  });
+  const popupHome = useCallback(
+    (opener: PopupOpener, columnId: string, from: HTMLElement) => {
+      const { columns: shown, active } = homeSources.current;
+      const place = shown.findIndex((column) => column.id === columnId);
+      return popupHomeOf(tableRef.current, place, opener, from, active);
+    },
+    [tableRef],
+  );
+  const filterView = useMemo<FilterView>(
+    () => ({
+      filter,
+      filtering,
+      apply: applyFilter,
+      clear: clearFilter,
+      onClear,
+      operatorMenu,
+      popover: filterPopover,
+      listValues,
+      popupHome,
+    }),
+    [
+      filter,
+      filtering,
+      applyFilter,
+      clearFilter,
+      onClear,
+      operatorMenu,
+      filterPopover,
+      listValues,
+      popupHome,
+    ],
+  );
+  return {
+    filtering,
+    applyFilter,
+    clearFilter,
+    filterView,
+    panelColumns,
+    panelSource,
+    panelShown,
+    marked,
+    homeSources,
+  };
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-grid-sort.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-grid-sort.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6a17a1d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-grid-sort.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,82 @@
+import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { effectiveSort, nextSort } from '../engine/sort';
+import type { DataGridLabels, DataGridSortItem } from '../types';
+import { captionOf } from './use-column-actions';
+
+export interface GridSortOptions<TRow> {
+  /** The sort the state holds, as given. */
+  sort: readonly DataGridSortItem[];
+  /** The columns shown, in any order: a hidden column is no column of the grid, so it sorts nothing. */
+  sortColumns: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  sortMode: 'single' | 'multiple';
+  setSort: (sort: readonly DataGridSortItem[]) => void;
+  /** The caller's columns, shown or not: a caption is looked up here. */
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  announce: (text: string) => void;
+}
+
+export interface GridSort {
+  /** The sort as it is shown: the items that sort something, in order. A press builds on them. */
+  sortItems: readonly DataGridSortItem[];
+  /** The level and direction of each sorted field, and how many there are, for the titles. */
+  sorting: {
+    levels: ReadonlyMap<string, { direction: DataGridSortItem['direction']; level: number }>;
+    count: number;
+  };
+  /** A sort the user asks for: the state, its callbacks and what is said. */
+  applySort: (next: readonly DataGridSortItem[]) => void;
+  /** A press on a title: the next sort, built on the one shown. */
+  onSortPress: (columnId: string, additive: boolean) => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The sort as the user sees and changes it: what sorts, what the titles show, and the one way a press
+ * on a title or an item of a column's menu asks for a change.
+ */
+export function useGridSort<TRow>({
+  sort,
+  sortColumns,
+  sortMode,
+  setSort,
+  resolved,
+  labels,
+  announce,
+}: GridSortOptions<TRow>): GridSort {
+  const sortItems = useMemo(() => effectiveSort(sort, sortColumns), [sort, sortColumns]);
+  const sorting = useMemo(
+    () => ({
+      levels: new Map(
+        sortItems.map((item, index) => [
+          item.field,
+          { direction: item.direction, level: index + 1 },
+        ]),
+      ),
+      count: sortItems.length,
+    }),
+    [sortItems],
+  );
+  const applySort = useCallback(
+    (next: readonly DataGridSortItem[]) => {
+      setSort(next);
+      announce(
+        next.length === 0
+          ? labels.announceSortCleared
+          : labels.announceSort(
+              next.map((item) => ({
+                caption: captionOf(resolved, item.field),
+                direction: item.direction,
+              })),
+            ),
+      );
+    },
+    [setSort, announce, labels, resolved],
+  );
+  const onSortPress = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string, additive: boolean) =>
+      applySort(nextSort(sortItems, columnId, additive, sortMode)),
+    [sortItems, sortMode, applySort],
+  );
+  return { sortItems, sorting, applySort, onSortPress };
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-header-values.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-header-values.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..05b635c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-header-values.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+import { useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { conditionOf, distinctValues, filterRows, listIsNarrowed } from '../engine/filter';
+import type { TextCache } from '../engine/values';
+import type { HeaderList } from '../filter-context';
+import type { DataGridFilter } from '../types';
+
+export interface HeaderValuesOptions<TRow> {
+  /** Whether the grid has funnels: only then is a listing kept. */
+  enabled: boolean;
+  /** The rows after the search, as of this commit (server mode: the page). */
+  rows: readonly TRow[];
+  filter: DataGridFilter;
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  remote: boolean;
+  read: TextCache<TRow>;
+  locale: string;
+}
+
+interface Listing<TRow> {
+  rows: readonly TRow[];
+  filter: DataGridFilter;
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  remote: boolean;
+}
+
+const NOTHING: HeaderList = { items: [], narrowed: false };
+
+/**
+ * What the header filter lists, read when its popover opens: the rows after the search and the
+ * conditions of the other columns (server mode lists the column's own values, or the page), as of the
+ * last commit. The listing is written on commit only while `enabled`: a grid without funnels keeps none.
+ */
+export function useHeaderValues<TRow>({
+  enabled,
+  rows,
+  filter,
+  resolved,
+  remote,
+  read,
+  locale,
+}: HeaderValuesOptions<TRow>): (columnId: string) => HeaderList {
+  const listing = useRef<Listing<TRow> | null>(enabled ? { rows, filter, resolved, remote } : null);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    if (enabled) listing.current = { rows, filter, resolved, remote };
+  });
+  return useCallback(
+    (columnId: string) => {
+      if (!listing.current) return NOTHING;
+      const { rows: searchedRows, filter: held, resolved: every, remote: server } = listing.current;
+      const column = every.find((candidate) => candidate.id === columnId);
+      if (!column) return NOTHING;
+      const others = server ? searchedRows : filterRows(searchedRows, every, held, read, columnId);
+      const { values } = conditionOf(held, columnId) ?? {};
+      const { items } = distinctValues(
+        others,
+        column,
+        { named: Array.isArray(values) ? values : [], limit: Infinity, locale },
+        read,
+      );
+      return { items, narrowed: listIsNarrowed(held, every, columnId, server) };
+    },
+    [read, locale],
+  );
+}
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-shown-state.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-shown-state.ts

@@ -0,0 +1,41 @@
+import { useMemo } from 'react';
+import type { MutableRefObject } from 'react';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import type { DataGridColumnLayout, DataGridState } from '../types';
+
+export interface ShownStateOptions {
+  /** The state as the app holds it, or as the grid does while it is uncontrolled. */
+  state: DataGridState;
+  /** The layout as it is shown. */
+  shownLayout: DataGridColumnLayout;
+  paged: boolean;
+  /** The page as drawn: the index clamped to the pages there are. */
+  pageIndex: number;
+  size: number;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The state the grid shows: what `getState()` returns and what the callbacks send, with the page as
+ * drawn and the layout as shown. It is written into `shownRef` when the commit starts, never in a
+ * render. The ref is made by the caller, early, because `useGridState` reads it too.
+ */
+export function useShownState(
+  shownRef: MutableRefObject<DataGridState>,
+  { state, shownLayout, paged, pageIndex, size }: ShownStateOptions,
+): DataGridState {
+  const shown = useMemo<DataGridState>(
+    () => ({
+      sort: state.sort,
+      filter: state.filter,
+      // With paging off the page is not the grid's to say: it stays as it is held, unused.
+      page: paged ? { index: pageIndex, size } : state.page,
+      selectedKeys: state.selectedKeys,
+      columnLayout: shownLayout,
+    }),
+    [state.sort, state.filter, state.page, state.selectedKeys, shownLayout, pageIndex, paged, size],
+  );
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    shownRef.current = shown;
+  });
+  return shown;
+}
```

  - `engine/summary.ts`: `ResolvedSummaryItem<TRow>`, `SummaryEntry<TRow> { value; row }`, `SummaryValues<TRow>` (`ReadonlyMap<id, SummaryEntry>`), `resolveSummaryItems(items, columns)` → `{ items, leftOut }`, `computeSummary(rows, items)`, `summaryText(item, entry, { locale, read })`.
  - `engine/flatten.ts`: `FlatDataRow<TRow>`, `FlatGroupRow<TRow>`, `FlatDetailRow<TRow>`, `FlatRow<TRow>` (union, không `index`), `flattenRows(rows, getKey, previous, places?)`, `FlattenInput<TRow>`, `flattenTree(input, previous)`, `isGroupOpen(expanded, key)`.
  - `engine/page.ts`: `countRows(flat)`; `pageRows`, `pageCount`, `clampPageIndex` theo dòng được đếm.
  - `engine/pipeline.ts`: `PipelineInput` thêm `grouping`, `groupColumns`, `summary` (`{ total, group }` đã giải hay `null`), `expanded`, `expandedRows`, `hasDetail`; `PipelineResult` thêm `tree`, `keyed`, `totals`; `memo` đưa giá trị lần trước cho hàm tính.
  - `engine/columns.ts`: `ResolvedColumn.allowGrouping`, `.showWhenGrouped`; `ResolveOptions.allowGrouping`.
- Consumes: `createTextCache` (`key`, `text`), `compareKeys`, `collator`, `isBlank`, `numberFormat`, `sortRows`, `createPipeline` và `memo` của nó (Plan B–D).
- Task sau dùng: Task 3 nối `grouping`, `expandedGroups`, đọc `tree`, `keyed`, `isGroupOpen`, `countRows`; Task 4 đọc `FlatDataRow.groups`; Task 6 nối `summary` và đọc `totals`, `summaryText`; Task 7 nối `expandedRows`, `hasDetail`.

```diff
+interface Order {
+  id: string;

+  [
+    { field: 'id' },
+    {

+    allowGrouping: true,
+  },
+);
+
+const ROWS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'a', status: 2, assignee: 'Bình' },
+  { id: 'b', status: 1, assignee: 'An' },
+  { id: 'c', status: 2, assignee: 'An' },
+  { id: 'd', status: 1, assignee: 'Bình' },
+  { id: 'e', status: 2, assignee: 'Bình' },
+];
+
+const read = createTextCache<Order>();
+const STATUS_THEN_ASSIGNEE: DataGridGroupItem[] = [
+  { field: 'status', direction: 'asc' },
+  { field: 'assignee', direction: 'asc' },
+];
+const OPEN: DataGridExpandedGroups = { allExpanded: true, except: [] };
+
+function treeOf(grouping: DataGridGroupItem[], rows: readonly Order[] = ROWS) {
+  return groupRows(rows, grouping, COLUMNS, read, 'en-US');
+}
+function keyedOf(tree: readonly GroupNode<Order>[]) {
+  return flattenRows(
+    groupedRows(tree),
+    (row) => row.id,
+    undefined,
+    rowPlaces(tree),
+  ) as FlatDataRow<Order>[];
+}
+const hasDetail = (row: Order) => row.id !== 'b';
+
+// The visible list as short words: `g1` is a group row of level 1, `d3` a data row of level 3, `x` a
+// detail row.
+function outline(flat: readonly FlatRow<Order>[]): string[] {
+  return flat.map((row) =>
+    row.kind === 'group'
+      ? `g${row.level}:${row.node.text}${row.expanded ? '' : '(closed)'}`
+      : row.kind === 'detail'
+        ? `x:${String(row.key)}`
+        : `d${row.level}:${String(row.key)}`,
+  );
+}
+
+function flatten(
+  tree: readonly GroupNode<Order>[] | null,
+  options: {
+    expanded?: DataGridExpandedGroups;
+    expandedRows?: ReadonlySet<DataGridKey>;
+    detail?: boolean;
+    previous?: readonly FlatRow<Order>[];
+    keyed?: readonly FlatDataRow<Order>[];
+  } = {},
+) {
+  const keyed = options.keyed ?? (tree ? keyedOf(tree) : keyedOf([]));
+  return flattenTree(
+    {
+      tree,
+      keyed,
+      expanded: options.expanded ?? OPEN,
+      expandedRows: options.expandedRows ?? new Set(),
+      hasDetail: options.detail ? hasDetail : undefined,
+    },
+    options.previous,
+  );
+}
+

+  });
+
+  it('puts a detail row right after each data row whose key is expanded and that has a detail', () => {
+    const flat = flatten(null, {
+      keyed: plain,
+      detail: true,
+      // `b` has no detail, and `zzz` is the key of no row.
+      expandedRows: new Set(['a', 'b', 'd', 'zzz']),
+    });
+    expect(outline(flat)).toEqual(['d1:a', 'x:a', 'd1:b', 'd1:c', 'd1:d', 'x:d', 'd1:e']);
+    expect(flat[1]).toEqual({ kind: 'detail', key: 'a', row: ROWS[0], level: 1 });
+    expect(flat[0]).toBe(plain[0]);
+  });
+
+  it('adds no detail row when the grid has no hasDetail', () => {
+    expect(flatten(null, { keyed: plain, expandedRows: new Set(['a']) })).toBe(plain);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('flattenTree with a tree', () => {

+

+
+  it('gives each data row the keyed object itself, and each group row its node, level and key', () => {

+
+  it('counts a group among the groups of its level, and a data row among the rows of its group', () => {

+    expect(groups.map((row) => [row.level, row.posinset, row.setsize])).toEqual([

+    expect(data.map((row) => [row.key, row.posinset, row.setsize])).toEqual([
+      ['c', 1, 1],

+      ['d', 1, 1],

+
+  it('shows a closed group as its row alone', () => {

+  it('opens only the groups of the exceptions when not all are expanded', () => {

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridGroupItem } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns, selectColumn } from './columns';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from './columns';
+import { effectiveGrouping, groupKey, groupRows, groupedRows, rowPlaces } from './group';
+import type { GroupNode } from './group';
+import { resolveSummaryItems } from './summary';
+import { createTextCache } from './values';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  status: number | null;
+  assignee: string | null;
+  qty: number | null;
+  placed: string | null;
+  at: number | null;
+  paid: boolean | null;
+}
+
+const STATUSES = [
+  { code: 1, name: 'New' },
+  { code: 2, name: 'Delivered' },
+  { code: 3, name: 'Cancelled' },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id' },
+  {
+    field: 'status',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+  },
+  { field: 'assignee' },
+  { field: 'qty', dataType: 'number' },
+  { field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' },
+  { field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' },
+  { field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' },
+];
+
+const OPTIONS = {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+  allowResizing: true,
+  allowReordering: true,
+  allowPinning: true,
+  allowHiding: true,
+  allowFiltering: true,
+  allowHeaderFiltering: true,
+  allowGrouping: true,
+};
+
+const resolved = resolveColumns<Order>(COLUMNS, OPTIONS);
+const read = createTextCache<Order>();
+
+const row = (id: string, patch: Partial<Order> = {}): Order => ({
+  id,
+  status: 1,
+  assignee: 'An',
+  qty: 1,
+  placed: null,
+  at: null,
+  paid: null,
+  ...patch,
+});
+
+const asc = (field: string): DataGridGroupItem => ({ field, direction: 'asc' });
+const desc = (field: string): DataGridGroupItem => ({ field, direction: 'desc' });
+
+const ROWS: Order[] = [
+  row('1', { status: 2, assignee: 'Bình', qty: 4 }),
+  row('2', { status: 1, assignee: 'An', qty: 2 }),
+  row('3', { status: 2, assignee: 'An', qty: 10 }),
+  row('4', { status: 3, assignee: null, qty: 7 }),
+  row('5', { status: 1, assignee: 'Bình', qty: 3 }),
+  row('6', { status: 2, assignee: 'Bình', qty: 5 }),
+];
+
+function group(
+  grouping: DataGridGroupItem[],
+  rows: readonly Order[] = ROWS,
+  columns: readonly ResolvedColumn<Order>[] = resolved,
+) {
+  return groupRows(rows, grouping, columns, read, 'en-US');
+}
+const ids = (rows: readonly Order[]) => rows.map((r) => r.id);
+const texts = (nodes: readonly GroupNode<Order>[]) => nodes.map((node) => node.text);
+
+describe('effectiveGrouping', () => {
+  it('keeps the items that group, in order, and drops the rest without a word', () => {
+    const columns = [
+      ...resolveColumns<Order>(
+        [
+          { field: 'id', allowGrouping: false },
+          { field: 'status', dataType: 'number' },
+          { field: 'assignee' },
+        ],
+        OPTIONS,
+      ),
+      selectColumn<Order>(),
+    ];
+    const items = [
+      asc('assignee'),
+      asc('nothing'),
+      asc('id'),
+      asc('flg:select'),
+      { field: 'status', direction: 'up' } as unknown as DataGridGroupItem,
+      desc('assignee'),
+      desc('status'),
+    ];
+    expect(effectiveGrouping(items, columns)).toEqual([asc('assignee'), desc('status')]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives nothing for no items, and does not change the items it is given', () => {
+    const items = [asc('assignee'), asc('assignee')];
+    expect(effectiveGrouping([], resolved)).toEqual([]);
+    effectiveGrouping(items, resolved);
+    expect(items).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('groupKey', () => {
+  it('is the JSON of the [field, value] steps from the outermost level down', () => {
+    expect(groupKey([{ field: 'status', value: 2 }])).toBe('[["status",2]]');
+    expect(
+      groupKey([
+        { field: 'status', value: 2 },
+        { field: 'assignee', value: 'Bình' },
+      ]),
+    ).toBe('[["status",2],["assignee","Bình"]]');
+    expect(groupKey([{ field: 'assignee', value: null }])).toBe('[["assignee",null]]');
+  });
+
+  it('differs when a level is added and when the levels are in another order', () => {
+    const status = { field: 'status', value: 2 };
+    const assignee = { field: 'assignee', value: 'An' };
+    expect(groupKey([status])).not.toBe(groupKey([status, assignee]));
+    expect(groupKey([status, assignee])).not.toBe(groupKey([assignee, status]));
+  });
+
+  it('writes a value JSON cannot write, and never throws', () => {
+    expect(groupKey([{ field: 'big', value: 10n }])).toBe('[["big","10"]]');
+    const loop: Record<string, unknown> = {};
+    loop.self = loop;
+    expect(() => groupKey([{ field: 'x', value: loop }])).not.toThrow();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('groupRows', () => {
+  it('groups by one level: each value once, in order, the rows of a group in the order they came', () => {
+    const tree = group([asc('assignee')]);
+    expect(texts(tree)).toEqual(['An', 'Bình', '']);
+    expect(tree.map((node) => ids(node.rows))).toEqual([['2', '3'], ['1', '5', '6'], ['4']]);
+    expect(tree.map((node) => node.key)).toEqual([
+      '[["assignee","An"]]',
+      '[["assignee","Bình"]]',
+      '[["assignee",null]]',
+    ]);
+    expect(tree[0]).toMatchObject({
+      field: 'assignee',
+      level: 1,
+      value: 'An',
+      children: null,
+      totals: null,
+      path: [{ field: 'assignee', value: 'An' }],
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('puts the blank group last in both directions', () => {
+    expect(texts(group([desc('assignee')]))).toEqual(['Bình', 'An', '']);
+    expect(group([desc('assignee')]).at(-1)!.value).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('groups by two levels: the groups of a level are inside the group of the level above', () => {
+    const tree = group([asc('status'), asc('assignee')]);
+    // A lookup is ordered by its text: Cancelled, Delivered, New.
+    expect(texts(tree)).toEqual(['Cancelled', 'Delivered', 'New']);
+    expect(tree.map((node) => node.value)).toEqual([3, 2, 1]);
+    const delivered = tree[1]!;
+    expect(ids(delivered.rows)).toEqual(['1', '3', '6']);
+    expect(texts(delivered.children!)).toEqual(['An', 'Bình']);
+    expect(delivered.children!.map((node) => node.level)).toEqual([2, 2]);
+    expect(delivered.children!.map((node) => ids(node.rows))).toEqual([['3'], ['1', '6']]);
+    expect(delivered.children![1]!.key).toBe('[["status",2],["assignee","Bình"]]');
+    expect(delivered.children![1]!.children).toBeNull();
+    expect(delivered.children![1]!.path).toEqual([
+      { field: 'status', value: 2 },
+      { field: 'assignee', value: 'Bình' },
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('orders each level by its own direction', () => {
+    const tree = group([desc('status'), desc('assignee')]);
+    expect(texts(tree)).toEqual(['New', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled']);
+    expect(texts(tree[1]!.children!)).toEqual(['Bình', 'An']);
+  });
+
+  it('orders numbers as numbers, and a column by its sortValue when it has one', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { qty: 10 }), row('b', { qty: 2 }), row('c', { qty: 10 })];
+    expect(group([asc('qty')], rows).map((node) => node.value)).toEqual([2, 10]);
+    const byCode = resolveColumns<Order>(
+      [
+        {
+          field: 'status',
+          dataType: 'number',
+          lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+          sortValue: (r) => r.status,
+        },
+      ],
+      OPTIONS,
+    );
+    expect(texts(group([asc('status')], ROWS, byCode))).toEqual(['New', 'Delivered', 'Cancelled']);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the first appearance first when two values are ordered the same', () => {
+    const flat = resolveColumns<Order>([{ field: 'assignee', sortValue: () => 0 }], OPTIONS);
+    expect(texts(group([asc('assignee')], ROWS, flat))).toEqual(['Bình', 'An', '']);
+    expect(texts(group([desc('assignee')], ROWS, flat))).toEqual(['Bình', 'An', '']);
+  });
+
+  it('groups a date by its day, written as the cells write it', () => {
+    const rows = [
+      row('a', { placed: '2026-11-06' }),
+      row('b', { placed: '2026-11-05' }),
+      row('c', { placed: '2026-11-06' }),
+    ];
+    const tree = group([asc('placed')], rows);
+    expect(tree.map((node) => node.value)).toEqual(['2026-11-05', '2026-11-06']);
+    expect(texts(tree)).toEqual(['11/05/2026', '11/06/2026']);
+    expect(tree[0]!.key).toBe('[["placed","2026-11-05"]]');
+  });
+
+  it('groups a datetime by its day in the zone of its cells', () => {
+    // Three instants of the 5th UTC: one day in UTC, two in Hanoi (UTC+7: 10:00 on the 5th, then 00:30
+    // and 06:30 on the 6th) and two in Los Angeles (UTC-8: 19:00 on the 4th, then 09:30 and 15:30).
+    const rows = [
+      row('a', { at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 23, 30) }),
+      row('b', { at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 17, 30) }),
+      row('c', { at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 3, 0) }),
+    ];
+    const inZone = (timeZone: string) =>
+      group(
+        [asc('at')],
+        rows,
+        resolveColumns<Order>([{ field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' }], { ...OPTIONS, timeZone }),
+      );
+    const utc = inZone('UTC');
+    expect(utc.map((node) => node.value)).toEqual(['2026-11-05']);
+    expect(ids(utc[0]!.rows)).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c']);
+    const hanoi = inZone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh');
+    expect(hanoi.map((node) => node.value)).toEqual(['2026-11-05', '2026-11-06']);
+    expect(hanoi.map((node) => ids(node.rows))).toEqual([['c'], ['a', 'b']]);
+    expect(texts(hanoi)).toEqual(['11/05/2026', '11/06/2026']);
+    const losAngeles = inZone('America/Los_Angeles');
+    expect(losAngeles.map((node) => ids(node.rows))).toEqual([['c'], ['a', 'b']]);
+    expect(losAngeles.map((node) => node.value)).toEqual(['2026-11-04', '2026-11-05']);
+  });
+
+  it('orders a datetime by its day, whatever the sortValue of its instant says', () => {
+    const backwards = resolveColumns<Order>(
+      [{ field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime', sortValue: (r) => -(r.at ?? 0) }],
+      OPTIONS,
+    );
+    const rows = [
+      row('a', { at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 7, 1) }),
+      row('b', { at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 1) }),
+    ];
+    expect(group([asc('at')], rows, backwards).map((node) => node.value)).toEqual([
+      '2026-11-05',
+      '2026-11-07',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('groups a boolean with false first, and writes it as the words of the grid', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { paid: true }), row('b', { paid: false }), row('c', { paid: true })];
+    const tree = group([asc('paid')], rows);
+    expect(tree.map((node) => node.value)).toEqual([false, true]);
+    expect(texts(tree)).toEqual(['No', 'Yes']);
+  });
+
+  it('writes the text of a group as the cell of its first row writes it', () => {
+    const upper = resolveColumns<Order>(
+      [{ field: 'assignee', format: (value: string | null) => `${value ?? ''}!`.toUpperCase() }],
+      OPTIONS,
+    );
+    expect(texts(group([asc('assignee')], ROWS, upper))).toEqual(['AN!', 'BÌNH!', '']);
+  });
+
+  it('groups by a column the layout hides, since it is given every resolved column', () => {
+    const [assignee] = resolveColumns<Order>([{ field: 'assignee', visible: false }], OPTIONS);
+    expect(texts(group([asc('assignee')], ROWS, [assignee!]))).toEqual(['An', 'Bình', '']);
+  });
+
+  it('groups by nothing that does not group: the tree is empty', () => {
+    expect(group([])).toEqual([]);
+    expect(group([asc('nothing')])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives no group for no rows, and does not change the rows', () => {
+    expect(group([asc('assignee')], [])).toEqual([]);
+    const copy = [...ROWS];
+    group([asc('status'), asc('assignee')]);
+    expect(ROWS).toEqual(copy);
+  });
+
+  it('computes the totals of each group over its rows when it is given items', () => {
+    const { items } = resolveSummaryItems(
+      [
+        { column: 'id', type: 'count' },
+        { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+      ],
+      resolved,
+    );
+    const tree = groupRows(ROWS, [asc('status'), asc('assignee')], resolved, read, 'en-US', items);
+    const delivered = tree[1]!;
+    expect(delivered.totals!.get('count:id')!.value).toBe(3);
+    expect(delivered.totals!.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(19);
+    // The total of a level is of every row inside it, the groups of the level below included.
+    expect(delivered.children![1]!.totals!.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(9);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('groupedRows', () => {
+  it('gives the rows in the order the tree shows them, the leaves in group order', () => {
+    expect(ids(groupedRows(group([asc('status')])))).toEqual(['4', '1', '3', '6', '2', '5']);
+    expect(ids(groupedRows(group([asc('status'), desc('assignee')])))).toEqual([
+      '4',
+      '1',
+      '6',
+      '3',
+      '5',
+      '2',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives nothing for an empty tree', () => {
+    expect(groupedRows([])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('rowPlaces', () => {
+  it('says, for each row in the order of groupedRows, its level, its groups and its place among its siblings', () => {
+    const tree = group([asc('status'), asc('assignee')]);
+    const places = rowPlaces(tree);
+    const rows = groupedRows(tree);
+    expect(places).toHaveLength(rows.length);
+    // Delivered > Bình holds rows 1 and 6: the second of two.
+    const six = rows.findIndex((r) => r.id === '6');
+    expect(places[six]).toEqual({
+      level: 3,
+      groups: [tree[1]!.key, tree[1]!.children![1]!.key],
+      setsize: 2,
+      posinset: 2,
+    });
+    expect(places.every((place) => place.level === 3 && place.groups.length === 2)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('puts the rows of a single level at level 2, and gives none for an empty tree', () => {
+    const tree = group([asc('status')]);
+    expect(rowPlaces(tree).map((place) => place.level)).toEqual([2, 2, 2, 2, 2, 2]);
+    expect(rowPlaces([])).toEqual([]);
+  });
+});

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/listing.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/listing.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..f07ff7a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/listing.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,195 @@
+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
+import { collator } from '../../../internal/intl';
+import type { DataGridColumn } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import { compareListed, keySortKey, listedValue } from './listing';
+import { createTextCache } from './values';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string | null;
+  status: number | null;
+  total: number | null;
+  placed: string | null;
+  at: number | null;
+  paid: boolean | null;
+}
+
+const STATUSES = [
+  { code: 1, name: 'New' },
+  { code: 2, name: 'Delivered' },
+  { code: 3, name: 'Cancelled' },
+];
+
+const OPTIONS = {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+  allowResizing: true,
+  allowReordering: true,
+  allowPinning: true,
+  allowHiding: true,
+  allowFiltering: true,
+  allowHeaderFiltering: true,
+  allowGrouping: true,
+};
+
+const ROW: Order = {
+  id: 'DH-1',
+  customer: 'Bình',
+  status: 2,
+  total: 1234,
+  placed: '2026-11-05',
+  at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 20, 30),
+  paid: true,
+};
+
+// One column of the given definition, resolved in the given zone.
+function column(definition: DataGridColumn<Order>, timeZone = 'UTC') {
+  return resolveColumns<Order>([definition], { ...OPTIONS, timeZone })[0]!;
+}
+
+const read = createTextCache<Order>();
+const listed = (row: Order, definition: DataGridColumn<Order>, timeZone?: string) =>
+  listedValue(row, column(definition, timeZone), read);
+
+describe('listedValue', () => {
+  it('lists a string by itself: its key, its text and its order', () => {
+    expect(listed(ROW, { field: 'customer' })).toEqual({
+      key: 'Bình',
+      text: 'Bình',
+      sortKey: 'Bình',
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('lists a number by its value, written as the cells write it', () => {
+    expect(listed(ROW, { field: 'total', dataType: 'number' })).toEqual({
+      key: 1234,
+      text: '1,234',
+      sortKey: 1234,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('lists a date by its ISO day, written as the cells write it, and orders it by its time', () => {
+    expect(listed(ROW, { field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' })).toEqual({
+      key: '2026-11-05',
+      text: '11/05/2026',
+      sortKey: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5),
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('lists a datetime by the day it falls on in the zone of its cells, written as that day', () => {
+    const definition: DataGridColumn<Order> = { field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' };
+    // 20:30 UTC on the 5th is 03:30 on the 6th in Hanoi, and 12:30 on the 5th in Los Angeles.
+    expect(listed(ROW, definition, 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')).toEqual({
+      key: '2026-11-06',
+      text: '11/06/2026',
+      sortKey: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 6),
+    });
+    expect(listed(ROW, definition, 'America/Los_Angeles')).toEqual({
+      key: '2026-11-05',
+      text: '11/05/2026',
+      sortKey: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5),
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('orders a datetime by its day, and not by the sortValue of its instant', () => {
+    const backwards: DataGridColumn<Order> = {
+      field: 'at',
+      dataType: 'datetime',
+      sortValue: (row) => -(row.at ?? 0),
+    };
+    expect(listed(ROW, backwards).sortKey).toBe(Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5));
+  });
+
+  it('lists a boolean by its value, written as the words of the grid, and orders false first', () => {
+    expect(listed(ROW, { field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' })).toEqual({
+      key: true,
+      text: 'Yes',
+      sortKey: 1,
+    });
+    expect(listed({ ...ROW, paid: false }, { field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' })).toEqual({
+      key: false,
+      text: 'No',
+      sortKey: 0,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('lists a lookup by the raw value, written as its text, and orders it by that text', () => {
+    const lookup: DataGridColumn<Order> = {
+      field: 'status',
+      dataType: 'number',
+      lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+    };
+    expect(listed(ROW, lookup)).toEqual({ key: 2, text: 'Delivered', sortKey: 'Delivered' });
+  });
+
+  it('orders a column by its sortValue when it has one', () => {
+    const lookup: DataGridColumn<Order> = {
+      field: 'status',
+      dataType: 'number',
+      lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+      sortValue: (row) => row.status,
+    };
+    expect(listed(ROW, lookup)).toEqual({ key: 2, text: 'Delivered', sortKey: 2 });
+  });
+
+  it('writes the key when the text of a value is empty', () => {
+    const silent: DataGridColumn<Order> = { field: 'customer', format: () => '' };
+    expect(listed(ROW, silent)).toEqual({ key: 'Bình', text: 'Bình', sortKey: 'Bình' });
+  });
+
+  it('lists a blank by no key, no text and no place in the order', () => {
+    expect(listed({ ...ROW, customer: null }, { field: 'customer' })).toEqual({
+      key: null,
+      text: '',
+      sortKey: null,
+    });
+    expect(listed({ ...ROW, at: null }, { field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' })).toEqual({
+      key: null,
+      text: '',
+      sortKey: null,
+    });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('keySortKey', () => {
+  it('orders a value no row holds as the column orders its rows', () => {
+    expect(keySortKey(column({ field: 'total', dataType: 'number' }), 7, '7')).toBe(7);
+    expect(keySortKey(column({ field: 'paid', dataType: 'boolean' }), false, 'No')).toBe(0);
+    expect(keySortKey(column({ field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' }), '2026-11-05', '')).toBe(
+      Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5),
+    );
+    expect(keySortKey(column({ field: 'customer' }), 'An', 'An')).toBe('An');
+    const lookup = column({
+      field: 'status',
+      dataType: 'number',
+      lookup: { items: STATUSES, valueField: 'code', displayField: 'name' },
+    });
+    expect(keySortKey(lookup, 3, 'Cancelled')).toBe('Cancelled');
+    expect(keySortKey(lookup, 9, '')).toBeNull();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('compareListed', () => {
+  const compareText = collator('en-US', { numeric: true }).compare;
+
+  it('orders numbers as numbers and strings by the collator', () => {
+    expect(compareListed(2, 10, compareText)).toBeLessThan(0);
+    expect(compareListed('DH-10', 'DH-2', compareText)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    expect(compareListed('a', 'a', compareText)).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('puts numbers before strings, so a mixed column orders the same way every time', () => {
+    expect(compareListed(5, 'a', compareText)).toBeLessThan(0);
+    expect(compareListed('a', 5, compareText)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+  });
+
+  it('puts a blank after every other value and ties two blanks', () => {
+    expect(compareListed(null, 1, compareText)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    expect(compareListed('z', null, compareText)).toBeLessThan(0);
+    expect(compareListed(null, null, compareText)).toBe(0);
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/page.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/page.test.ts
index fdebd4d..1452ac7 100644
--- a/src/components/data-grid/engine/page.test.ts
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/page.test.ts
@@ -1,14 +1,17 @@
 import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
-import type { FlatRow } from './flatten';
-import { clampPageIndex, pageCount, pageRows } from './page';
+import type { DataGridGroupItem, DataGridKey } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';

+  { id: 'a', status: 2, assignee: 'Bình' },
+  { id: 'b', status: 1, assignee: 'An' },
+  { id: 'c', status: 2, assignee: 'An' },

+  { field: 'assignee', direction: 'asc' },

+// The whole list, all groups open: Delivered (An: c; Bình: a, e), New (An: b; Bình: d) is 6 group
+// rows and 5 data rows. `details` are the keys whose detail row is open.
+function grouped(details: DataGridKey[] = []): FlatRow<Order>[] {
+  const tree = groupRows(ROWS, GROUPING, COLUMNS, createTextCache<Order>(), 'en-US');
+  const keyed = flattenRows(
+    groupedRows(tree),
+    (row) => row.id,
+    undefined,
+    rowPlaces(tree),
+  ) as FlatDataRow<Order>[];

+    {
+      tree,
+      keyed,
+      expanded: { allExpanded: true, except: [] },
+      expandedRows: new Set(details),
+      hasDetail: () => true,
+    },
+    undefined,
+  ).slice();
+}
+

+function outline(rows: readonly FlatRow<Order>[]): string[] {

+      ? `g${row.level}:${row.node.text}${row.continued ? '*' : ''}`
+      : row.kind === 'detail'

+        : `d:${String(row.key)}`,
+  );

+
+  it('keeps a detail row with its master, even when the master is the last row counted', () => {

+      'g2:An',
+      'd:c',

+      'd:a',

+    ]);
+    // The next page does not start on the detail row, and does not hold it twice.
+    expect(outline(pageRows(rows, { index: 1, size: 5 }))).toEqual([

+      'g2:Bình*',
+      'd:e',
+      'g1:New',
+      'g2:An',
+      'd:b',

+  it('does not count a detail row in the size of a page', () => {

+
+  it('cuts the clamped page, so a page past the end shows the last one', () => {

+      const closed = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, expanded: { allExpanded: false, except: [] } }),
+      );
+      expect(closed.flat).toHaveLength(11);
+      const key = closed.tree![2]!.key;
+      const one = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, expanded: { allExpanded: false, except: [key] } }),
+      );
+      expect(one.flat).toHaveLength(11 + closed.tree![2]!.rows.length);
+      // Every row is still keyed: what a selection reads does not shrink with a closed group.
+      expect(one.keyed).toHaveLength(30);
+    });
+
+    it('ignores the items that do not group, and groups by a column the layout hides', () => {
+      const none = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ grouping: [{ field: 'gone', direction: 'asc' }] }),
+      );
+      expect(none.tree).toBeNull();
+      expect(none.flat).toBe(none.keyed);
+      // groupColumns is every resolved column, not the shown ones.
+      const hidden = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, columns: [resolved[0]!] }),
+      );
+      expect(hidden.tree).toHaveLength(11);
+    });
+
+    it('puts a detail row after the open masters, and keeps it with its master on a page', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({
+          expandedRows: ['DH-1', 'DH-2', 'nope'],
+          hasDetail: (row) => row.id === 'DH-1',
+          page: { index: 0, size: 2 },
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(result.flat).toHaveLength(31);
+      expect(result.flat[1]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'detail', key: 'DH-1', level: 1 });
+      expect(result.total).toBe(30);
+      expect(result.visible.map((row) => row.kind)).toEqual(['data', 'detail', 'data']);
+    });
+
+    it('has no totals without items, and no total on a group without group items', () => {
+      const bare = createPipeline<Order>().run(input({ grouping: byQty }));
+      expect(bare.totals).toBeNull();
+      expect(bare.tree![0]!.totals).toBeNull();
+      expect(totals).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    });
+
+    it('totals every row after the search and the filter, whatever the page', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({
+          summary: summary(sumQty),
+          filter: { columns: { qty: { operator: '>', value: 5 } } },
+          page: { index: 1, size: 3 },
+        }),
+      );
+      const kept = DATA.filter((row) => row.qty > 5);
+      expect(result.totals!.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(kept.reduce((n, row) => n + row.qty, 0));
+    });
+
+    it('totals each group over its rows when it has group items', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ grouping: byQty, summary: summary([], [{ column: 'id', type: 'count' }]) }),
+      );
+      const counts = result.tree!.map((node) => node.totals!.get('count:id')!.value);
+      expect(counts).toEqual(QUANTITIES.map((qty) => DATA.filter((row) => row.qty === qty).length));
+      expect(result.totals).toBeNull();
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('server mode', () => {
+    it('does not group and does not total: the data is the page, and the totals are of the app', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({
+          remote: true,
+          totalCount: 90,
+          grouping: byQty,
+          summary: summary(sumQty, [{ column: 'id', type: 'count' }]),
+        }),
+      );
+      expect(groups).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+      expect(totals).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+      expect(result.tree).toBeNull();
+      expect(result.totals).toBeNull();
+      expect(result.flat).toBe(result.keyed);
+      expect(result.total).toBe(90);
+    });
+
+    it('still puts the detail rows of the page after their masters', () => {
+      const result = createPipeline<Order>().run(
+        input({ remote: true, totalCount: 90, expandedRows: ['DH-3'], hasDetail: () => true }),
+      );
+      expect(result.flat).toHaveLength(31);
+      expect(result.flat[3]).toMatchObject({ kind: 'detail', key: 'DH-3' });
+      expect(result.total).toBe(90);
+    });
+  });
+
+  describe('what it remembers', () => {
+    it('groups once for the same inputs, and for a grouping written as a new array', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: [{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }] }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: [{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }] }));
+      expect(second).toBe(first);
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    });
+
+    it('does not group again for an item that does not group, nor for a hide of columns it does not name', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty }));
+      const idle: DataGridGroupItem[] = [...byQty, { field: 'gone', direction: 'desc' }];
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: idle }));
+      const hidden = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty, columns: [resolved[0]!] }));
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(second.tree).toBe(first.tree);
+      expect(hidden).toBe(first);
+    });
+
+    it('groups again for another level, another direction or other columns the grouping names', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty }));
+      pipeline.run(input({ grouping: [{ field: 'qty', direction: 'desc' }] }));
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      const two: DataGridGroupItem[] = [...byQty, { field: 'id', direction: 'asc' }];
+      pipeline.run(input({ grouping: two }));
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+      const again = resolveColumns(COLUMNS, { ...OPTIONS, locale: 'vi-VN' });
+      pipeline.run(input({ grouping: two, groupColumns: again, locale: 'vi-VN' }));
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(4);
+    });
+
+    it('runs steps 8 and 9 only for a toggle of a group, and keeps the tree, the keyed rows and the totals', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { summary: summary(sumQty), grouping: byQty };
+      const first = pipeline.run(input(held));
+      const key = first.tree![0]!.key;
+      const toggled = pipeline.run(
+        input({ ...held, expanded: { allExpanded: true, except: [key] } }),
+      );
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(totals).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(keyedRows).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(flattenings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(toggled.tree).toBe(first.tree);
+      expect(toggled.keyed).toBe(first.keyed);
+      expect(toggled.totals).toBe(first.totals);
+      expect(toggled.flat).not.toBe(first.flat);
+      expect(toggled.flat).toHaveLength(first.flat.length - first.tree![0]!.rows.length);
+    });
+
+    it('reads the exceptions and the open rows as sets: the same members in another order is no toggle', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty }));
+      const [a, b] = [first.tree![0]!.key, first.tree![1]!.key];
+      const hasDetail = () => true;
+      const run = (except: string[], expandedRows: string[], detail = hasDetail) =>
+        pipeline.run(
+          input({
+            grouping: byQty,
+            hasDetail: detail,
+            expanded: { allExpanded: true, except },
+            expandedRows,
+          }),
+        );
+      run([a, b], ['DH-1', 'DH-2']);
+      const count = flattenings.mock.calls.length;
+      run([b, a], ['DH-2', 'DH-1']);
+      expect(flattenings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(count);
+      // A function that is another function is another list, as the grid warns it may be.
+      run([b, a], ['DH-2', 'DH-1'], () => true);
+      expect(flattenings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(count + 1);
+    });
+
+    it('does not group, total or flatten again for a new page', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { summary: summary(sumQty), grouping: byQty };
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ ...held, page: { index: 0, size: 10 } }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ ...held, page: { index: 2, size: 10 } }));
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(totals).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(flattenings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(second.flat).toBe(first.flat);
+      expect(second.visible).not.toBe(first.visible);
+    });
+
+    it('runs no total again for a sort but groups the new order again; a search runs them from step 3', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { summary: summary(sumQty), grouping: byQty };
+      const idDesc: DataGridSortItem[] = [{ field: 'id', direction: 'desc' }];
+      pipeline.run(input(held));
+      pipeline.run(input({ ...held, sort: idDesc }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(totals).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      pipeline.run(input({ ...held, sort: idDesc, filter: { search: 'DH-2' } }));
+      expect(totals).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
+    });
+
+    it('runs none of the steps 5 to 8 for a hide or a reorder of columns they do not name', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { summary: summary(sumQty), grouping: byQty, sort: qtyAsc };
+      const first = pipeline.run(input(held));
+      const reordered = pipeline.run(input({ ...held, columns: [resolved[1]!, resolved[0]!] }));
+      // The quantity is the one column the sort names, so it stays: hide the id.
+      const fewer = pipeline.run(input({ ...held, columns: [resolved[1]!] }));
+      expect(sorts).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(groups).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(totals).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(keyedRows).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(flattenings).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+      expect(reordered).toBe(first);
+      expect(fewer).toBe(first);
+    });
+
+    it('keeps the data rows that did not change when one row is edited, and draws the groups from the new tree', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const held = { grouping: byQty };
+      const first = pipeline.run(input(held));
+      const edited = DATA.map((row) => (row.id === 'DH-2' ? { ...row } : row));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ ...held, data: edited }));
+      const kept = second.flat.filter((row) => row.kind === 'data' && first.flat.includes(row));
+      expect(kept).toHaveLength(29);
+    });
+
+    it('gives back the same keyed rows and list for a new getKey that says the same', () => {
+      const pipeline = createPipeline<Order>();
+      const first = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty }));
+      const second = pipeline.run(input({ grouping: byQty, getKey: (row) => row.id }));
+      expect(second.keyed).toBe(first.keyed);
+      expect(second.flat).toBe(first.flat);
+    });
+  });
+});

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/summary.test.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/summary.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..97d3023
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/summary.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,260 @@
+import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import type { DataGridColumn, DataGridSummaryItem } from '../types';
+import { resolveColumns } from './columns';
+import { computeSummary, resolveSummaryItems, summaryText } from './summary';
+import type { ResolvedSummaryItem } from './summary';
+import { createTextCache } from './values';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  qty: number | null;
+  total: number | null;
+  placed: string | null;
+  at: number | null;
+  note: string | null;
+}
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id' },
+  { field: 'qty', dataType: 'number' },
+  { field: 'total', dataType: 'number', format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' } },
+  { field: 'placed', dataType: 'date' },
+  { field: 'at', dataType: 'datetime' },
+  { field: 'note' },
+];
+
+const OPTIONS = {
+  locale: 'en-US',
+  timeZone: 'UTC',
+  yes: 'Yes',
+  no: 'No',
+  allowSorting: true,
+  allowResizing: true,
+  allowReordering: true,
+  allowPinning: true,
+  allowHiding: true,
+  allowFiltering: true,
+  allowHeaderFiltering: true,
+  allowGrouping: true,
+};
+
+const resolved = resolveColumns<Order>(COLUMNS, OPTIONS);
+const read = createTextCache<Order>();
+
+const row = (id: string, patch: Partial<Order> = {}): Order => ({
+  id,
+  qty: null,
+  total: null,
+  placed: null,
+  at: null,
+  note: null,
+  ...patch,
+});
+
+const ROWS: Order[] = [
+  row('a', { qty: 4, total: 10.5, placed: '2026-11-06', at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 6, 9), note: 'x' }),
+  row('b', { qty: 2, total: 20, placed: '2026-11-04', at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 4, 9) }),
+  row('c', { qty: null, total: 30, placed: null, at: null }),
+  row('d', { qty: 10, total: null, placed: '2026-11-05', at: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 5, 9) }),
+];
+
+// The items, resolved, in the order of the definitions.
+function resolve(...definitions: DataGridSummaryItem<Order>[]): ResolvedSummaryItem<Order>[] {
+  return resolveSummaryItems(definitions, resolved).items;
+}
+function compute(...definitions: DataGridSummaryItem<Order>[]) {
+  return computeSummary(ROWS, resolve(...definitions));
+}
+function text(definition: DataGridSummaryItem<Order>, rows: readonly Order[] = ROWS): string {
+  const [item] = resolve(definition);
+  const entry = computeSummary(rows, [item!]).get(item!.id);
+  return summaryText(item!, entry, { locale: 'en-US', read });
+}
+
+describe('resolveSummaryItems', () => {
+  it('gives each item an id: its own, else the type and the field, else "custom" and the field', () => {
+    const fn = (rows: readonly Order[]) => rows.length;
+    const { items } = resolveSummaryItems(
+      [
+        { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+        { column: 'total', field: 'qty', type: 'avg' },
+        { id: 'mine', column: 'qty', type: 'max' },
+        { column: 'id', field: 'qty', type: fn },
+      ],
+      resolved,
+    );
+    expect(items.map((item) => item.id)).toEqual(['sum:qty', 'avg:qty', 'mine', 'custom:qty']);
+  });
+
+  it('says the column an item shows in and the column it reads, which is its own by default', () => {
+    const { items } = resolveSummaryItems(
+      [
+        { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+        { column: 'total', field: 'qty', type: 'avg', label: 'Mean' },
+      ],
+      resolved,
+    );
+    expect(items.map((item) => [item.column, item.source.id])).toEqual([
+      ['qty', 'qty'],
+      ['total', 'qty'],
+    ]);
+    expect(items[1]).toMatchObject({ type: 'avg', label: 'Mean', format: undefined });
+    expect(items[0]!.source).toBe(resolved.find((column) => column.id === 'qty'));
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out an item whose column or field is no column of the grid, and says which', () => {
+    const lost = { column: 'nothing', type: 'sum' } as const;
+    const lostField = { column: 'qty', field: 'nothing', type: 'sum' } as const;
+    const { items, leftOut } = resolveSummaryItems(
+      [lost, { column: 'qty', type: 'count' }, lostField],
+      resolved,
+    );
+    expect(items.map((item) => item.id)).toEqual(['count:qty']);
+    expect(leftOut).toEqual([lost, lostField]);
+  });
+
+  it('gives nothing for no items, and does not warn itself', () => {
+    expect(resolveSummaryItems([], resolved)).toEqual({ items: [], leftOut: [] });
+  });
+});
+
+describe('computeSummary', () => {
+  it('counts the rows, blanks included', () => {
+    expect(compute({ column: 'qty', type: 'count' }).get('count:qty')).toEqual({
+      value: 4,
+      row: undefined,
+    });
+  });
+
+  it('sums the numbers of the field and skips the rest', () => {
+    expect(compute({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' }).get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(16);
+    // A string column holds no number to sum.
+    expect(compute({ column: 'note', type: 'sum' }).get('sum:note')!.value).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('gives 0 for the sum of no number, and no value for the average of none', () => {
+    const none = [row('a'), row('b')];
+    const items = resolve({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' }, { column: 'qty', type: 'avg' });
+    const values = computeSummary(none, items);
+    expect(values.get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(0);
+    expect(values.get('avg:qty')!.value).toBeNull();
+    expect(computeSummary([], items).get('sum:qty')!.value).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('averages the numbers that are there, not all the rows', () => {
+    expect(compute({ column: 'qty', type: 'avg' }).get('avg:qty')!.value).toBeCloseTo(16 / 3);
+  });
+
+  it('finds the least and the greatest number, and keeps the row that holds it', () => {
+    const values = compute({ column: 'qty', type: 'min' }, { column: 'qty', type: 'max' });
+    expect(values.get('min:qty')).toEqual({ value: 2, row: ROWS[1] });
+    expect(values.get('max:qty')).toEqual({ value: 10, row: ROWS[3] });
+  });
+
+  it('finds the least and the greatest date and datetime, and keeps the row', () => {
+    const values = compute(
+      { column: 'placed', type: 'min' },
+      { column: 'placed', type: 'max' },
+      { column: 'at', type: 'max' },
+    );
+    expect(values.get('min:placed')).toEqual({ value: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 4), row: ROWS[1] });
+    expect(values.get('max:placed')).toEqual({ value: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 6), row: ROWS[0] });
+    expect(values.get('max:at')).toEqual({ value: Date.UTC(2026, 10, 6, 9), row: ROWS[0] });
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the first row that holds the value when two do', () => {
+    const rows = [row('a', { qty: 3 }), row('b', { qty: 3 })];
+    const [min, max] = resolve({ column: 'qty', type: 'min' }, { column: 'qty', type: 'max' });
+    const values = computeSummary(rows, [min!, max!]);
+    expect(values.get('min:qty')!.row).toBe(rows[0]);
+    expect(values.get('max:qty')!.row).toBe(rows[0]);
+  });
+
+  it('has no value and no row for the least of nothing, or of a column that has no order of numbers', () => {
+    const items = resolve({ column: 'qty', type: 'min' }, { column: 'note', type: 'max' });
+    const empty = computeSummary([row('a')], items);
+    expect(empty.get('min:qty')).toEqual({ value: null, row: undefined });
+    // A string column has no least or greatest to total.
+    expect(computeSummary(ROWS, items).get('max:note')).toEqual({ value: null, row: undefined });
+  });
+
+  it('calls a function type with every row, and keeps what it returns', () => {
+    const fn = vi.fn((rows: readonly Order[]) => `${rows.length} rows`);
+    const [item] = resolve({ column: 'id', type: fn });
+    const values = computeSummary(ROWS, [item!]);
+    expect(fn).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
+    expect(fn.mock.calls[0]![0]).toEqual(ROWS);
+    expect(values.get('custom:id')).toEqual({ value: '4 rows', row: undefined });
+  });
+
+  it('computes every item over one set of rows, each under its id', () => {
+    const values = compute(
+      { column: 'qty', type: 'count' },
+      { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+      { column: 'total', type: 'max' },
+    );
+    expect([...values.keys()]).toEqual(['count:qty', 'sum:qty', 'max:total']);
+  });
+
+  it('does not change the rows', () => {
+    const copy = [...ROWS];
+    compute({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' });
+    expect(ROWS).toEqual(copy);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('summaryText', () => {
+  it('writes a count as a whole number, in the grid locale', () => {
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'count' })).toBe('4');
+    const many = Array.from({ length: 1234 }, (_, index) => row(String(index)));
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'count' }, many)).toBe('1,234');
+  });
+
+  it('writes a sum as the column writes a number: with its Intl options, else the locale default', () => {
+    expect(text({ column: 'total', type: 'sum' })).toBe('$60.50');
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' })).toBe('16');
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'avg' })).toBe('5.333');
+  });
+
+  it('writes a sum with the Intl options or the function of the item when it has one', () => {
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum', format: { minimumFractionDigits: 2 } })).toBe(
+      '16.00',
+    );
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum', format: (value) => `${String(value)} pcs` })).toBe(
+      '16 pcs',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('writes a least or greatest as the text of the row that holds it', () => {
+    expect(text({ column: 'total', type: 'max' })).toBe('$30.00');
+    expect(text({ column: 'placed', type: 'min' })).toBe('11/04/2026');
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'max' })).toBe('10');
+  });
+
+  it('writes a least or greatest with the format of the item when it has one', () => {
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'max', format: (value) => `<${String(value)}>` })).toBe(
+      '<10>',
+    );
+  });
+
+  it('writes the value of a function type with the format of the item, else as a string', () => {
+    expect(text({ column: 'id', type: (rows) => rows.length })).toBe('4');
+    expect(
+      text({ column: 'id', type: (rows) => rows.length, format: (v) => `n=${String(v)}` }),
+    ).toBe('n=4');
+    expect(text({ column: 'id', type: () => null })).toBe('');
+  });
+
+  it('writes nothing for a blank: the average or least of no number, and a missing value', () => {
+    const none = [row('a')];
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'avg' }, none)).toBe('');
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'min' }, none)).toBe('');
+    const [item] = resolve({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' });
+    expect(summaryText(item!, undefined, { locale: 'en-US', read })).toBe('');
+  });
+
+  it('never throws on Intl options it cannot use: the number is written as the locale writes it', () => {
+    const bad = { style: 'currency' } as Intl.NumberFormatOptions;
+    expect(text({ column: 'qty', type: 'sum', format: bad })).toBe('16');
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/grouping.test-d.ts b/src/components/data-grid/grouping.test-d.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..093296f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/grouping.test-d.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,80 @@
+import { expectTypeOf, test } from 'vitest';
+import type {
+  DataGridColumn,
+  DataGridExpandedGroups,
+  DataGridGroupItem,
+  DataGridSortDirection,
+  DataGridSummaryItem,
+} from './index';
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  customer: string;
+  total: number;
+}
+
+// What JSON can carry, so an app can keep the state in `localStorage` or send it to a server.
+type IsJson<T> = T extends string | number | boolean | null
+  ? true
+  : T extends readonly (infer Item)[]
+    ? IsJson<Item>
+    : T extends object
+      ? { [K in keyof T]: IsJson<T[K]> }[keyof T] extends true
+        ? true
+        : false
+      : false;
+
+test('a grouping item names a column and a direction of the sort, and no other', () => {
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridGroupItem>().toEqualTypeOf<{
+    field: string;
+    direction: DataGridSortDirection;
+  }>();
+  const ok: DataGridGroupItem = { field: 'customer', direction: 'desc' };
+  expectTypeOf(ok).toBeObject();
+  // @ts-expect-error `up` is no direction
+  const up: DataGridGroupItem = { field: 'customer', direction: 'up' };
+  expectTypeOf(up).toBeObject();
+});
+
+test('the groups that are open are JSON: a switch and the keys of the exceptions', () => {
+  expectTypeOf<DataGridExpandedGroups>().toEqualTypeOf<{
+    allExpanded: boolean;
+    except: readonly string[];
+  }>();
+  expectTypeOf<IsJson<DataGridExpandedGroups>>().toEqualTypeOf<true>();
+  expectTypeOf<IsJson<DataGridGroupItem>>().toEqualTypeOf<true>();
+});
+
+test('a summary item takes the five types, or a function of the rows, and no other word', () => {
+  const named: DataGridSummaryItem<Order>[] = [
+    { column: 'total', type: 'count' },
+    { column: 'total', type: 'sum', label: 'Sum', format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'VND' } },
+    { id: 'mean', column: 'total', field: 'total', type: 'avg' },
+    { column: 'total', type: 'min' },
+    { column: 'total', type: 'max', format: (value) => String(value) },
+  ];
+  expectTypeOf(named).toBeArray();
+  // A function reads the rows and gives any value.
+  const own: DataGridSummaryItem<Order> = {
+    column: 'id',
+    type: (rows) => {
+      expectTypeOf(rows).toEqualTypeOf<readonly Order[]>();
+      return rows.length;
+    },
+  };
+  expectTypeOf(own).toBeObject();
+  // @ts-expect-error `median` is no type
+  const median: DataGridSummaryItem<Order> = { column: 'total', type: 'median' };
+  expectTypeOf(median).toBeObject();
+});
+
+test('a column says whether it groups and whether it stays shown while it does', () => {
+  const columns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+    { field: 'customer', allowGrouping: false },
+    { field: 'total', dataType: 'number', showWhenGrouped: true },
+  ];
+  expectTypeOf(columns).toBeArray();
+  // @ts-expect-error a switch is a boolean
+  const wrong: DataGridColumn<Order> = { field: 'customer', allowGrouping: 'yes' };
+  expectTypeOf(wrong).toBeObject();
+});
```

```diff
+
+export interface FlattenInput<TRow> {
+  /** The groups, or `null` when the rows are not grouped. */
+  tree: readonly GroupNode<TRow>[] | null;
+  /** The data rows in the order the tree shows them (`groupedRows`), each with its place. */
+  keyed: readonly FlatDataRow<TRow>[];
+  expanded: DataGridExpandedGroups;
+  /** The keys of the rows whose detail is open. */
+  expandedRows: ReadonlySet<DataGridKey>;
+  /** Whether a row has a detail; without it no row does, whatever `expandedRows` holds. */
```
