diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/engine/group-panel.ts b/src/components/data-grid/engine/group-panel.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..1ff4316
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/engine/group-panel.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+import type { DataGridGroupItem } from '../types';
+
+/**
+ * Where a drop on the group panel would put a level: the slot, from 0 (before the first chip) to the
+ * number of chips (after the last), is the number of chips whose middle is left of the pointer, so the
+ * level goes before the chip under the pointer when the pointer is in its left half, and after it when
+ * it is in the right half. `centers` are the client x of the middles of the chips, in order.
+ */
+export function slotAt(centers: readonly number[], x: number): number {
+  let slot = 0;
+  for (const center of centers) {
+    if (center < x) slot += 1;
+  }
+  return slot;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The place, from 0, that the chip at `from` has when it is dropped on `slot` (a slot of the chips as
+ * they are, which counts the chip itself), or `null` when that is the place it has: the slots just
+ * before and just after a chip are no move.
+ */
+export function levelTarget(from: number, slot: number): number | null {
+  const to = slot > from ? slot - 1 : slot;
+  return to === from ? null : to;
+}
+
+/** `items` with the one at `from` taken out and put at `to`; a new list. */
+export function moveItem<T>(items: readonly T[], from: number, to: number): T[] {
+  const next = [...items];
+  const [moved] = next.splice(from, 1);
+  if (moved !== undefined) next.splice(to, 0, moved);
+  return next;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The grouping a drop or a key asks for when it moves the level `from` to `to`: the held grouping with
+ * its levels (`levels`, the items that group) in the new order. The held grouping may hold items that
+ * do not group (a field of no column, a repeated field: spec phase 6 §5 "Giá trị lạ"), which stay
+ * where they are, so only the places of the levels are written again.
+ */
+export function regroupLevels(
+  held: readonly DataGridGroupItem[],
+  levels: readonly DataGridGroupItem[],
+  from: number,
+  to: number,
+): DataGridGroupItem[] {
+  const places = levels.map((level) => held.findIndex((item) => item.field === level.field));
+  const moved = moveItem(levels, from, to);
+  const next = [...held];
+  for (const [at, place] of places.entries()) {
+    if (place >= 0) next[place] = moved[at]!;
+  }
+  return next;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The held grouping with `item` added as a level before the level at `slot` (the end when `slot` is
+ * past the last level): before that level's own item in the held list, so the items that do not group
+ * keep their places.
+ */
+export function insertLevel(
+  held: readonly DataGridGroupItem[],
+  levels: readonly DataGridGroupItem[],
+  item: DataGridGroupItem,
+  slot: number,
+): DataGridGroupItem[] {
+  const before = levels[slot];
+  const place = before === undefined ? -1 : held.findIndex((other) => other.field === before.field);
+  const next = [...held];
+  next.splice(place < 0 ? next.length : place, 0, item);
+  return next;
+}

+ * bottom of the row of the titles, and across the frame. A chip of the group panel dropped here ungroups.

+export function overHeading(
+  frame: HTMLElement | null | undefined,
+  table: HTMLTableElement | null | undefined,
+  x: number,
+  y: number,

+  const row = titleRow(table);
+  if (!frame || !row) return false;
+  const box = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
+  return x >= box.left && x <= box.right && y >= box.top && y <= row.getBoundingClientRect().bottom;
+}

+import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { PointerEvent as ReactPointerEvent, RefObject } from 'react';
+import { takesOwnPress } from '../../../internal/controls';
+import { usePointerDrag } from '../../../internal/use-pointer-drag';
+import { useWriteOnCommit } from '../../../internal/use-write-on-commit';
+import { levelTarget, slotAt } from '../engine/group-panel';
+import { chipCenters, markDragCursor, overHeading } from '../grid-dom';
+import type { DragViewStore } from './use-drag-view';
+import type { GroupChip } from './use-group-panel';
+
+export interface ChipDragOptions {
+  /** Whether the panel is drawn: a drag in flight ends, with nothing done, when it is not. */
+  enabled: boolean;
+  frameRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
+  tableRef: RefObject<HTMLTableElement | null>;
+  panelRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>;
+  /** The chips as they are now. */
+  chips: readonly GroupChip[];
+  view: DragViewStore;
+  /** Moves the level of the field to a place among the levels, with the sentence. */
+  moveTo: (field: string, to: number) => void;
+  /** Takes the level of the field out of the grouping, with the sentence. */
+  ungroup: (field: string) => void;
+}
+
+export interface ChipDrag {
+  /** The press on the chip of `field`: the start of a drag, unless the press is on one of its buttons. */
+  onPointerDown: (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>, field: string) => void;
+}
+
+/** A drag from its first move to its end. */
+interface Session {
+  field: string;
+  caption: string;
+  doc: Document;
+  /** Where the pointer was last, to place again what a change of the chips made out of date. */
+  x: number;
+  y: number;
+  /** What the pointer is over that takes a drop. */
+  over: 'tray' | 'heading' | null;
+  /** The place a drop on the panel gives the level; `null` beside itself and off the panel. */
+  to: number | null;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Dragging a chip of the group panel (spec phase 6 §3.8): to a place of the panel, which moves its level
+ * (a drop beside itself changes nothing), onto the headings, which ungroups, and anywhere else it does
+ * nothing. Every pointer type drags (a finger too: the chips are on the toolbar, which does not scroll
+ * sideways, and have `touch-action: none`). A press on one of the chip's buttons is the button's
+ * (`takesOwnPress`), and the `mousedown` of a press that may drag is cancelled by the chip, never the
+ * `pointerdown`. The chip that follows the pointer is the grid's one (`DragLayer`); the panel reads
+ * where the pointer is from the store of the drag, and the source chip is dimmed from it.
+ *
+ * Escape, `pointercancel`, a lost capture, the grid unmounting and the panel being turned off all end it
+ * the same way: what the drag set on the page (the cursor mark, the store) is taken off by one function
+ * (`settle`) and nothing is changed. The grouping changes once, at the release.
+ */
+export function useChipDrag(options: ChipDragOptions): ChipDrag {
+  const latest = useRef(options);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    latest.current = options;
+  });
+  const pressed = useRef<string | null>(null);
+  const session = useRef<Session | null>(null);
+
+  /** Where the pointer is now says what a drop would do: the panel shows the bar, the chip follows. */
+  const apply = useCallback((current: Session, x: number, y: number) => {
+    const { panelRef, frameRef, tableRef, chips, view } = latest.current;
+    current.x = x;
+    current.y = y;
+    const panel = panelRef.current;
+    const box = panel?.getBoundingClientRect();
+    let slot: number | null = null;
+    current.to = null;
+    current.over = null;
+    if (panel && box && x >= box.left && x <= box.right && y >= box.top && y <= box.bottom) {
+      current.over = 'tray';
+      const from = chips.findIndex((chip) => chip.field === current.field);
+      const at = slotAt(chipCenters(panel), x);
+      current.to = from < 0 ? null : levelTarget(from, at);
+      slot = current.to === null ? null : at;
+    } else if (overHeading(frameRef.current, tableRef.current, x, y)) {
+      current.over = 'heading';
+    }
+    view.set({
+      caption: current.caption,
+      x,
+      y,
+      edge: null,
+      target: current.over,
+      slot,
+      chip: current.field,
+    });
+  }, []);
+
+  // Everything a drag set, taken off: the one place that does it, for each way a drag ends.
+  const settle = useCallback((current: Session) => {
+    markDragCursor(current.doc, null);
+    latest.current.view.set(null);
+  }, []);
+
+  const finish = useCallback(
+    (done: boolean) => {
+      const current = session.current;
+      if (!current) return;
+      session.current = null;
+      if (done) {
+        // The chips may have changed while the button was held: the drop is worked out again from them.
+        apply(current, current.x, current.y);
+      }
+      settle(current);
+      if (!done) return;
+      const { moveTo, ungroup } = latest.current;
+      if (current.over === 'tray' && current.to !== null) moveTo(current.field, current.to);
+      else if (current.over === 'heading') ungroup(current.field);
+    },
+    [apply, settle],
+  );

+  const drag = usePointerDrag({
+    onStart: ({ x, y }) => {
+      const field = pressed.current;
+      const { enabled, panelRef, chips } = latest.current;
+      const chip = chips.find((other) => other.field === field);
+      const doc = panelRef.current?.ownerDocument;

+      session.current = { field, caption: chip.caption, doc, x, y, over: null, to: null };
+      markDragCursor(doc, 'grabbing');

+    onMove: ({ x, y }) => {
+      const current = session.current;
+      if (current) apply(current, x, y);
+    },
+    onEnd: () => finish(true),
+    onCancel: () => finish(false),
+  });

+  // A panel turned off in the middle of a drag takes the drag with it, and the grid going does too.
+  const { enabled } = options;
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!enabled) finish(false);
+  }, [enabled, finish]);
+  useEffect(
+    () => () => {
+      const current = session.current;
+      session.current = null;
+      if (current) settle(current);
+    },
+    [settle],
+  );
+
+  const { onPointerDown: startDrag } = drag;
+  const onPointerDown = useCallback(
+    (event: ReactPointerEvent<HTMLElement>, field: string) => {
+      if (takesOwnPress(event)) return;
+      pressed.current = field;
+      startDrag(event);
+    },
+    [startDrag],
+  );
+  return useMemo(() => ({ onPointerDown }), [onPointerDown]);
+}

+import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';

+/** A chip of the group panel: one level of the grouping, as the panel draws it. */

+    (chip, at) =>
+      chip.field === b[at]!.field &&
+      chip.caption === b[at]!.caption &&
+      chip.direction === b[at]!.direction,
+  );
+
+export interface GroupPanelOptions<TRow> {
+  /**
+   * Whether the grid draws the panel: `groupPanel`, not server mode, and the toolbar places the tray. The
+   * grid groups from the menu and the titles only then.
+   */
+  panel: boolean;
+  /** The grouping as the grid holds it, and the items of it that group, in order. */
+  held: readonly DataGridGroupItem[];
+  levels: readonly DataGridGroupItem[];
+  /** The one way the grouping changes (`useGridGrouping`): callbacks, the first page, the sentence. */
+  applyGrouping: (next: readonly DataGridGroupItem[], said?: string) => void;
+  /** The caller's columns, shown or not: a chip says the caption of its column. */
+  resolved: readonly ResolvedColumn<TRow>[];
+  /** Whether more than one data column is shown: a grouping must leave one shown. */
+  hideable: boolean;
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+}
+
+export interface GroupPanelControl {
+  /** The chips, in the order of the levels, kept by value. */
+  chips: readonly GroupChip[];
+  /** Whether the grid would group by the column now: it allows it, it is not grouped by, a column stays shown. */
+  canGroup: (columnId: string) => boolean;
+  /** Whether a title may be dropped on the panel: the panel is drawn and `canGroup`. */
+  accepts: (columnId: string) => boolean;
+  /** Adds the column as a level, ascending, at `slot` of the levels (the end without one). */
+  group: (columnId: string, slot?: number) => void;
+  /** Takes the level of the field out of the grouping. */
+  ungroup: (field: string) => void;
+  /** Turns the direction of the level of the field. */
+  turn: (field: string) => void;
+  /** Moves the level of the field one place; `false` at the edge, where nothing changed. */
+  step: (field: string, step: -1 | 1) => boolean;
+  /** Moves the level of the field to the place `to` (from 0) among the levels. */
+  moveTo: (field: string, to: number) => void;
+}
+
+/**
+ * What the user does to the grouping from the group panel and the column menu (spec phase 6 §3.8, §6.3
+ * "Nhóm"): each is one change through `applyGrouping`, with the sentence it says. They build the new
+ * grouping from the one the grid holds, and keep the items that do not group where they are. The
+ * functions read what they need when they are called and are the same for as long as the grid lives, so
+ * the chips, which are keyed by their field, draw only when a level changes.
+ */
+export function useGroupPanel<TRow>(options: GroupPanelOptions<TRow>): GroupPanelControl {
+  const { levels, resolved } = options;
+  const latest = useRef(options);
+  useWriteOnCommit(() => {
+    latest.current = options;
+  });
+
+  const list = useMemo(
+    () =>
+      levels.map((item) => ({
+        field: item.field,
+        caption: captionOf(resolved, item.field),
+        direction: item.direction,
+      })),
+    [levels, resolved],
+  );
+  const chips = useKept(list, sameChips);
+
+  const canGroup = useCallback((columnId: string) => {
+    const { panel, levels: now, resolved: columns, hideable } = latest.current;
+    const column = columns.find((other) => other.id === columnId);
+    return (
+      panel &&
+      hideable &&
+      column?.allowGrouping === true &&
+      !now.some((item) => item.field === columnId)
+    );
+  }, []);
+  // `canGroup` already needs the panel drawn, so what the panel accepts is what can be grouped.
+  const accepts = canGroup;
+
+  const group = useCallback(
+    (columnId: string, slot?: number) => {
+      if (!canGroup(columnId)) return;
+      const { held, levels: now, applyGrouping, resolved: columns, labels } = latest.current;
+      const item: DataGridGroupItem = { field: columnId, direction: 'asc' };
+      const next =
+        slot === undefined || slot >= now.length
+          ? [...held, item]
+          : insertLevel(held, now, item, Math.max(0, slot));
+      applyGrouping(next, labels.announceGrouped(captionOf(columns, columnId)));
+    },
+    [canGroup],
+  );
+
+  const ungroup = useCallback((field: string) => {
+    const { held, levels: now, applyGrouping, resolved: columns, labels } = latest.current;
+    if (!now.some((item) => item.field === field)) return;
+    applyGrouping(
+      held.filter((item) => item.field !== field),
+      labels.announceUngrouped(captionOf(columns, field)),
+    );
+  }, []);
+
+  const turn = useCallback((field: string) => {
+    const { held, levels: now, applyGrouping } = latest.current;
+    const level = now.find((item) => item.field === field);
+    if (!level) return;
+    const next: DataGridSortDirection = level.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
+    const at = held.findIndex((item) => item.field === field);
+    // The name of the button says the direction it turns to, so the change says nothing more.
+    applyGrouping(held.map((item, place) => (place === at ? { ...item, direction: next } : item)));
+  }, []);
+
+  const moveTo = useCallback((field: string, to: number) => {
+    const { held, levels: now, applyGrouping, resolved: columns, labels } = latest.current;
+    const from = now.findIndex((item) => item.field === field);
+    if (from < 0 || to < 0 || to >= now.length || to === from) return;
+    applyGrouping(
+      regroupLevels(held, now, from, to),
+      labels.announceGroupMoved(captionOf(columns, field), to + 1, now.length),
+    );
+  }, []);
+
+  const step = useCallback(
+    (field: string, by: -1 | 1) => {
+      const from = latest.current.levels.findIndex((item) => item.field === field);
+      const to = from + by;
+      if (from < 0 || to < 0 || to >= latest.current.levels.length) return false;
+      moveTo(field, to);
+      return true;
+    },
+    [moveTo],
+  );
+
+  return useMemo(
+    () => ({ chips, canGroup, accepts, group, ungroup, turn, step, moveTo }),
+    [chips, canGroup, accepts, group, ungroup, turn, step, moveTo],
+  );
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/GroupPanel.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/GroupPanel.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..aa21336
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/GroupPanel.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,191 @@
+import { Fragment, memo, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { KeyboardEvent, PointerEvent, MouseEvent, RefObject } from 'react';
+import { takesOwnPress } from '../../../internal/controls';
+import { dataAttr } from '../../../internal/data-attr';
+import { ArrowIcon, ChevronIcon, CloseIcon, GroupIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import { isApplePlatform } from '../../../internal/platform';
+import { isComposing } from '../../../internal/roving';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+import { GROUP_CHIP_SELECTOR } from '../grid-dom';
+import { useDragMember } from '../hooks/use-drag-view';
+import type { DragViewStore } from '../hooks/use-drag-view';
+import type { GroupChip, GroupPanelControl } from '../hooks/use-group-panel';
+import type { DataGridLabels } from '../types';
+
+export interface GroupPanelProps {
+  /** The element of the tray, which a drag of a title or of a chip measures. */
+  panelRef: RefObject<HTMLDivElement | null>;
+  /** Told `true` when the tray is mounted and `false` when it goes: a toolbar may leave it out. */
+  onMounted: (mounted: boolean) => void;
+  chips: readonly GroupChip[];
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  /** What the buttons of the chips do: the same functions for as long as the grid lives. */
+  actions: Pick<GroupPanelControl, 'turn' | 'ungroup' | 'step'>;
+  /** The press on a chip that may become a drag (`useChipDrag`). */
+  onChipPointerDown: (event: PointerEvent<HTMLElement>, field: string) => void;
+  /** Where a drag of a title or a chip is over the tray, apart from what the rows read. */
+  view: DragViewStore;
+  /** Gives the focus to the active place of the grid, when no chip is left to take it. */
+  focusGrid: () => void;
+}
+
+type ButtonKind = 'direction' | 'remove';
+
+/** The focus a button of a chip is owed after the commit of what it did. */
+type Owed =
+  | { kind: 'stay'; field: string; button: ButtonKind }
+  | { kind: 'removed'; field: string; index: number };
+
+/**
+ * The group panel (spec phase 6 §3.8, §4.3 R1 "Thanh nhóm"): a tray in the toolbar, `role="group"` named
+ * by `labels.groupPanel`, with a chip for each level of the grouping in order and a chevron between two
+ * of them. A chip is its caption and two buttons, one that turns the direction of its level and one that
+ * takes it out; `mod+Shift+←` and `mod+Shift+→` on either moves the level. Empty, the tray has the icon
+ * and the hint. The buttons are stops of Tab of the toolbar, two for each chip.
+ *
+ * A title or a chip that is over it marks it: `data-drop-target` on the tray and `data-drop-before` on
+ * the chip the level would go before (`data-drop-end` for after the last), which the stylesheet draws
+ * the bar from. They come from the store of the drag, one value at a time, so a move of the pointer
+ * draws this only when it changes the slot. The chip that is dragged is dimmed from the same store.
+ *
+ * The focus is where the button was: after a move by the keys the same button of the same chip, which
+ * an engine may drop when React moves the chip's node; after a removal the same button of the chip that
+ * is now in its place, else of the one before, else the grid's active place. Written in the commit of
+ * what the button did, and only when it did it.
+ */
+export const GroupPanel = memo(function GroupPanel({
+  panelRef,
+  onMounted,
+  chips,
+  labels,
+  actions,
+  onChipPointerDown,
+  view,
+  focusGrid,
+}: GroupPanelProps) {
+  const over = useDragMember(view, 'target') === 'tray';
+  const slot = useDragMember(view, 'slot');
+  const dragged = useDragMember(view, 'chip');
+  const owed = useRef<Owed | null>(null);
+
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    onMounted(true);
+    return () => onMounted(false);
+  }, [onMounted]);
+
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const due = owed.current;
+    owed.current = null;
+    const panel = panelRef.current;
+    if (!due || !panel) return;
+    const buttons = (field: string) =>
+      Array.from(panel.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(GROUP_CHIP_SELECTOR))
+        .find((chip) => chip.dataset.field === field)
+        ?.querySelectorAll<HTMLButtonElement>('button');
+    if (due.kind === 'stay') {
+      const [direction, remove] = buttons(due.field) ?? [];
+      const button = due.button === 'direction' ? direction : remove;
+      if (button && document.activeElement !== button) button.focus();
+      return;
+    }
+    // A removal that the parent did not keep leaves the chip, and the focus where it is.
+    if (chips.some((chip) => chip.field === due.field)) return;
+    const next = chips[due.index] ?? chips[due.index - 1];
+    const [, remove] = (next ? buttons(next.field) : undefined) ?? [];
+    if (remove) remove.focus();
+    else focusGrid();
+  });
+
+  const onKeyDown = (
+    event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLButtonElement>,
+    chip: GroupChip,
+    button: ButtonKind,
+  ) => {
+    if (event.defaultPrevented || isComposing(event)) return;
+    if (event.key !== 'ArrowLeft' && event.key !== 'ArrowRight') return;
+    const apple = isApplePlatform();
+    const mod = apple ? event.metaKey && !event.ctrlKey : event.ctrlKey && !event.metaKey;
+    if (!mod || !event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
+    // Cancelled at an edge too, where it moves nothing: the browser does not scroll or select with it.
+    event.preventDefault();
+    if (actions.step(chip.field, event.key === 'ArrowLeft' ? -1 : 1)) {
+      owed.current = { kind: 'stay', field: chip.field, button };
+    }
+  };
+
+  // The `mousedown` of a press that may become a drag is cancelled, so that no text is selected as the
+  // pointer goes; a press on a button is the button's.
+  const onMouseDown = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
+    if (event.button === 0 && !takesOwnPress(event)) event.preventDefault();
+  };
+
+  const empty = chips.length === 0;
+  return (
+    <div
+      ref={panelRef}
+      role="group"
+      aria-label={labels.groupPanel}
+      className="flg-data-grid-group-panel"
+      data-empty={dataAttr(empty)}
+      data-drop-target={dataAttr(over)}
+      data-drop-end={dataAttr(over && slot !== null && slot >= chips.length)}
+    >
+      {empty ? (
+        <>
+          <GroupIcon width={15} height={15} />
+          <span className="flg-data-grid-group-hint">{labels.groupPanelHint}</span>
+        </>
+      ) : (
+        <>
+          <span className="flg-data-grid-group-label">{labels.groupBy}</span>
+          {chips.map((chip, at) => {
+            const next = chip.direction === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc';
+            return (
+              <Fragment key={chip.field}>
+                {at > 0 ? (
+                  <span className="flg-data-grid-group-separator" aria-hidden="true">
+                    <ChevronIcon direction="right" />
+                  </span>
+                ) : null}
+                {/* The press handlers only drag the chip, a pointer gesture with a keyboard counterpart
+                    in its two buttons (`mod+Shift+←` and `mod+Shift+→`); the chip is no control. */}
+                {/* eslint-disable-next-line jsx-a11y/no-static-element-interactions */}
+                <span
+                  className="flg-data-grid-group-chip"
+                  data-field={chip.field}
+                  data-drag-source={dataAttr(dragged === chip.field)}
+                  data-drop-before={dataAttr(over && slot === at)}
+                  onPointerDown={(event) => onChipPointerDown(event, chip.field)}
+                  onMouseDown={onMouseDown}
+                >
+                  {chip.caption}
+                  <button
+                    type="button"
+                    className="flg-data-grid-chip-button"
+                    aria-label={labels.groupDirection(chip.caption, next)}
+                    onClick={() => actions.turn(chip.field)}
+                    onKeyDown={(event) => onKeyDown(event, chip, 'direction')}
+                  >
+                    <ArrowIcon direction={chip.direction === 'asc' ? 'up' : 'down'} />
+                  </button>
+                  <button
+                    type="button"
+                    className="flg-data-grid-chip-button"
+                    aria-label={labels.ungroup(chip.caption)}
+                    onClick={() => {
+                      owed.current = { kind: 'removed', field: chip.field, index: at };
+                      actions.ungroup(chip.field);
+                    }}
+                    onKeyDown={(event) => onKeyDown(event, chip, 'remove')}
+                  >
+                    <CloseIcon />
+                  </button>
+                </span>
+              </Fragment>
+            );
+          })}
+        </>
+      )}
+    </div>
+  );
+});

+  .flg-data-grid-group-chip {
+    position: relative;
+    display: inline-flex;

+    margin-left: 3px;

+// The footer is a memo component as well: a memo of its own that counts, drawing again exactly when the

+vi.mock('./parts/SummaryFooter', async (importOriginal) => {

+  const { createElement, memo } = await import('react');
+  return {
+    ...real,
+    SummaryFooter: memo((props: Parameters<typeof real.SummaryFooter>[0]) => {
+      footerRenders.footer += 1;
+      return createElement(real.SummaryFooter, props as never);
+    }),
+  };
+});

+describe('the totals', () => {
+  const FEW = ORDERS.slice(0, 12);
+  const FOOTER = { total: [{ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' as const }] };
+  const GROUPED = { ...FOOTER, group: [{ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' as const }] };
+  const BY_NAME = [{ field: 'customer', direction: 'asc' as const }];
+  const reset = () => {
+    renders.cell = 0;
+    renders.headerCell = 0;
+    renders.toolbar = 0;
+    renders.body = 0;
+    groupRenders.groupRow = 0;
+    footerRenders.footer = 0;
+  };
+  const totals = (props: Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof DataGrid<Order>>> = {}) => (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={FEW}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      summary={FOOTER}
+      paging={{ pageSize: 5 }}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+
+  it('draws no footer and no group row for a change of page: the totals are those of every page', () => {
+    render(totals());
+    expect(footerRenders.footer).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    reset();
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Next page' }));
+    expect(footerRenders.footer).toBe(0);
+    expect(groupRenders.groupRow).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws the footer once for a filter that changes what it adds up, and no title', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(totals());
+    reset();
+    rerender(totals({ filter: { columns: { qty: { operator: '>', value: 6 } } } }));
+    expect(footerRenders.footer).toBe(1);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws nothing again for a summary written inline that says what it said before', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      totals({ grouping: BY_NAME, summary: { ...GROUPED, group: [...GROUPED.group] } }),
+    );
+    reset();
+    rerender(
+      totals({
+        grouping: [...BY_NAME],
+        summary: { total: [{ ...FOOTER.total[0]! }], group: [{ ...GROUPED.group[0]! }] },
+      }),
+    );
+    expect(footerRenders.footer).toBe(0);
+    expect(groupRenders.groupRow).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders).toMatchObject({ headerCell: 0, cell: 0 });
+  });
+
+  it('draws no footer for a choice: only the row that is chosen', () => {
+    render(totals({ selectionMode: 'multiple' }));
+    reset();
+    fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByRole('checkbox', { name: /^Select DH-/ })[0]!);
+    expect(footerRenders.footer).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws the group row that is toggled, with its totals, and not the footer', () => {
+    render(totals({ grouping: BY_NAME, summary: GROUPED, paging: false }));
+    const first = document.querySelector('tr.flg-data-grid-group-row')!;
+    reset();
+    fireEvent.click(first);
+    expect(groupRenders.groupRow).toBe(1);
+    expect(footerRenders.footer).toBe(0);
+  });
+});
+
 describe('the group panel', () => {

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.summary.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.summary.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..0aab61c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.summary.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,740 @@
+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type {
+  DataGridColumn,
+  DataGridGroupItem,
+  DataGridProps,
+  DataGridSummaryProp,
+} from './index';
+
+// The totals (spec phase 6 §3.5 steps 6-7, §3.6 "Hàng tổng là một hàng của grid", §4.3 R1 "Hàng nhóm" and
+// "Tổng cuối bảng", §5, §6.3 "Tổng"): the totals on the group rows, the footer, what it adds up (every
+// row after the filter, of every page, the closed groups' too), how each total is written, server mode, the
+// warnings, and the footer as a row of the keyboard. What needs a layout engine (a footer that sticks, the
+// rows kept clear of it, pinned cells over scrolled ones) is proven in the stories.
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  status: string;
+  assignee: string | null;
+  qty: number;
+  price: number;
+}
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', status: 'Delivered', assignee: 'An', qty: 5, price: 10 },
+  { id: 'DH-2', status: 'Delivered', assignee: 'Bình', qty: 3, price: 20.5 },
+  { id: 'DH-3', status: 'Processing', assignee: 'An', qty: 2, price: 5 },
+  { id: 'DH-4', status: 'Processing', assignee: null, qty: 4, price: 8.25 },
+  { id: 'DH-5', status: 'Processing', assignee: 'Bình', qty: 1, price: 2 },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 104 },
+  { field: 'status', caption: 'Status', width: 120 },
+  { field: 'assignee', caption: 'Assignee', width: 120 },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+  {
+    field: 'price',
+    caption: 'Price',
+    dataType: 'number',
+    width: 100,
+    format: { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' },
+  },
+];
+
+const BY_STATUS: DataGridGroupItem[] = [{ field: 'status', direction: 'asc' }];
+
+// What R1 asks for: a count under the first column, the sum under Qty, the sum of the prices.
+const FOOTER: DataGridSummaryProp<Order> = {
+  total: [
+    { column: 'id', type: 'count', label: 'Orders' },
+    { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+    { column: 'price', type: 'sum' },
+  ],
+};
+const GROUPS: DataGridSummaryProp<Order> = {
+  group: [
+    { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+    { column: 'price', type: 'sum' },
+  ],
+};
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const table = () => document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role]')!;
+const footer = () => table().tFoot;
+const footRow = () => footer()?.rows[0] ?? null;
+const footCells = () =>
+  Array.from(footRow()?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-foot-cell') ?? []);
+const footText = () => footCells().map((cell) => cell.textContent);
+const groupRows = () =>
+  Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-group-row'));
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row'));
+const group = (text: string) => groupRows().find((row) => row.textContent?.includes(text))!;
+const cellsText = (row: HTMLTableRowElement) => Array.from(row.cells, (cell) => cell.textContent);
+const stops = () => Array.from(table().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[tabindex="0"]'));
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+const press = (element: HTMLElement, pressed: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, {
+    key: pressed,
+    bubbles: true,
+    cancelable: true,
+    ...init,
+  });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+
+describe('the totals of a group row', () => {
+  it('writes each total under its column: the label muted, the value, and nothing in the other cells', () => {
+    render(<Orders grouping={BY_STATUS} summary={GROUPS} />);
+    const row = group('Delivered');
+    // The chevron; the caption over Order and Assignee, up to the first total; Qty; Price; the filler.
+    expect(cellsText(row)).toEqual(['', 'Status: Delivered (2)', 'Total: 8', 'Total: $30.50', '']);
+    expect(row.cells[1]).toHaveAttribute('colspan', '2');
+    const [qty] = row.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-summary-cell');
+    expect(qty!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-summary-label')).toHaveTextContent('Total:');
+    expect(qty!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-summary-value')).toHaveTextContent('8');
+    expect(qty).toHaveAttribute('data-align', 'end');
+    expect(cellsText(group('Processing'))).toEqual([
+      '',
+      'Status: Processing (3)',
+      'Total: 7',
+      'Total: $15.25',
+      '',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('says the word of each type, or the label of the item, and writes the value as the item says', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        grouping={BY_STATUS}
+        summary={{
+          group: [
+            { column: 'qty', type: 'avg' },
+            { column: 'price', type: 'max' },
+            { column: 'assignee', field: 'qty', type: 'count', label: 'Rows' },
+            {
+              column: 'qty',
+              type: 'min',
+              label: 'Least',
+              format: (value) => `${String(value)} pcs`,
+            },
+          ],
+        }}
+      />,
+    );
+    // The first total is under Assignee, which is where the caption stops; Qty has two, in the order given.
+    expect(cellsText(group('Delivered'))).toEqual([
+      '',
+      'Status: Delivered (2)',
+      'Rows: 2',
+      'Average: 4 Least: 3 pcs',
+      'Max: $20.50',
+      '',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('writes a total of the first data column in the caption, after the count', () => {
+    render(<Orders grouping={BY_STATUS} summary={{ group: [{ column: 'id', type: 'count' }] }} />);
+    expect(cellsText(group('Delivered'))).toEqual(['', 'Status: Delivered (2) Count: 2', '']);
+    expect(group('Delivered').cells[1]).toHaveAttribute('colspan', '1');
+  });
+
+  it('is the total of the rows of each group, nested ones included, and of a blank group too', () => {
+    const levels: DataGridGroupItem[] = [
+      { field: 'status', direction: 'asc' },
+      { field: 'assignee', direction: 'asc' },
+    ];
+    render(<Orders grouping={levels} summary={GROUPS} />);
+    const rows = groupRows().map((row) => row.textContent);
+    expect(rows).toEqual([
+      expect.stringContaining('Status: Delivered (2)Total: 8Total: $30.50'),
+      expect.stringContaining('Assignee: An (1)Total: 5Total: $10.00'),
+      expect.stringContaining('Assignee: Bình (1)Total: 3Total: $20.50'),
+      expect.stringContaining('Status: Processing (3)Total: 7Total: $15.25'),
+      expect.stringContaining('Assignee: An (1)Total: 2Total: $5.00'),
+      expect.stringContaining('Assignee: Bình (1)Total: 1Total: $2.00'),
+      expect.stringContaining('Assignee: (Blanks) (1)Total: 4Total: $8.25'),
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('stops the caption at the end of the left zone and pins it there, the band going on in a cell', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        grouping={BY_STATUS}
+        summary={GROUPS}
+        columns={COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+          column.field === 'id' ? { ...column, pinned: 'left' } : column,
+        )}
+      />,
+    );
+    const row = group('Delivered');
+    expect(cellsText(row)).toEqual([
+      '',
+      'Status: Delivered (2)',
+      '',
+      'Total: 8',
+      'Total: $30.50',
+      '',
+    ]);
+    expect(row.cells[1]).toHaveAttribute('data-pinned', 'left');
+    // The empty cell across the Assignee column is one band cell, not pinned.
+    expect(row.cells[2]).not.toHaveAttribute('data-pinned');
+    expect(row.cells[2]).toHaveAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
+  });
+
+  it('leaves out the total of a column that is grouped by or hidden: it has no cell', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders grouping={BY_STATUS} summary={{ group: [{ column: 'status', type: 'count' }] }} />,
+    );
+    expect(cellsText(group('Delivered'))).toEqual(['', 'Status: Delivered (2)']);
+  });
+
+  it('follows the filter and the search: the totals are those of the rows that are kept', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders grouping={BY_STATUS} summary={GROUPS} />);
+    rerender(
+      <Orders
+        grouping={BY_STATUS}
+        summary={GROUPS}
+        filter={{ columns: { assignee: { operator: '=', value: 'An' } } }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(cellsText(group('Delivered'))).toContain('Total: 5');
+    expect(cellsText(group('Processing'))).toContain('Total: 2');
+  });
+
+  it('is drawn when the group is closed, and its row of totals is the same as open', () => {
+    render(<Orders grouping={BY_STATUS} summary={GROUPS} autoExpandAll={false} />);
+    expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(cellsText(group('Delivered'))).toContain('Total: 8');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the footer', () => {
+  it("is Table's footer with one row of the totals, each under its column", () => {
+    render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} />);
+    expect(footer()).toHaveClass('flg-table-footer');
+    expect(footRow()).toHaveClass('flg-table-row', 'flg-data-grid-summary-row');
+    // R1: "Orders: 12" under Order, the sum under Qty (no label), the sum under Price.
+    expect(footText()).toEqual(['Orders: 5', '', '', 'Total of Qty 15', 'Total of Price $45.75']);
+    expect(footCells()[0]!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-summary-label')).toHaveTextContent(
+      'Orders:',
+    );
+    expect(footCells()[3]!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-summary-label')).toBeNull();
+    expect(footCells()[3]!.querySelector('.flg-visually-hidden')).toHaveTextContent('Total of Qty');
+    expect(footCells()[3]!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-summary-value')).toHaveTextContent('15');
+    expect(footCells()[3]).toHaveAttribute('data-align', 'end');
+  });
+
+  it('labels a total whose type is not a sum, and a function type has only its column as hidden words', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        summary={{
+          total: [
+            { column: 'qty', type: 'avg' },
+            { column: 'price', type: 'max' },
+            { column: 'id', type: (rows) => `${rows.length} rows` },
+          ],
+        }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(footText()).toEqual(['Order 5 rows', '', '', 'Average: 3', 'Max: $20.50']);
+    expect(footCells()[0]!.querySelector('.flg-visually-hidden')).toHaveTextContent('Order');
+    expect(footCells()[0]!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-summary-label')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('adds up every row after the filter, of every page', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} paging={{ pageSize: 2 }} />);
+    // Two rows are on the page; the footer is about all five.
+    expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(footText()[0]).toBe('Orders: 5');
+    expect(footText()[3]).toContain('15');
+    rerender(
+      <Orders
+        summary={FOOTER}
+        filter={{ columns: { status: { operator: '=', value: 'Delivered' } } }}
+        paging={{ pageSize: 2 }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(footText()).toEqual(['Orders: 2', '', '', 'Total of Qty 8', 'Total of Price $30.50']);
+  });
+
+  it('adds up the rows of closed groups, which are not on the page', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        summary={FOOTER}
+        grouping={BY_STATUS}
+        autoExpandAll={false}
+        paging={{ pageSize: 2 }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(groupRows()).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(footText()[0]).toBe('Orders: 5');
+    expect(footText()[2]).toContain('15');
+  });
+
+  it('adds up the search too, and the rows of a grid with a grouping the same as without one', () => {
+    render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} grouping={BY_STATUS} filter={{ search: 'Bình' }} />);
+    // Status is grouped by, so it has no column: Qty is the third.
+    expect(footText()[0]).toBe('Orders: 2');
+    expect(footText()[2]).toContain('4');
+  });
+
+  it('stays when the filter keeps no row, and goes only while the first rows load', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      <Orders
+        summary={FOOTER}
+        filter={{ columns: { status: { operator: '=', value: 'Nothing' } } }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(dataRows()).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(footText()).toEqual(['Orders: 0', '', '', 'Total of Qty 0', 'Total of Price $0.00']);
+    rerender(<Orders summary={FOOTER} data={[]} loading />);
+    expect(table().tFoot).toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders summary={FOOTER} data={[]} loading={false} />);
+    expect(footer()).not.toBeNull();
+    // With rows the footer stays while they reload.
+    rerender(<Orders summary={FOOTER} loading />);
+    expect(footer()).not.toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it("is not drawn without items of the footer, and is the group totals' alone with items of the groups", () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders />);
+    expect(footer()).toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders summary={GROUPS} />);
+    expect(footer()).toBeNull();
+    rerender(<Orders summary={{ total: [] }} />);
+    expect(footer()).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('spans the group indents with one empty cell, and has a cell for the box column', () => {
+    render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} grouping={BY_STATUS} selectionMode="multiple" />);
+    const indent = footRow()!.querySelector('.flg-data-grid-indent')!;
+    expect(indent).toHaveAttribute('colspan', '1');
+    expect(indent).not.toHaveAttribute('tabindex');
+    // The box column's cell is a place of the keyboard, and empty.
+    expect(footCells()).toHaveLength(5);
+    expect(footCells()[0]).toHaveTextContent('');
+    expect(footCells()[1]).toHaveTextContent('Orders: 5');
+  });
+
+  it('writes a total in the locale of the grid', () => {
+    render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} locale="vi-VN" />);
+    expect(footText()[3]).toContain('15');
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        summary={{
+          total: [{ column: 'price', type: 'sum', format: { minimumFractionDigits: 3 } }],
+        }}
+        locale="vi-VN"
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(
+      Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-summary-value')).at(-1),
+    ).toHaveTextContent('45,750');
+  });
+
+  it('writes a total of a column whose format is a function by the format of the item, else the locale', () => {
+    const columns: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+      column.field === 'price'
+        ? { ...column, format: (value: unknown) => `<${String(value)}>` }
+        : column,
+    );
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      <Orders columns={columns} summary={{ total: [{ column: 'price', type: 'sum' }] }} />,
+    );
+    expect(footCells()[4]).toHaveTextContent('45.75');
+    rerender(
+      <Orders
+        columns={columns}
+        summary={{
+          total: [{ column: 'price', type: 'sum', format: (value) => `= ${String(value)}` }],
+        }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(footCells()[4]).toHaveTextContent('= 45.75');
+    // The least or greatest is the text of the row that holds it, which the column's function writes.
+    rerender(<Orders columns={columns} summary={{ total: [{ column: 'price', type: 'max' }] }} />);
+    expect(footCells()[4]).toHaveTextContent('Max: <20.5>');
+  });
+
+  it('has the words of the labels the caller gives, merged by type', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        summary={{
+          total: [
+            { column: 'qty', type: 'avg' },
+            { column: 'price', type: 'sum', label: 'Sum' },
+          ],
+        }}
+        labels={{
+          summary: { avg: 'Mean' },
+          summaryLabel: (label) => `${label} =`,

+      />,

+    expect(footText().slice(3)).toEqual(['Mean = 3', 'Sum = $45.75']);

+
+  it('says the hidden words of a sum from labels.summaryOf and labels.summary', () => {
+    render(

+
+  it('draws the sum of a summary that changes, and not a total of the rows that were', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} />);
+    expect(footText()[3]).toContain('15');

+    rerender(<Orders summary={FOOTER} locale="de-DE" />);
+    expect(footText()[4]).toContain('45,75');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the items', () => {
+  it('keeps the first of two items with one id and warns once, for the footer and for the groups', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        grouping={BY_STATUS}
+        summary={{

+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(dataRows()[0]!.cells[0]);
+    focusOn(dataRows()[1]!.cells[2]!);

+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(lastRow().cells[2]);

+
+  it('does nothing on Enter and F2, and cancels Space', () => {
+    const onRowActivate = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} onRowActivate={onRowActivate} selectionMode="multiple" />);
+    focusOn(lastRow().cells[2]!);
+    press(lastRow().cells[2]!, 'ArrowDown');
+    const cell = footCells()[2]!;
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(cell);
+    expect(press(cell, 'Enter')).toBe(false);
+    expect(press(cell, 'F2')).toBe(false);
+    expect(press(cell, ' ')).toBe(true);
+    expect(onRowActivate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(cell);
+    expect(screen.queryAllByRole('checkbox', { checked: true })).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('is a place of the pointer too: a press on a cell of it makes it the active one', () => {
+    render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} />);
+    focusOn(footCells()[3]!);
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([footCells()[3]]);
+    fireEvent.mouseDown(footCells()[1]!);
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([footCells()[1]]);
+  });
+
+  it('is no place when the grid has no row: the empty cell stays the one place of the body', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        summary={FOOTER}
+        filter={{ columns: { status: { operator: '=', value: 'Nothing' } } }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(footCells().every((cell) => cell.tabIndex === -1)).toBe(true);
+    const title = table().querySelector<HTMLElement>('thead th[tabindex]')!;
+    focusOn(title);
+    press(title, 'ArrowDown');
+    expect(document.activeElement?.closest('tfoot')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('gives the place back to the last row when the footer goes, and keeps it in the footer across a filter', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} />);
+    focusOn(lastRow().cells[3]!);
+    press(lastRow().cells[3]!, 'ArrowDown');
+    rerender(
+      <Orders
+        summary={FOOTER}
+        filter={{ columns: { status: { operator: '=', value: 'Delivered' } } }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([footCells()[3]]);
+    rerender(<Orders summary={undefined} />);
+    expect(footer()).toBeNull();
+    expect(stops()).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(stops()[0]!.closest('tbody')).not.toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('is reached from a group row by ArrowDown from the last row of the list', () => {
+    render(<Orders summary={FOOTER} grouping={BY_STATUS} autoExpandAll={false} />);
+    const last = groupRows().at(-1)!;
+    focusOn(last);
+    press(last, 'ArrowDown');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(footCells()[0]);
+    press(footCells()[0]!, 'ArrowUp');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(last);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the rows of a virtual grid', () => {
+  it('counts the footer in aria-rowcount and gives it the last aria-rowindex', () => {
+    vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'clientHeight', 'get').mockImplementation(function (
+      this: HTMLElement,
+    ) {
+      return this.classList.contains('flg-table-frame') ? 300 : 0;
+    });
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      <Orders summary={FOOTER} scrolling="virtual" height={300} paging={false} />,
+    );
+    // The heading's row and five of data, and the footer: seven.
+    expect(table()).toHaveAttribute('aria-rowcount', '7');
+    expect(footRow()).toHaveAttribute('aria-rowindex', '7');
+    rerender(<Orders scrolling="virtual" height={300} />);
+    expect(table()).toHaveAttribute('aria-rowcount', '6');
+  });
+
+  it('has no aria-rowcount or aria-rowindex in a grid that draws every row', () => {

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGridGrouping.stories.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGridGrouping.stories.tsx
index e9ca742..1fb4686 100644
--- a/src/components/data-grid/DataGridGrouping.stories.tsx
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGridGrouping.stories.tsx
@@ -1132,3 +1132,235 @@ export const ChipDragTouch: Story = {
     touch(document, 'pointerup');
   },
 };
+
+/** The totals of R1's footer: a count under Order, the sum of the quantities and of the totals. */
+const FOOTER_TOTALS: NonNullable<DataGridProps<R1Order>['summary']> = {
+  total: [
+    { column: 'id', type: 'count', label: 'Orders' },
+    { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+    { column: 'total', type: 'sum' },
+  ],
+};
+
+/** R1's columns with Order pinned to the left and Total to the right, so a frame scrolled sideways has both zones. */
+const PINNED_COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<R1Order>[] = R1_COLUMNS.map((column) =>
+  column.field === 'id'
+    ? { ...column, pinned: 'left' as const }
+    : column.field === 'total'
+      ? { ...column, pinned: 'right' as const }
+      : column,
+);
+
+const TotalsGrid = (props: Partial<DataGridProps<R1Order>>) => (
+  <div style={{ width: 640, marginBottom: 24 }}>
+    <DataGrid
+      aria-label="Orders"
+      data={R1_ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={PINNED_COLUMNS}
+      paging={false}
+      height={240}
+      summary={FOOTER_TOTALS}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  </div>
+);
+
+/** The bottom of what a frame shows: its box without the border and the scrollbar. */
+const frameBottom = (frame: HTMLElement) => {
+  const box = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
+  return box.top + frame.clientTop + frame.clientHeight;
+};
+
+/** The alpha of a computed colour: `rgb()` has none (opaque), `rgba()` and `color()` say it. */
+const alphaOf = (color: string) => {
+  const match = /(?:rgba|color)\(.*\/\s*([\d.]+)\)|rgba\([^)]*,\s*([\d.]+)\)/.exec(color);
+  return match ? Number(match[1] ?? match[2]) : 1;
+};
+
+/**
+ * The sticky footer of totals (spec phase 6 §3.6, §3.7 "Dính", §4.3 R1 "Tổng cuối bảng"), in a grid with a
+ * height in each variant, with Order pinned left and Total pinned right: the footer's bottom is the bottom
+ * of the frame at rest and while the rows are scrolled (it is at `bottom: 0`, `-6px` where the frame has
+ * padding); its cells are solid, and the pinned ones stay at their edges when the frame is scrolled
+ * sideways; the grid measures the footer (`--flg-data-grid-foot-height`). With real keys: a cell scrolled
+ * into view by the keys stops above the footer, and ↓ from the last row lands on the footer and ↑ goes
+ * back. A scroll is made by setting the frame's `scrollTop` and `scrollLeft`.
+ */
+export const StickyTotals: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  beforeEach: onPlatform('other'),
+  render: () => (
+    <>
+      <TotalsGrid aria-label="Lined" variant="lined" />
+      <TotalsGrid aria-label="Striped" variant="striped" />
+      <TotalsGrid aria-label="Minimal" variant="minimal" />
+    </>
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    const roots = Array.from(canvasElement.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid'));
+    await expect(roots).toHaveLength(3);
+    for (const root of roots) {
+      const variant = root.dataset.variant!;
+      const frame = root.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-frame')!;
+      const foot = tableOf(root).tFoot!;
+      await expect(foot, `${variant}: the footer is drawn`).not.toBeNull();
+      await waitFor(
+        () =>
+          expect(
+            Number.parseFloat(frame.style.getPropertyValue('--flg-data-grid-foot-height')),
+            `${variant}: the footer is measured`,
+          ).toBeGreaterThan(20),
+        RENDER_UPDATE,
+      );
+      await expect(frame.scrollHeight).toBeGreaterThan(frame.clientHeight + 40);
+      const place = () => Math.abs(foot.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - frameBottom(frame));
+      await expect(place(), `${variant}: at rest the footer is at the bottom`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(
+        1,
+      );
+      frame.scrollTop = 60;
+      await waitFor(() => expect(frame.scrollTop).toBeGreaterThan(0), SCROLL_EVENT);
+      await nextFrame();
+      await expect(place(), `${variant}: scrolled, it stays at the bottom`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
+      // No row is seen through it: its cells are painted over a solid colour.
+      for (const cell of foot.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-foot-cell')) {
+        await expect(
+          alphaOf(getComputedStyle(cell).backgroundColor),
+          `${variant}: the footer cell is solid`,
+        ).toBe(1);
+      }
+      // Scrolled sideways, the pinned cells stay where they stick.
+      frame.scrollLeft = 200;
+      await waitFor(() => expect(frame.scrollLeft).toBeGreaterThan(100), SCROLL_EVENT);
+      await nextFrame();
+      const left = foot.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-pinned="left"]')!;
+      const right = foot.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-pinned="right"]')!;
+      const area = frame.getBoundingClientRect();
+      near(
+        left.getBoundingClientRect().left,
+        area.left + frame.clientLeft,
+        1.5,
+        `${variant}: the left cell`,
+      );
+      near(
+        right.getBoundingClientRect().right,
+        area.left + frame.clientLeft + frame.clientWidth,
+        1.5,
+        `${variant}: the right cell`,
+      );
+      await expect(alphaOf(getComputedStyle(left).backgroundColor)).toBe(1);
+      await expect(alphaOf(getComputedStyle(right).backgroundColor)).toBe(1);
+      await expect(place(), `${variant}: sideways it is at the bottom`).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
+      frame.scrollLeft = 0;
+      frame.scrollTop = 0;
+      await nextFrame();
+    }
+
+    if (!real) return;
+    // The keys of the first grid: the last cell of the last row is scrolled into view above the footer.
+    const frame = roots[0]!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-frame')!;
+    const table = tableOf(roots[0]!);
+    const foot = table.tFoot!;
+    const first = table.tBodies[0]!.rows[0]!.cells[0]!;
+    first.focus();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(first).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.keyboard('{Control>}{End}{/Control}');
+    const lastRow = table.tBodies[0]!.rows[table.tBodies[0]!.rows.length - 1]!;
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(document.activeElement!.closest('tr'), 'the last row has the focus').toBe(lastRow),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(
+          document.activeElement!.getBoundingClientRect().bottom,
+          'the cell stops above the footer',
+        ).toBeLessThanOrEqual(foot.getBoundingClientRect().top + 1),
+      SCROLL_EVENT,
+    );
+    const last = document.activeElement as HTMLTableCellElement;
+    const index = Array.from(lastRow.cells).indexOf(last);
+    // ArrowDown lands on the footer in the same column, ArrowDown again stays, ArrowUp goes back.
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowDown}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(document.activeElement, 'the footer has the focus').toBe(foot.rows[0]!.cells[index]),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowDown}');
+    await nextFrame();
+    await expect(document.activeElement).toBe(foot.rows[0]!.cells[index]);
+    await expect(frame.scrollTop).toBeGreaterThan(0);
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowUp}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () => expect(document.activeElement, 'back on the last row').toBe(last),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+  },
+};
+
+/**
+ * The footer in a virtual grid (spec phase 6 §3.6 "aria-rowcount"): ten thousand orders, so `aria-rowcount`
+ * is the heading, every row and the footer (10002), the footer says the last `aria-rowindex`, and mod+End
+ * scrolls to the last row, which is drawn above the footer and not under it; the footer is reached by ↓ and
+ * ↑ goes back to a row that is drawn.
+ */
+export const StickyTotalsVirtual: Story = {
+  tags: ['no-visual'],
+  beforeEach: onPlatform('other'),
+  render: () => (
+    <TotalsGrid data={BIG_ORDERS} scrolling="virtual" height={300} columns={R1_COLUMNS} />
+  ),
+  play: async ({ canvasElement }) => {
+    const root = canvasElement.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid')!;
+    const table = tableOf(root);
+    const frame = table.parentElement!;
+    const foot = table.tFoot!;
+    await expect(table).toHaveAttribute('aria-rowcount', '10002');
+    await expect(foot.rows[0]).toHaveAttribute('aria-rowindex', '10002');
+    const real = await realUserEvent();
+    if (!real) return;
+    const first = table.tBodies[0]!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('tr.flg-data-grid-row > *')!;
+    first.focus();
+    await waitFor(() => expect(first).toHaveFocus(), RENDER_UPDATE);
+    await real.keyboard('{Control>}{End}{/Control}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(document.activeElement!.closest('tr'), 'the last row').toHaveAttribute(
+          'aria-rowindex',
+          '10001',
+        ),
+      SCROLL_EVENT,
+    );
+    const last = document.activeElement as HTMLElement;
+    await waitFor(() => {
+      const box = last.getBoundingClientRect();
+      expect(box.bottom, 'the last row is above the footer').toBeLessThanOrEqual(
+        foot.getBoundingClientRect().top + 1,
+      );
+      expect(box.top, 'and under the heading').toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(
+        table.tHead!.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - 1,
+      );
+    }, SCROLL_EVENT);
+    await expect(
+      Math.abs(foot.getBoundingClientRect().bottom - frameBottom(frame)),
+    ).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowDown}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(document.activeElement?.closest('tfoot'), 'the footer has the focus').not.toBeNull(),
+      RENDER_UPDATE,
+    );
+    await real.keyboard('{ArrowUp}');
+    await waitFor(
+      () =>
+        expect(document.activeElement!.closest('tr'), 'back on the last row').toHaveAttribute(
+          'aria-rowindex',
+          '10001',
+        ),
+      SCROLL_EVENT,
+    );
+  },
+};

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-foot-height.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-foot-height.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..27f709f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-foot-height.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,123 @@
+import { act, render } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { DataGrid } from '../DataGrid';
+import type { DataGridProps } from '../index';
+import { FOOT_HEIGHT_PROPERTY } from './use-foot-height';
+
+// The height of the sticky footer is measured for a grid that has a height and a footer, and only then:
+// the rows keep clear of the footer by the property it writes on the frame (`scroll-margin-bottom`).
+
+interface Row {
+  id: string;
+  qty: number;
+}
+const DATA: Row[] = [
+  { id: 'a', qty: 1 },
+  { id: 'b', qty: 2 },
+];
+
+const observers: {
+  callback: ResizeObserverCallback;
+  observed: Element[];
+  disconnected: boolean;
+}[] = [];
+class FakeObserver {
+  private readonly entry: (typeof observers)[number];
+  constructor(callback: ResizeObserverCallback) {
+    this.entry = { callback, observed: [], disconnected: false };
+    observers.push(this.entry);
+  }
+  observe(element: Element) {
+    this.entry.observed.push(element);
+  }
+  unobserve(element: Element) {
+    this.entry.observed = this.entry.observed.filter((other) => other !== element);
+  }
+  disconnect() {
+    this.entry.disconnected = true;
+  }
+}
+
+afterEach(() => {
+  observers.length = 0;
+  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+});
+
+function Orders(props: Partial<DataGridProps<Row>>) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      data={DATA}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={[
+        { field: 'id', caption: 'Id', width: 80 },
+        { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+      ]}
+      caption="Rows"
+      paging={false}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const SUMMARY = { total: [{ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' as const }] };
+const frame = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-frame')!;
+const property = () => frame().style.getPropertyValue(FOOT_HEIGHT_PROPERTY);
+// The observers that watch a footer: the ones the grid made for its height, which watch the table.
+const watchingFooter = () =>
+  observers.filter((entry) => entry.observed.some((element) => element.tagName === 'TFOOT'));
+
+describe('useFootHeight', () => {
+  it('writes the height of the footer on the frame for a grid with a height and a footer', () => {
+    vi.stubGlobal('ResizeObserver', FakeObserver);
+    vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'offsetHeight', 'get').mockImplementation(function (
+      this: HTMLElement,
+    ) {
+      return this.tagName === 'TFOOT' ? 37 : 0;
+    });
+    render(<Orders height={300} summary={SUMMARY} />);
+    expect(property()).toBe('37px');
+    expect(watchingFooter()).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('follows the footer when it changes size, and takes it off when the footer goes', () => {
+    vi.stubGlobal('ResizeObserver', FakeObserver);
+    let height = 37;
+    vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'offsetHeight', 'get').mockImplementation(function (
+      this: HTMLElement,
+    ) {
+      return this.tagName === 'TFOOT' ? height : 0;
+    });
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders height={300} summary={SUMMARY} />);
+    height = 45;
+    act(() => {
+      for (const entry of watchingFooter()) entry.callback([], {} as ResizeObserver);
+    });
+    expect(property()).toBe('45px');
+    rerender(<Orders height={300} />);
+    expect(property()).toBe('');
+    expect(watchingFooter().every((entry) => entry.disconnected)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('writes nothing, and observes no footer, for a grid with no height', () => {
+    vi.stubGlobal('ResizeObserver', FakeObserver);
+    render(<Orders summary={SUMMARY} />);
+    expect(property()).toBe('');
+    expect(watchingFooter()).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('writes nothing, and observes no footer, for a grid with a height and no footer', () => {
+    vi.stubGlobal('ResizeObserver', FakeObserver);
+    render(<Orders height={300} />);
+    expect(property()).toBe('');
+    expect(watchingFooter()).toHaveLength(0);
+    // The group totals have no footer either.
+    render(<Orders height={300} summary={{ group: [{ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' }] }} />);
+    expect(watchingFooter()).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('leaves the property to the stylesheet where nothing observes, as in jsdom', () => {
+    render(<Orders height={300} summary={SUMMARY} />);
+    expect(property()).toBe('');
+  });
+});
```

````diff
diff --git a/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md
index 3a724d4..c28c756 100644
--- a/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md
+++ b/docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md
@@ -276,6 +276,7 @@ Chủ dự án chọn một phương án cho mỗi câu, nên `Kbd`, `DialogCont
 **Mô hình focus** (mẫu data grid của APG):
 
 - **Một điểm Tab.** Đúng một phần tử trong bảng có `tabindex="0"`: ô đang hoạt động (hay hàng nhóm đang hoạt động, hay control duy nhất của ô, bên dưới); mọi ô khác và mọi control trong ô `tabindex="-1"`. Thanh công cụ, thanh lưu, thanh bộ lọc và thanh phân trang là các điểm Tab riêng trước và sau bảng. Khung cuộn mang `tabindex="-1"` cố định (không bao giờ đổi, không có `role`): Firefox đưa một phần tử cuộn được vào thứ tự Tab nếu nó không có `tabindex`, kể cả khi trong nó đã có ô là điểm Tab; `-1` giữ khung ngoài thứ tự Tab mà vẫn không bị gỡ khi đang giữ focus (phát hiện khi lập Plan B). Control trong ô tuỳ biến (`cell`) được grid đặt `tabindex="-1"` sau mỗi lần commit, nhớ giá trị cũ của từng cái và trả đúng giá trị đó khi grid biến mất; nút sắp xếp ở tiêu đề cũng vậy (phát hiện khi lập Plan B). Control mà ô tự thêm khi render riêng (không có commit nào của grid: link đến sau một lần tải, `Suspense` xong) cũng được đặt `-1`, qua một `MutationObserver` (`childList`, `subtree`) trên `<tbody>`, chỉ có khi grid có cột `cell` và gỡ khi không còn; observer đó cũng nghe `attributes` (`attributeFilter`: `disabled`, `tabindex`, `href`, `contenteditable`, `hidden`, `inert`), nên control mà ô làm thành điểm Tab bằng một thuộc tính (nút ô tự bật sau một lần tải, link có `href`, `tabindex` roving mà ô tự chuyển) cũng được đặt `-1`; observer chỉ xem các ô của bảng mà bản ghi nằm trong và các dòng được thêm vào (cửa sổ dời, dòng đến), không đi lại cả `<tbody>` (vòng sửa thứ hai); bản ghi của chính các lần ghi của grid được lấy đi bằng `takeRecords()` ngay sau khi ghi (lần ghi là đồng bộ, nên không lấy mất gì khác), nên observer không đọc chúng và không chạy lại; một `tabindex` ô ghi sau grid là của ô: giá trị từ 0 trở lên được lấy lại cùng giá trị mới để trả, giá trị âm ở nguyên và không được trả khi grid biến mất (phát hiện khi review PR #42); control nằm trong popup của ô (`[popover]`, `dialog`) giữ nguyên `tabindex` của nó, vì popup là chỗ riêng như với phím và lần nhấn; cả hai qua một hook `use-release-controls.ts` mà nút ở tiêu đề của C và trình sửa của F dùng lại (phát hiện khi review cuối Plan B).
+- **Hàng tổng là một hàng của grid** (phát hiện khi lập Plan E, Claude chốt OQ 4 (a)): ô của nó là ô lưới (`td.flg-table-cell.flg-data-grid-foot-cell`, `tabindex` 0/-1, `data-align` và thuộc tính ghim của cột, key React là id cột; cột ô chọn có một ô trống, các cột thụt của nhóm gộp thành một `td.flg-data-grid-indent` trống như ô tiêu đề của chúng, chỗ của cột đệm như ở các hàng khác). Chỗ của nó là chỗ ngay sau dòng cuối của danh sách (`rows.length`), `ActiveCell` có `{ area: 'footer'; column }`: `↓` từ dòng cuối xuống hàng tổng, ở cột chỗ đang nhớ, `↑` quay lại dòng cuối, `←`/`→`/`Home`/`End` đi dọc hàng, `mod+End` và `PageDown` dừng ở dòng cuối của thân (không vào hàng tổng), `Enter`, `F2` không làm gì và `Space` bị huỷ; grid không có dòng nào thì hàng tổng không phải chỗ (ô trống của Plan D vẫn là chỗ duy nhất của thân), và một chỗ ở hàng tổng khi hàng tổng mất thì về dòng cuối. Chuột bấm vào ô của nó thì ô ấy thành ô đang chọn. Hàng tổng không bao giờ bị bỏ vì bộ lọc (review PR #44: một bộ phận dính không đến rồi đi theo bộ lọc); nó chỉ vắng khi các dòng đầu đang tải (dòng khung xương).
 - **Hàng lọc là một hàng của grid** (phát hiện khi lập Plan D): ô của nó là ô lưới (`td.flg-table-cell.flg-data-grid-filter-cell`, `tabindex` 0/-1, `data-align` và thuộc tính ghim của cột, key React là id cột; cột ô chọn có ô dịch vụ `data-service` không nội dung, cột không lọc (`allowFiltering` tắt) có ô trống, chỗ của cột đệm như ở hàng tiêu đề). Chỗ của bàn phím đếm các hàng tiêu đề từ thân bảng lên: -1 là hàng tiêu đề cuối (hàng lọc nếu có, không thì hàng tiêu đề), -2 là hàng tiêu đề khi có hàng lọc (`isTitlePlace`, `isFilterPlace` của `grid-dom.ts`; mọi chỗ trước đây hỏi "đang ở tiêu đề" bằng `row < 0` nay hỏi hai hàm này, và `titleRow(table)` là `<tr>` tiêu đề trong DOM, luôn là hàng đầu của `<thead>`). `ActiveCell.area` thêm `'filter'`: tắt `filterRow` khi chỗ đang ở hàng lọc thì chỗ là tiêu đề của cột đó (focus theo sang đó nếu đang trong grid), bật `filterRow` thì chỗ ở tiêu đề vẫn ở tiêu đề. `↑` từ dòng đầu lên hàng lọc rồi hàng tiêu đề, `↓` ngược lại; `Home`/`End` trong hàng; ô lọc giữ focus (không bao giờ control của nó: `Select` sẽ nhận `↓`); `Enter` và `F2` vào control giá trị (input hoặc trigger của Select, không phải nút toán tử), `Tab` đi vòng các control của ô, `Esc`/`F2` về ô; gõ một ký tự in được trên ô không làm gì (không có "gõ để lọc" ở Plan D); phím của cột (đổi cỡ, di chuyển, menu cột, `Enter` sắp xếp) chỉ ở hàng tiêu đề, còn `Space` trên ô lọc bị huỷ như trên tiêu đề. `aria-rowindex`: tiêu đề 1, hàng lọc 2, dòng đầu 3 (`firstRowIndex(headRows)`), `aria-rowcount` = số hàng tiêu đề + số dòng.
 - **Vị trí hoạt động** lưu bằng (khoá dòng hoặc khoá nhóm, id cột), không bằng chỉ số DOM, nên sắp xếp, lọc, cuộn ảo không làm mất chỗ. Lúc đầu: ô đầu của dòng thân đầu tiên (không có dòng: ô tiêu đề đầu). Dòng hoạt động biến mất (lọc, xoá) thì vị trí chuyển sang dòng cùng chỉ số (kẹp lại), và nếu focus đang ở trong grid thì focus theo sang đó ("trong grid" là trong DOM của bảng: sự kiện focus của một portal mà ô mở, như popover của thư viện ngoài, đi qua bảng trong cây React nhưng không tính, nên focus trong portal không bị kéo về ô hoạt động khi grid render lại; phát hiện khi review cuối Plan B). Vị trí cũng nhớ chỉ số dòng lần cuối thấy nó; dòng ở chỉ số đó còn mang khoá ấy thì chính nó là dòng hoạt động, không thì là dòng đầu tiên mang khoá, nên hai dòng cùng khoá (grid cảnh báo) không làm phím bị khoá ở dòng thứ hai (phát hiện khi review PR #42). Vị trí cũng nhớ chỉ số cột lần cuối thấy nó: cột hoạt động biến mất (ẩn, gỡ) thì vị trí chuyển sang cột đang ở chỉ số đó (kẹp lại), như với dòng, thay vì về cột đầu tiên; cột chỉ đổi chỗ thì vị trí đi theo id của nó (phát hiện khi lập Plan C). Grid trống do lọc (G1 "Trống") có nút "Clear filter" trong ô trải mọi cột: lúc đó ô trống là một ô của grid, là vị trí duy nhất của thân bảng, nút là "nhà" của nó (`data-home="control"`, như ô chọn là nhà của ô ở cột chọn dòng); không dòng nào thì vị trí lúc đầu là nút, ↓ từ hàng tiêu đề cuối tới nút (giữ cột đang đứng), ↑ về tiêu đề của cột đó, ←, →, Home, End, ↓ đứng yên, Enter và Space bấm nút, bấm vào ô là đặt vị trí ở đó; đúng một `tabindex="0"` trong bảng. Bấm nút thì bộ lọc xoá, các dòng trở lại và vị trí là ô đầu của dòng đầu, focus theo sang nếu đang ở nút (phát hiện khi lập Plan D). Grid trống không do lọc (`labels.noData`) không đổi: không nút, ô tiêu đề là vị trí.

-- **Không bị header dính che** (WCAG 2.4.11): mỗi dòng và mỗi ô của `<tbody>` của chính grid (chọn bằng bước con từ khung xuống bảng của grid, nên `Table` hay grid nằm trong ô giữ quy tắc của nó; và chỉ ở grid có `height`, mà khung mang `data-height`: không có `height` thì trang cuộn, không gì dính trên các dòng, và trang đưa một dòng lên sát mép trên; vòng sửa thứ hai của review PR #42) có `scroll-margin-top` bằng chiều cao đo được của `<thead>` (dùng lại `useHeadHeight` của Table; `--flg-table-head-height` của khung), và khung của grid đặt `scroll-padding-top: 0` thay cho `scroll-padding-top` của `Table` (phát hiện khi review PR #42, xem dưới); `scroll-padding-bottom` bằng chiều cao `<tfoot>` (E; tiêu đề dưới dính cũng nằm trong phần đệm này, nên E làm như trên: `scroll-margin-bottom` trên dòng), không có `scroll-padding-left`/`-right` (phát hiện khi lập Plan C: `Table` cũng không đặt; Plan C làm như trục dọc dưới đây: các ô **không ghim** của `<thead>` và `<tbody>` của chính grid, chọn bằng bước con từ khung xuống, mang `scroll-margin-left` và `scroll-margin-right` bằng `--flg-data-grid-pinned-left` và `--flg-data-grid-pinned-right`, bề rộng hai vùng ghim mà `GridTable` ghi trên `<table>` và `.flg-data-grid-table` khai báo `0px`; ô ghim không có `scroll-margin`: xem "Cột ghim" ở §3.7). Di chuyển bằng phím gọi `focus({ preventScroll: true })` rồi `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' })` của **ô** (cả khi control trong ô giữ focus), cái tôn trọng `scroll-margin` của ô và `scroll-padding` của khung. Cuộn ảo: cuộn tới độ lệch tính được, render, rồi focus. **Đi trên tiêu đề không cuộn khung theo chiều dọc** (phát hiện khi review PR #42): tiêu đề dính ở đầu khung, trong `scroll-padding-top` của `Table`, và Chromium với WebKit coi phần đệm đó là phần che nó, nên đo bằng story `TitlesKeepScroll` (khung cuộn ở 400px, focus ở tiêu đề): mỗi phím `←`/`→` cuộn các dòng lên đúng chiều cao tiêu đề (368, 336), `Tab` từ ngoài quay lại tiêu đề cuộn 129px (focus của chính trình duyệt, `preventScroll` không với tới: Chromium cuộn trước sự kiện focus, WebKit sau một hay nhiều khung hình), `focus()` của handle cuộn thêm 32px; Firefox không cuộn. Vì vậy phần chừa cho tiêu đề chuyển từ khung sang các dòng (như trên): với ô thân, phép tính của `nearest`, `start`, `center` cho cùng vị trí như phần đệm cũ, nên mọi cuộn tới ô thân và các ảnh chuẩn không đổi; ô tiêu đề ở chỗ nó dính đã nằm trong tầm nhìn, nên không lối nào (phím, `Tab`, `focus()`) cuộn dọc. `scroll-margin` âm trên ô tiêu đề cũng chạy ở cả ba engine nhưng dời hộp của tiêu đề cả với trang, nên tiêu đề ở trên mép cửa sổ sẽ bị cuộn ra ngoài, và việc hoàn lại lần cuộn của trình duyệt sau sự kiện focus thì không chắc (WebKit cuộn muộn hơn ba khung hình khi máy bận), nên không dùng. Ô tiêu đề cũng đi qua cùng `scrollIntoView({ block: 'nearest', inline: 'nearest' })` như ô thân: khung không cuộn dọc vì tiêu đề dính đã ở trong tầm nhìn của khung, khung cuộn ngang theo `nearest`, và trang quanh grid đưa tiêu đề vào cửa sổ khi trang đã cuộn qua nó (có `height` hay không); một bản trước dùng `scrollLeft` tính tay cho tiêu đề (`scrollHeadIntoView`), nên tiêu đề tới bằng phím hay `focus()` có thể nằm ngoài cửa sổ, và đã bỏ (vòng sửa thứ hai của review PR #42).

+## Totals
+
+`summary` asks for totals. `summary.total` is the footer of the grid and `summary.group` is the
+totals on the group rows. Each item names the column it is shown under (`column`), and what it adds
+up (`type`):
+
+- `'count'` is the number of rows, always a whole number.
+- `'sum'` and `'avg'` read the finite numbers of the item's `field` (the column's own when
+  `field` is left out) and skip the rest. The sum of nothing is 0, the average of nothing is blank.
+- `'min'` and `'max'` read the numbers, dates and datetimes of `field` and are blank for a column
+  of any other type. They are written as the cell of the row that holds the value is written.
+- A function of the rows is called once for the rows and its result is shown, written as a string.
+
+`label` says the words before the value; without it the grid says its own word for the type
+(`labels.summary`: Count, Total, Average, Min, Max), so a group row says "Total: 65.720.000 ₫".
+`format` writes the value, as Intl number options or as a function; without it a `sum` or an `avg`
+is written as the column writes a number (its Intl options, else the `locale`). A function needs a
+row and a total has none, so a total of a column whose `format` is a function is written by the
+item's own `format`, else by the locale: give the item a `format`. Items of one column come in the
+order given, and an item that names no column, or a column that is not shown, draws nothing (the
+first warns once). Of two items with one `id` (the id they have, else `type:field`) the first stays
+and the grid warns once.
+
+```tsx
+const summary = {
+  total: [
+    { column: 'id', type: 'count', label: 'Orders' },
+    { column: 'qty', type: 'sum' },
+    { column: 'total', type: 'sum' },
+  ],
+  group: [{ column: 'total', type: 'sum' }],
+} satisfies DataGridSummaryProp<Order>;
+
+<DataGrid data={orders} rowKey="id" columns={columns} caption="Orders" summary={summary} />;
+```
+
+**On a group row** the caption goes on up to the column before the first one that has a total, and
+never past the end of the left zone, where it stops and is pinned with the zone; the band goes on in
+an empty cell. Then each column has a cell of its own, with its total or empty, pinned as its column
+and aligned as its column. A total of a column the caption covers (the first data column) is written
+in the caption, after the count. A total is its label, muted and regular, and its value, semibold,
+and does not wrap.
+
+**The footer** is Table's footer of the variant, one row under the body, and is drawn whenever
+`summary.total` has an item: it stays while a filter leaves no row, and is left out only while the
+first rows load. It adds up every row after the search and the filter, of every page and of the
+groups that are closed. Its cells do not wrap. A total with a `label`, or one that is not a `sum`,
+says its label and the value ("Orders: 12"); a `sum` with no label is the value alone, with the
+hidden words `labels.summaryOf` ("Total of Qty") before it so that it reads on its own, and so is a
+function with the caption of its column. With a `height` the footer sticks at the bottom of the
+frame, as the heading sticks at the top, over a solid colour, with its pinned cells solid too; the
+grid measures it, and every row and cell keeps that much scroll margin at the bottom, so what
+scrolls into view stops above it. Without a `height` the footer is Table's, at the end of the rows.
+
+The footer is a row of the keyboard, as the filter row is: each cell has `tabindex` (the box, the
+handle and the detail column have an empty one, the group indents one between them). <Kbd keys="down" /> from the last row of the list
+lands on it, in the column the place was in, and <Kbd keys="up" /> goes back to the last row;
+
+<Kbd keys="left" />, <Kbd keys="right" />, <Kbd keys="home" /> and <Kbd keys="end" /> go along it;
+<Kbd keys="mod+end" /> and <Kbd keys="pagedown" /> stop at the last row of the body, and
+<Kbd keys="enter" />, <Kbd keys="f2" /> and <Kbd keys="space" /> do nothing in it (Space is
+cancelled). A grid with no row has no footer place; the empty cell stays its one place.
+
+**Server mode.** The grid does not total the page. The footer writes `totalSummary[id]`, the value
+the server computed for each item, by the item's `id`; an id with no value of its own (an id
+`constructor` holds nothing inherited) is blank. Each value is written by the item's `format`,
+else as the column writes it, a `count` as a whole number and a function's as a string.
+

-| Prop                     | Type                                        | Default      | Does                                                                              |

-| `caption`                | `ReactNode`                                 |              | The title and the name                                                            |

-| `density`                | `'compact' \| 'standard' \| 'comfortable'`  | `'standard'` | The height of a row                                                               |
-| `rowHeight`              | `number`                                    |              | The height of a row in pixels, over the table's                                   |
