index 0000000..252024c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-foot-height.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,55 @@
+import type { RefObject } from 'react';
+import { useIsoLayoutEffect } from '../../../internal/use-iso-layout-effect';
+
+/** The custom property of the frame that holds the height of the sticky footer. */
+export const FOOT_HEIGHT_PROPERTY = '--flg-data-grid-foot-height';
+
+/**
+ * Hands the measured height of the `<tfoot>` of a grid that scrolls its rows (a grid with a `height`) to
+ * its frame, as a custom property the stylesheet takes the `scroll-margin-bottom` of the rows from, so a
+ * row or a cell scrolled into view stops above the footer that sticks over the bottom of the frame, as
+ * `useHeadHeight` does for the heading (the footer is as tall as what is in it, and no estimate follows it). The
+ * property is set on the element and not through React, so a draw of the grid has nothing to reconcile.
+ * Nothing is measured, and nothing is written, unless the grid has a height and a footer (`active`); the
+ * stylesheet declares the property as `0px` on the frame, which is what a grid without one reads. Where
+ * there is no ResizeObserver, as in jsdom, nothing is written.
+ */
+export function useFootHeight(
+  frameRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>,
+  tableRef: RefObject<HTMLTableElement | null>,
+  active: boolean,
+): void {
+  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
+    const frame = frameRef.current;
+    const table = tableRef.current;
+    if (!active || !frame || !table || typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return undefined;
+    let foot: HTMLTableSectionElement | null = null;
+    const measure = (entries: ResizeObserverEntry[] = []) => {
+      // The footer comes and goes while the table is on screen (the first rows load), so it is looked up
+      // each time.
+      let changed = false;
+      if (table.tFoot !== foot) {
+        if (foot) observer.unobserve(foot);
+        foot = table.tFoot;
+        if (foot) observer.observe(foot);
+        changed = true;
+      }
+      if (!foot) {
+        frame.style.removeProperty(FOOT_HEIGHT_PROPERTY);
+        return;
+      }
+      // The layout size the observer reports keeps fractions and does not follow a transform.
+      const entry = entries.find((candidate) => candidate.target === foot);
+      if (!entry && !changed && entries.length > 0) return;
+      const height = entry?.borderBoxSize?.[0]?.blockSize ?? foot.offsetHeight;
+      frame.style.setProperty(FOOT_HEIGHT_PROPERTY, `${height}px`);
+    };
+    const observer = new ResizeObserver(measure);
+    observer.observe(table);
+    measure();
+    return () => {
+      observer.disconnect();
+      frame.style.removeProperty(FOOT_HEIGHT_PROPERTY);
+    };
+  }, [frameRef, tableRef, active]);
+}

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/SummaryFooter.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SummaryFooter.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2e738a3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SummaryFooter.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+import { memo } from 'react';
+import type { ReactElement } from 'react';
+import { isPlaceColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import { remoteSummaryText, summaryText } from '../engine/summary';
+import type { ResolvedSummaryItem, SummaryValues as Totals } from '../engine/summary';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { placeFiller } from './FillerCell';
+import { pinAttributes } from './pin-attributes';
+import { SummaryValues } from './SummaryValue';
+
+interface SummaryFooterProps<TRow> {
+  /** The totals of the footer, resolved: the grid keeps them while the `summary` prop says the same. */
+  items: readonly ResolvedSummaryItem<TRow>[];
+  /** The totals of every row after the filter; `null` in server mode. */
+  totals: Totals<TRow> | null;
+  /** Server mode: what the server computed, by the id of each item. */
+  remoteValues: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined;
+  /** The column of the active cell when it is in the footer, else -1: a prop, as for a row. */
+  activeColumn: number;
+  /** The place of the row for a screen reader, in a virtual grid, where the rows are not all drawn. */
+  ariaRowIndex: number | undefined;
+}
+
+function SummaryFooterImpl<TRow>({
+  items,
+  totals,
+  remoteValues,
+  activeColumn,
+  ariaRowIndex,
+}: SummaryFooterProps<TRow>) {
+  const { layoutColumns, layoutPins, filler, fillerAt, labels, locale, summaryReader } =
+    useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const indents = layoutColumns.filter((column) => !isPlaceColumn(column)).length;
+  const textOf = (item: ResolvedSummaryItem<TRow>): string =>
+    remoteValues
+      ? remoteSummaryText(
+          item,
+          Object.hasOwn(remoteValues, item.id) ? remoteValues[item.id] : undefined,
+          locale,
+        )
+      : summaryText(item, totals?.get(item.id), { locale, read: summaryReader });
+
+  // The columns the keyboard visits have a cell each, the group indents one between them (as the
+  // heading has), and the filler column its own where the row says it goes.
+  let place = -1;
+  const cells: ReactElement[] = [];
+  layoutColumns.forEach((column, index) => {
+    if (!isPlaceColumn(column)) {
+      if (column.id === layoutColumns.find((other) => !isPlaceColumn(other))!.id) {
+        cells.push(
+          <td
+            key="flg:indents"
+            colSpan={indents}
+            className="flg-table-cell flg-data-grid-indent"
+            aria-hidden="true"
+            {...pinAttributes(layoutPins[index])}
+          />,
+        );
+      }
+      return;
+    }
+    place++;
+    const here = items
+      .filter((item) => item.column === column.id)
+      .map((item) => ({ item, text: textOf(item) }));
+    cells.push(
+      <td
+        key={column.id}
+        className="flg-table-cell flg-data-grid-foot-cell"
+        data-align={column.align}
+        tabIndex={place === activeColumn ? 0 : -1}
+        {...pinAttributes(layoutPins[index])}
+      >
+        {here.length > 0 ? (
+          <SummaryValues items={here} column={column} labels={labels} footer />
+        ) : null}
+      </td>,
+    );
+  });
+  return (
+    <tfoot className="flg-table-footer">
+      <tr className="flg-table-row flg-data-grid-summary-row" aria-rowindex={ariaRowIndex}>
+        {placeFiller(cells, indents > 0 ? fillerAt - (indents - 1) : fillerAt, filler)}
+      </tr>
+    </tfoot>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The footer (spec phase 6 §4.3 R1 "Tổng cuối bảng"): one row of totals under the body, Table's footer
+ * of the variant, that sticks at the bottom of a grid with a height. It is a row of the keyboard (its
+ * cells have `tabindex`, one of them the Tab stop when the active place is here). Memoized: it draws
+ * again when its totals, its items or the active column change, or something the whole grid shares.
+ */
+export const SummaryFooter = memo(SummaryFooterImpl) as typeof SummaryFooterImpl;
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/SummaryValue.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SummaryValue.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6dc6931
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/SummaryValue.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+import { Fragment } from 'react';
+import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
+import type { ResolvedColumn } from '../engine/columns';
+import type { ResolvedSummaryItem } from '../engine/summary';
+import type { DataGridLabels } from '../types';
+
+/**
+ * The words a total has before its value, `undefined` where it has none. A group row labels every item
+ * (`label`, else the word of the type); the footer only an item with a `label` or one that is not a
+ * `sum` (R1: "Orders: 12", and the sum alone); a function type has no word of its own.
+ */
+export function summaryLabelOf<TRow>(
+  item: ResolvedSummaryItem<TRow>,
+  labels: DataGridLabels,
+  footer: boolean,
+): string | undefined {
+  if (item.label !== undefined) return item.label;
+  if (typeof item.type === 'function' || (footer && item.type === 'sum')) return undefined;
+  return labels.summary[item.type];
+}
+
+interface SummaryValuesProps<TRow> {
+  /** The items of one column, in order, with the text of each: an item whose text is empty draws nothing. */
+  items: readonly { item: ResolvedSummaryItem<TRow>; text: string }[];
+  /** The column the totals stand under: its caption is what an item with no label says it is the total of. */
+  column: ResolvedColumn<TRow>;
+  labels: DataGridLabels;
+  /** Whether this is the footer, which leaves the label of a `sum` out. */
+  footer: boolean;
+}
+
+/**
+ * The totals of one column as they are written in a cell: for each item the label
+ * (`flg-data-grid-summary-label`) and a space, then the value (`flg-data-grid-summary-value`); an item
+ * with no label has hidden words in front of its value instead, "Total of Amount", so that it reads
+ * alone. The items are in the order they were given, a space between two. Returns `null` when no item
+ * has a text.
+ */
+export function SummaryValues<TRow>({ items, column, labels, footer }: SummaryValuesProps<TRow>) {
+  const written = items.filter(({ text }) => text !== '');
+  if (written.length === 0) return null;
+  const nodes: ReactNode[] = written.map(({ item, text }, at) => {
+    const label = summaryLabelOf(item, labels, footer);
+    // A function type has no word of its own: the column's caption says what it is the total of.
+    const hidden =
+      typeof item.type === 'function'
+        ? column.caption
+        : labels.summaryOf(labels.summary[item.type], column.caption);
+    return (
+      <Fragment key={item.id}>
+        {at > 0 ? ' ' : null}
+        {label === undefined ? (
+          <span className="flg-visually-hidden">{hidden} </span>
+        ) : (
+          <>
+            <span className="flg-data-grid-summary-label">{labels.summaryLabel(label)}</span>{' '}
+          </>
+        )}
+        <span className="flg-data-grid-summary-value">{text}</span>
+      </Fragment>
+    );
+  });
+  return <>{nodes}</>;
+}

### Task 7: master-detail và story `GridGroups` của R1

Spec §3.6 "Master-detail", "Ô chỉ có một control đơn giản" (nút), "Ô có nhiều control" (ô chi tiết), "Sự kiện không phải của grid"; §3.7 "Dòng có chiều cao thay đổi", "Nội dung trải cả hàng"; §4.3 R1 "Cột phục vụ", "Nút mở chi tiết", "Dòng chi tiết"; §4.4 "Không đo"; §4.5 (nút `ButtonText`); §5 (cảnh báo `scrolling="virtual"` với `renderDetail`); §6.3 `renderDetail`, `rowHasDetail`, `expandedRows`, `defaultExpandedRows`, `onExpandedRowsChange`, "Master-detail", nhãn `showDetails`, `hideDetails`; §7 story `GridGroups`, lớp 3. Mockup R1 crop 1 đủ mặt: thanh công cụ với hai chip, hàng nhóm, DH-1028 và DH-1024 với nút của chúng (của DH-1024 mở, nền track), chi tiết của DH-1024 (dòng hàng trong một `Table` `lined` `sm`, khách hàng với điện thoại và địa chỉ), tổng và hàng tổng.
- **Bộ ba `expandedRows`**, cột `flg:detail` 40px và nút của nó, dòng chi tiết với một ô lưới trải phần còn lại, id từ `useId` và số đếm (phát hiện 15).
- **Phím** của nút và của dòng chi tiết; observer nhả control theo dõi thân khi có `renderDetail`; cuộn ảo tắt và cảnh báo; không `ExpandedRowsContext`.
- **Quy tắc giữ `Table` trong chi tiết trơn** (tiêu đề không dính, không đặc).
- **Story giao diện `GridGroups`** (R1 crop 1, `rowHeight={33}`, hàng tổng 162.010.000 ₫; phát hiện 16); story `no-visual` `DetailRowKeys`, `DetailScrolled`; phần "Master-detail" của `DataGrid.mdx`. Spec §3.6, §4.3, §5, §6.3 được sửa (phát hiện 25).

**Files:**
- Create: `src/components/data-grid/parts/DetailRow.tsx`, `parts/DetailToggle.tsx`, `hooks/use-detail-ids.ts`, `DataGrid.detail.test.tsx`
- Modify: `src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.tsx`, `types.ts`, `labels.ts`, `normalize.ts`, `grid-context.ts`, `grid-dom.ts`, `grid-dom.test.ts`, `engine/columns.ts`, `engine/columns.test.ts`, `engine/selection.ts`, `engine/selection.test.ts`, `hooks/use-grid-columns.ts`, `hooks/use-grid-grouping.test.tsx`, `hooks/use-grid-keyboard.ts`, `hooks/use-grid-state.ts`, `hooks/use-grid-state.test.tsx`, `hooks/use-prop-warnings.ts`, `hooks/use-renewal-warning.ts`, `hooks/use-shown-state.ts`, `parts/Body.tsx`, `parts/Cell.tsx`, `parts/DataRow.tsx`, `parts/GroupRow.tsx`, `parts/HeaderRow.tsx`, `parts/IndentCells.tsx`, `parts/pin-attributes.ts`, `DataGrid.mdx`, `DataGrid.test.tsx`, `DataGrid.test-d.ts`, `DataGrid.renders.test.tsx`, `DataGrid.stories.tsx`, `DataGridGrouping.stories.tsx`; `src/styles/components/data-grid.css`, `src/styles/preferences.css`; `scripts/check-dist-css.ts`; `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-13-h2d-glass-ui-phase-6-design.md`

+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [

+  { field: 'status', caption: 'Status', width: 120 },

+];
+
+const BY_STATUS: DataGridGroupItem[] = [{ field: 'status', direction: 'asc' }];

+const renderDetail = (row: Order): ReactNode => <span>{`Lines of ${row.id}`}</span>;

+  return (

+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      renderDetail={renderDetail}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const table = () => document.querySelector<HTMLTableElement>('table[role]')!;
+const detailRows = () =>

+const dataRows = () =>

+const toggle = (name: string) =>

+const press = (element: HTMLElement, pressed: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {

+    bubbles: true,

+    render(
+      <Orders
+        onExpandedRowsChange={(keys) => calls.push(`rows ${keys.join(',')}`)}
+        onStateChange={(state, part) => calls.push(`state ${part} ${state.expandedRows.join(',')}`)}
+      />,
+    );
+    click(toggle('DH-1'));
+    click(toggle('DH-3'));
+    click(toggle('DH-1'));
+    expect(calls).toEqual([
+      'rows DH-1',
+      'state expandedRows DH-1',
+      'rows DH-1,DH-3',
+      'state expandedRows DH-1,DH-3',
+      'rows DH-3',
+      'state expandedRows DH-3',
+    ]);
+  });
+
+  it('calls nothing from a render, nor for a value that comes from outside', () => {
+    const onChange = vi.fn();
+    const onState = vi.fn();
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      <Orders expandedRows={['DH-1']} onExpandedRowsChange={onChange} onStateChange={onState} />,
+    );
+    rerender(
+      <Orders
+        expandedRows={['DH-1', 'DH-2']}
+        onExpandedRowsChange={onChange}
+        onStateChange={onState}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(2);
+    expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(onState).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('leaves a controlled grid as the parent holds it, and sends the state it shows with the change on top', () => {
+    const onChange = vi.fn();
+    const onState = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Orders expandedRows={['DH-1']} onExpandedRowsChange={onChange} onStateChange={onState} />,
+    );
+    click(toggle('DH-2'));
+    expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledExactlyOnceWith(['DH-1', 'DH-2']);
+    const [state, part] = onState.mock.calls[0] as [DataGridState, string];
+    expect(part).toBe('expandedRows');
+    expect(state.expandedRows).toEqual(['DH-1', 'DH-2']);
+    // The parent kept its value: nothing changed on the screen.
+    expect(detailRows().map((row) => row.textContent)).toEqual(['Lines of DH-1']);
+  });
+
+  it('asks a controlled grid once for two presses of one event, the second against the first', () => {
+    const onChange = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders expandedRows={[]} onExpandedRowsChange={onChange} />);
+    const one = toggle('DH-1');
+    act(() => {
+      one.click();
+      one.click();
+    });
+    // The second press closes what the first asked for: the parent hears both, each against the one before.
+    expect(onChange.mock.calls).toEqual([[['DH-1']], [[]]]);
+  });
+
+  it('holds and returns the state as given: the keys of no row stay, in the order they were opened', () => {
+    const ref = createRef<DataGridHandle>();
+    render(<Orders gridRef={ref} defaultExpandedRows={['nobody', 'DH-3']} />);
+    click(toggle('DH-1'));
+    expect(ref.current?.getState().expandedRows).toEqual(['nobody', 'DH-3', 'DH-1']);
+    expect(detailRows().map((row) => row.textContent)).toEqual(['Lines of DH-1', 'Lines of DH-3']);
+  });
+
+  it('opens the detail of a row that comes later, for a key held by defaultExpandedRows', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(
+      <Orders data={ORDERS.slice(0, 1)} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-3']} />,
+    );
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(0);
+    rerender(<Orders data={ORDERS} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-3']} />);
+    expect(detailRows().map((row) => row.textContent)).toEqual(['Lines of DH-3']);
+  });
+
+  it('is a state change on a mounted grid: expandedRows from outside opens and closes', () => {
+    function Controlled() {
+      const [keys, setKeys] = useState<readonly DataGridKey[]>([]);
+      return (
+        <>
+          <button type="button" onClick={() => setKeys(['DH-2'])}>
+            open
+          </button>
+          <Orders expandedRows={keys} onExpandedRowsChange={setKeys} />
+        </>
+      );
+    }
+    render(<Controlled />);
+    click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'open' }));
+    expect(detailRows().map((row) => row.textContent)).toEqual(['Lines of DH-2']);
+    click(toggle('DH-2'));
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('says what a state that is no list of keys is, once, and shows none open', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
+    render(<Orders expandedRows={'DH-1' as never} />);
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(warn.mock.calls.some(([message]) => String(message).includes('expandedRows'))).toBe(
+      true,
+    );
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the heading, the filter row and the footer of a grid with details', () => {
+  it('has one title over the indents and the button, which is a place and holds the hidden words', () => {
+    render(<Orders grouping={BY_STATUS} />);
+    const head = table().tHead!.rows[0]!;
+    expect(head.cells).toHaveLength(4);
+    const merged = head.cells[0]!;
+    expect(merged).toHaveAttribute('colspan', '2');
+    expect(merged).toHaveTextContent('Groups and details');
+    expect(merged).toHaveAttribute('scope', 'col');
+    // A place of the keyboard: it is not an indent cell, which the keyboard skips.
+    expect(merged).not.toHaveClass('flg-data-grid-indent');
+    expect(merged).toHaveAttribute('tabindex');
+  });
+
+  it('has a title of its own for the button without a grouping', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const head = table().tHead!.rows[0]!;
+    expect(head.cells[0]).toHaveTextContent('Groups and details');
+    expect(head.cells[0]).not.toHaveAttribute('colspan', '2');
+  });
+
+  it('gives the filter row and the footer an empty cell for the button, a place of the keyboard', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        filterRow
+        summary={{ total: [{ column: 'qty', type: 'sum' }] }}
+        grouping={BY_STATUS}
+      />,
+    );
+    const filter = table().tHead!.rows[1]!;
+    // One indent cell, then the cell of the button, Order, Status and Qty.
+    expect(filter.cells[0]).toHaveClass('flg-data-grid-indent');
+    expect(filter.cells[1]).toHaveAttribute('data-service', 'detail');
+    const foot = table().tFoot!.rows[0]!;
+    expect(foot.cells[0]).toHaveClass('flg-data-grid-indent');
+    expect(foot.cells[1]).toHaveClass('flg-data-grid-foot-cell');
+    expect(foot.cells[1]!.textContent).toBe('');
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the keys of the button', () => {
+  it("is the cell's one control: the Tab stop while its cell is the active one, and the cell never is", () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    // The first cell of the first row is the active one at the start: the button of the first column.
+    const button = toggle('DH-1');
+    expect(button).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '0');
+    expect(toggle('DH-2')).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
+    expect(button.closest('td')).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([button]);
+    focusOn(toggle('DH-2'));
+    expect(toggle('DH-2')).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '0');
+    expect(button).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([toggle('DH-2')]);
+  });
+
+  it("Enter presses it, and Space is the button's: it chooses no row", () => {
+    render(<Orders selectionMode="multiple" />);
+    const button = toggle('DH-1');
+    focusOn(button);
+    expect(press(button, 'Enter')).toBe(true);
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(1);
+    // Space is not cancelled on the button (the browser presses it on keyup), and no row is chosen.
+    expect(press(button, ' ')).toBe(false);
+    expect(dataRows()[0]).not.toHaveAttribute('data-selected');
+    // On another cell of the row Space chooses the row, as it did.
+    const cell = dataRows()[0]!.querySelectorAll('td, th');
+    const order = Array.from(cell).find((c) => c.textContent === 'DH-1') as HTMLElement;
+    focusOn(order);
+    expect(press(order, ' ')).toBe(true);
+    expect(dataRows()[0]).toHaveAttribute('data-selected');
+  });
+
+  it('is pressed once by a click, and the press chooses nothing and activates nothing', () => {
+    const onActivate = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders selectionMode="single" onRowActivate={onActivate} />);
+    click(toggle('DH-2'));
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(dataRows()[1]).not.toHaveAttribute('data-selected');
+    fireEvent.doubleClick(toggle('DH-2'));
+    expect(onActivate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the focus on the button while it opens and closes the detail', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    const button = toggle('DH-1');
+    focusOn(button);
+    click(button);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(toggle('DH-1'));
+    expect(toggle('DH-1')).toBe(button);
+    click(button);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(button);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the detail row as a place of the keyboard', () => {
+  const link = (row: Order) => (
+    <p>
+      <a href="#x">{`Open ${row.id}`}</a> <button type="button">{`Print ${row.id}`}</button>
+    </p>
+  );
+  const detailCell = () =>
+    detailRows()[0]!.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-detail-cell')!;
+
+  it('is reached by ↓ from its master, at the column the place remembers, and ↑ goes back to it', () => {
+    render(<Orders renderDetail={link} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1']} />);
+    const status = dataRows()[0]!.cells[2]!;
+    focusOn(status);
+    expect(press(status, 'ArrowDown')).toBe(true);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(detailCell());
+    expect(detailCell()).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '0');
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([detailCell()]);
+    expect(press(detailCell(), 'ArrowDown')).toBe(true);
+    // The next row, in the column that was remembered through the detail.
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(dataRows()[1]!.cells[2]);
+    press(document.activeElement as HTMLElement, 'ArrowUp');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(detailCell());
+    press(detailCell(), 'ArrowUp');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(dataRows()[0]!.cells[2]);
+  });
+
+  it('cancels the keys that move along a row, and leaves the place where it is', () => {
+    render(<Orders renderDetail={link} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1']} />);
+    const status = dataRows()[0]!.cells[2]!;
+    focusOn(status);
+    press(status, 'ArrowDown');
+    for (const key of ['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'Home', 'End', ' ']) {
+      expect(press(detailCell(), key), key).toBe(true);
+      expect(document.activeElement, key).toBe(detailCell());
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('goes into its first control on Enter and F2, cycles its controls on Tab, and comes back on Esc and F2', () => {
+    render(<Orders renderDetail={link} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1']} />);
+    focusOn(detailCell());
+    const anchor = screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open DH-1' });
+    const print = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Print DH-1' });
+    expect(press(detailCell(), 'Enter')).toBe(true);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(anchor);
+    press(anchor, 'Tab');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(print);
+    press(print, 'Tab');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(anchor);
+    press(anchor, 'Tab', { shiftKey: true });
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(print);
+    press(print, 'Escape');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(detailCell());
+    press(detailCell(), 'F2');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(anchor);
+    press(anchor, 'F2');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(detailCell());
+  });
+
+  it('does nothing on Enter when it holds no control, and activates no row', () => {
+    const onActivate = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onRowActivate={onActivate} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1']} />);
+    focusOn(detailCell());
+    expect(press(detailCell(), 'Enter')).toBe(false);
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(detailCell());
+    expect(onActivate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("keeps the grid's one Tab stop: the controls of a detail are out of the Tab order", () => {
+    render(<Orders renderDetail={link} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1']} />);
+    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Open DH-1' })).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
+    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Print DH-1' })).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1');
+    expect(stops()).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('lets go of a control the detail draws on its own, after the grid has committed', async () => {
+    function Late(): ReactNode {
+      const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);
+      return (
+        <div>
+          <button type="button" onClick={() => setLoaded(true)}>
+            Load
+          </button>
+          {loaded ? <a href="#late">Late link</a> : null}
+        </div>
+      );
+    }
+    render(<Orders renderDetail={() => <Late />} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1']} />);
+    click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Load' }));
+    const late = await screen.findByRole('link', { name: 'Late link' });
+    // The observer of the bodies is on, as it is for a column that draws its own cells.
+    await vi.waitFor(() => expect(late).toHaveAttribute('tabindex', '-1'));
+    expect(stops()).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('gives the place to its master, at the same column, when its detail closes under the focus', () => {
+    function Holder() {
+      const [keys, setKeys] = useState<readonly DataGridKey[]>(['DH-1']);
+      return (
+        <>
+          <button type="button" onClick={() => setKeys([])}>
+            close
+          </button>
+          <Orders expandedRows={keys} onExpandedRowsChange={setKeys} />
+        </>
+      );
+    }
+    render(<Holder />);
+    const status = dataRows()[0]!.cells[2]!;
+    focusOn(status);
+    press(status, 'ArrowDown');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(detailCell());
+    click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'close' }));
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([dataRows()[0]!.cells[2]]);
+  });
+
+  it('is a press that makes it the place, with the column kept', () => {
+    render(<Orders defaultExpandedRows={['DH-2']} />);
+    const qty = dataRows()[0]!.cells[3]!;
+    focusOn(qty);
+    fireEvent.mouseDown(detailCell());
+    act(() => detailCell().focus());
+    expect(stops()).toEqual([detailCell()]);
+    press(detailCell(), 'ArrowUp');
+    expect(document.activeElement).toBe(dataRows()[1]!.cells[3]);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('scrolling, pages and server mode with details', () => {
+  it('scrolls as usual with scrolling="virtual", and says so once', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
+    render(<Orders scrolling="virtual" height={300} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1']} />);
+    expect(table().closest('[data-virtual]')).toBeNull();
+    expect(table().tBodies[0]!.querySelectorAll('.flg-data-grid-spacer')).toHaveLength(0);
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(1);
+    const said = warn.mock.calls.filter(([message]) => String(message).includes('renderDetail'));
+    expect(said).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(said[0]![0]).toContain('scrolling="virtual" with renderDetail');
+    expect(table()).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-rowcount');
+  });
+
+  it('keeps a detail with its master on a page, and counts it as no row', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders paging={{ pageSize: 2, pageSizes: [2] }} defaultExpandedRows={['DH-2', 'DH-3']} />,
+    );
+    expect(dataRows().map((row) => row.cells[1]!.textContent)).toEqual(['DH-1', 'DH-2']);
+    expect(detailRows().map((row) => row.textContent)).toEqual(['Lines of DH-2']);
+    expect(screen.getByText(/1.2 of 4|1–2 of 4/)).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('works on the page in server mode, with the keys the server rows have', () => {
+    render(
+      <Orders
+        remote
+        totalCount={40}
+        paging={{ pageSize: 4, pageSizes: [4] }}
+        defaultExpandedRows={['DH-2']}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(detailRows().map((row) => row.textContent)).toEqual(['Lines of DH-2']);
+    click(toggle('DH-1'));
+    expect(detailRows()).toHaveLength(2);
+  });
+});
+
+describe('what is said of the functions the grid reads for every row', () => {
+  const warnings = (warn: { mock: { calls: unknown[][] } }, word: string) =>
+    warn.mock.calls.filter(([message]) => String(message).includes(word)).length;
+
+  it('warns once when renderDetail is a new function on three commits running, and not for a stable one', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders renderDetail={(row) => <i>{row.id}</i>} />);
+    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) rerender(<Orders renderDetail={(row) => <i>{row.id}</i>} />);
+    expect(warnings(warn, 'renderDetail is a new function')).toBe(1);
+    warn.mockClear();
+    resetDevWarnings();
+    const stable = (row: Order) => <i>{row.id}</i>;
+    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) rerender(<Orders renderDetail={stable} />);
+    expect(warnings(warn, 'renderDetail is a new function')).toBe(0);
+  });
+
+  it('warns the same for rowHasDetail', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => undefined);
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders rowHasDetail={() => true} />);
+    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) rerender(<Orders rowHasDetail={() => true} />);
+    expect(warnings(warn, 'rowHasDetail is a new function')).toBe(1);
+  });
+});

Cột đang nhóm ẩn khỏi tiêu đề và thân (như DevExtreme, bản quyết định) trừ khi `showWhenGrouped`. Thứ tự nhóm theo `sortValue` của cột nếu có (điểm mở), không thì như sắp xếp của cột; rỗng là nhóm cuối "(Blanks)". Thông báo `labels.announceGrouped(caption)` / `announceUngrouped` / `announceGroupMoved(caption, level, count)`. Phát hiện khi lập Plan E: nút chiều không có thông báo (tên nút đổi thành chiều kế tiếp); sau khi bỏ nhóm, focus sang cùng nút của chip đang ở chỗ đó, không thì chip trước, không thì ô hoạt động của grid; thả tiêu đề không nhận (cột đã nhóm, cột hiện cuối cùng) không làm gì; kéo tiêu đề vào khay không có vạch thả ở tiêu đề và không tự cuộn khung; `groupPanel` ở chế độ server không vẽ khay và cảnh báo một lần.
 - **Mở/đóng:** `expandedGroups` = `{ allExpanded, except }` (khoá nhóm từ `groupKey`: chuỗi JSON của các bước `[field, value]`, `value` là khoá lọc; khoá không còn khớp nhóm nào thì bị bỏ qua, không cảnh báo) (phát hiện khi lập Plan E, theo OQ 3 (b)); `autoExpandAll` cho `allExpanded` ban đầu. Bấm hàng nhóm, `Enter`, `←`/`→` (§3.6). Không có thông báo live (§1).
 - **Tổng** (`summary`, bản quyết định): `total` ở `<tfoot>` dính dưới, tính trên mọi dòng sau lọc (§3.5 bước 7); `group` trên hàng nhóm, tính trên dòng của nhóm. `count` đếm dòng; `sum`, `avg`, `min`, `max` trên giá trị không rỗng của `field` (số; `min`/`max` cả ngày); hàm tuỳ biến nhận các dòng. Định dạng: `format` của mục, không thì `format` của cột (`count` luôn là số nguyên). Nhãn: `label`, không thì `labels.summary[type]` ("Count", "Total", "Average", "Min", "Max"), trừ `sum` ở `<tfoot>` (không nhãn, như R1). Ô tổng có chữ ẩn của cột khi không có nhãn ("Total of Amount") để đọc rời vẫn hiểu. Chế độ server: `totalSummary[id]` của app (đọc bằng `Object.hasOwn`: id `constructor` không lấy gì từ prototype; id không có giá trị thì trống), viết bằng `format` của mục, không thì như cột viết một giá trị không dòng nào giữ (`keyText`); tổng nhóm không có (`devWarn`: "<DataGrid> remote has no group totals; they are not shown."). Phát hiện khi lập Plan E: hai mục có cùng `id` (`id` đã cho, hay `${type}:${field}`) thì mục đầu giữ, mục sau bị bỏ có `devWarn` ("two summary items have the same id; the second is left out"), như hai cột cùng id, để không có hai ô và hai key React từ một id; tổng `sum`/`avg` của cột có `format` là hàm (hàm cần một dòng mà tổng không có) được viết bằng `format` của chính mục, không thì theo `locale` (tài liệu: "give the item a `format`"); `summary` được giữ theo giá trị (`useKept`, hàm so theo danh tính) và `summary` mà hàm mới mỗi lần commit ba lần liền thì cảnh báo ("pass a stable summary: a module constant or useMemo"); mục trỏ vào cột không có, hoặc cột đang ẩn hay đã nhóm, không vẽ gì (cột không có thì cảnh báo một lần); `aria-rowcount` đếm cả hàng tổng và nó có `aria-rowindex` cuối cùng.
-- **Master-detail** (bản quyết định): `renderDetail(row)` bật cột nút mở chi tiết (tên `labels.showDetails(name)` / `labels.hideDetails(name)`); `rowHasDetail(row)` để tắt cho từng dòng; `expandedRows` controllable. Dòng chi tiết có id, nút `aria-controls` trỏ vào nó; ô chi tiết là một ô của grid (`Enter`/`F2` vào nội dung, `Tab` đi vòng trong nó, `Esc` ra). Cuộn ảo tắt (§3.7).
+- **Master-detail** (bản quyết định): `renderDetail(row)` bật cột nút mở chi tiết (tên `labels.showDetails(name)` / `labels.hideDetails(name)`); `rowHasDetail(row)` để tắt cho từng dòng; `expandedRows` controllable. Dòng chi tiết có id, nút `aria-controls` trỏ vào nó; ô chi tiết là một ô của grid (`Enter`/`F2` vào nội dung, `Tab` đi vòng trong nó, `Esc` ra). Cuộn ảo tắt (§3.7). Phát hiện khi lập Plan E: `rowHasDetail` vắng thì dòng nào cũng có chi tiết; `renderDetail` không phải hàm thì không có chi tiết và không thêm cột; `expandedRows` là danh sách khoá theo thứ tự mở, so như tập hợp cả hai chiều (cùng khoá khác thứ tự hay một khoá hai lần là không đổi; so với `asked ?? state` như `setSelectedKeys`), khoá của dòng không có hay dòng không có chi tiết bị bỏ qua và ở lại trong trạng thái, và có hiệu lực với dòng đến sau; dòng chi tiết chỉ có trong danh sách khi mở, ngay sau dòng của nó, khoá React `x:<khoá>`; `id` của nó là `useId` của lưới và một số đếm theo khoá (cấp lần đầu dòng chi tiết có trong danh sách, giữ cho đến khi lưới mất), không bao giờ là khoá thô (khoá có thể chứa dấu cách); nút có `aria-controls` chỉ khi chi tiết đang mở, và dòng dữ liệu không mang `aria-expanded`; tên nút theo văn bản của cột tiêu đề dòng, không có thì theo khoá; `Space` trên nút là của nút. Danh sách dòng là nguồn nói dòng nào đang mở (`expanded` của dòng dữ liệu là dòng sau nó là dòng chi tiết của nó), nên một khoá của dòng không có chi tiết không làm nút nào hiện đang mở; không có context riêng cho khoá đang mở. Cột nút (`flg:detail`, 40px, `service: 'detail'`) nằm sau các cột thụt, là một chỗ của bàn phím và ghim trái cùng vùng; hàng lọc và hàng tổng cho nó một ô trống. Ô chi tiết (`.flg-data-grid-detail-cell`, không có padding) trải từ cột nút tới hết hàng cả cột đệm, nội dung `.flg-data-grid-detail-content` dính `left: var(--flg-data-grid-pinned-left)` và rộng `min(--flg-data-grid-frame-width − hai vùng ghim, 100%)`; lưới đo khung trong lúc có dòng chi tiết. Observer thả control của thân chạy khi có cột `cell` hay có `renderDetail` (PR #44, ý 1). `Table` trong chi tiết giữ giao diện của một Table không dính tiêu đề: luật tiêu đề dính của Table và của grid dùng bộ chọn con cháu nên lọt vào nó (khung grid có `data-sticky-header`), và một luật của grid trả nó về nền của variant.
 - **Kéo dòng** (bản quyết định): `rowReorder` bật cột tay nắm; `onRowReorder(fromKey, toKey, position)`, app tự đổi `data`. Tắt khi đang sắp xếp hay nhóm (bản quyết định); chạy được khi đang lọc (vị trí so với dòng thấy được) và ở chế độ server (trong trang). Menu dòng từ tay nắm (`Enter`, `Space`, bấm): Lên trên, Xuống dưới, Lên đầu, Xuống cuối (tắt ở mép). `mod+Shift+↑/↓` trên mọi ô của dòng. Focus đi theo dòng (vị trí hoạt động theo khoá); thông báo `labels.announceRowMoved(name, position, count)`.

+## Master-detail
+
+`renderDetail(row)` gives each row a detail: a row that opens under it and holds what the function
+returns. The grid then has a column of 40px with a button for each row, after the column of boxes and
+the indent columns of a grouping, and the button opens and closes the detail of its row.
+`rowHasDetail(row)` takes it away from some rows: such a row has an empty cell where the button would
+be. Without `rowHasDetail` every row has a detail.
+
+<Canvas of={GroupingStories.GridGroups} />
+
+```tsx
+<DataGrid
+  data={orders}
+  rowKey="id"
+  columns={columns}
+  caption="Orders"
+  renderDetail={renderOrderDetail}
+  rowHasDetail={hasLines}
+  defaultExpandedRows={['DH-1024']}
+/>
+```
+
+`renderDetail` and `rowHasDetail` are read by every row, so write them outside the component or in
+`useCallback`: after three renders in a row with a new one the grid warns.
+
+**The state** is `expandedRows`: the keys of the rows whose detail is open, in the order they were
+opened. It is controlled or uncontrolled like the rest (`expandedRows`, `defaultExpandedRows` and
+`onExpandedRowsChange`), and `onStateChange` hears it as the part `'expandedRows'`. The keys are
+compared as a set: the same keys in another order, or a key twice, is no change. A key that no row has,
+or that belongs to a row with no detail, is ignored and stays in the state, and it opens the detail of
+that row when the row comes later.
+
+**The button** is the one control of its cell, as the box is in the column of boxes: it has the focus
+and is the Tab stop while its cell is the active one. It is named `labels.showDetails(name)` while the
+detail is closed and `labels.hideDetails(name)` while it is open, where `name` is the text of the row
+header column, or the key when there is none. It says `aria-expanded`, and, while the detail is open,
+`aria-controls` with the id of the detail row; the row of data says neither (`aria-expanded` on a
+row would mean that it has child rows). A press on it opens or closes the detail and chooses no row,
+whatever `selectOnRowClick` is, and does not call `onRowActivate`.
+
+**The detail row** is the row after its master, drawn only while the detail is open. The cells before
+the button's column (the box, the indents) are empty and have no band; one cell goes on from there to
+the end of the row and holds the detail, on the band of the second level of a group. The content has
+12px 16px 14px of room around it and may wrap. It sticks to what the frame shows: when the columns
+are wider than the frame, and it is scrolled sideways, the content stays in sight, at the right of the
+left zone and as wide as what is left between the zones. Its height is its content's. A `Table` in a
+detail has the look of a Table that does not stick its heading.
+
+The detail row is a place of the grid, with one cell, and it is in the order of the rows: <Kbd keys="down" />
+from its master goes to it and <Kbd keys="down" /> from it goes to the next row, in the column the place
+was in all the while. <Kbd keys="left" />, <Kbd keys="right" />, <Kbd keys="home" /> and
+
+<Kbd keys="end" /> do nothing in it. Its content works as a cell that holds controls (see Keyboard):
+<Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" /> goes into the first control, <Kbd keys="tab" /> goes round
+the controls, <Kbd keys="esc" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" /> comes back, and with no control
+<Kbd keys="enter" />
+does nothing. A control the detail draws is out of the Tab order, as the control of a custom cell
+is, also one that it adds after a load. When a detail closes with the place on it, the place goes to
+its master row, in the same column.
+
+**A detail turns virtual scrolling off:** a detail has no fixed height, which the window of rows
+counts on, so `scrolling="virtual"` with `renderDetail` scrolls as usual and warns once. **Pages** keep
+a detail with its master and do not count it as a row. **Server mode** works on the page: the keys
+are the keys of the rows the server sent.
+

+| <Kbd keys="left" /> <Kbd keys="right" />                                        | a cell, a title                                | Goes to the cell at the left or the right. It does not wrap to another row                                                     |
+| <Kbd keys="up" /> <Kbd keys="down" />                                           | a cell, a title                                | Goes up or down a row, in the same column. Up from the first row is the filter row when there is one, then the title           |
+| <Kbd keys="home" /> <Kbd keys="end" />                                          | a cell, a title                                | Goes to the first or the last cell of the row                                                                                  |
+| <Kbd keys="mod+home" /> <Kbd keys="mod+end" />                                  | a cell, a title                                | Goes to the first cell of the first row, or the last cell of the last (of every row in a virtual grid)                         |
+| <Kbd keys="pageup" /> <Kbd keys="pagedown" />                                   | a cell                                         | Goes up or down by the rows the frame shows, in the same column. It never changes the page                                     |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" />                                                            | a title                                        | Sorts by the column, in place of any other sort; on the box in the title, presses it                                           |
+| <Kbd keys="shift+enter" />                                                      | a title                                        | Adds the column to the sort and keeps the others, as Shift or ⌘/Ctrl with a press does                                         |
+| <Kbd keys="f2" />                                                               | a title                                        | Goes to the first control of the title, the sort button; Tab goes on to the funnel and the menu button                         |
+| <Kbd keys="space" />                                                            | a title                                        | Nothing, and the frame does not scroll; the box in the title of the column of boxes keeps it                                   |
+| <Kbd keys="alt+shift+left" /> <Kbd keys="alt+shift+right" />                    | a title of a data column                       | Makes the column 10px narrower or wider (see Resizing columns); cancelled on every such title, also where nothing changes      |
+| <Kbd keys="mod+shift+left" /> <Kbd keys="mod+shift+right" />                    | a title of a data column                       | Moves the column one place within its zone (see Reordering columns); cancelled on every such title, also where nothing changes |
+| <Kbd keys="alt+down" /> <Kbd keys="shift+f10" /> or the ContextMenu key         | a title of a data column                       | Opens the menu of the column under its button (see The column menu); cancelled on every such title, once for a held key        |
+| <Kbd keys="mod+shift+left" /> <Kbd keys="mod+shift+right" />                    | a button of a chip of the group panel          | Moves its level one place (see The group panel); cancelled at an edge too, where nothing changes                               |
+| <Kbd keys="right" />                                                            | a group row                                    | Opens a closed group; on an open one goes to its first row                                                                     |
+| <Kbd keys="left" />                                                             | a group row                                    | Closes an open group; on a closed one goes up to its parent group (nothing at level 1)                                         |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" />                                                            | a group row                                    | Opens or closes the group                                                                                                      |
+| <Kbd keys="home" /> <Kbd keys="end" />                                          | a group row                                    | Goes to the first or the last row of the list                                                                                  |
+| <Kbd keys="space" />                                                            | a group row                                    | Nothing, and the frame does not scroll                                                                                         |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" /> <Kbd keys="space" />                                       | the button of a detail                         | Opens or closes the detail (see Master-detail); Space is the button's, and chooses no row                                      |
+| <Kbd keys="left" /> <Kbd keys="right" /> <Kbd keys="home" /> <Kbd keys="end" /> | a detail row                                   | Nothing, and the frame does not scroll; Space is cancelled too                                                                 |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" />                                       | a detail row                                   | Goes into the first control of its content; with none, nothing                                                                 |
+| <Kbd keys="down" /> <Kbd keys="up" />                                           | the last row, the footer of totals             | Goes down to the footer, in the same column; up goes back to the last row (see Totals)                                         |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" /> <Kbd keys="f2" /> <Kbd keys="space" />                     | a cell of the footer                           | Nothing; Space is cancelled, so the frame does not scroll                                                                      |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" />                                       | a cell that holds controls                     | Goes into the cell: the first of its controls has the focus (widget mode)                                                      |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" />                                                            | a cell that holds none                         | Calls `onRowActivate(row, key)`                                                                                                |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" />                                       | a cell of the filter row                       | Goes into its input, its DatePicker or its Select (see The filter row); a printable key does nothing                           |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" />                                                            | the field of a range                           | Opens the popover of its two ends under it (see The filter row)                                                                |
+| <Kbd keys="enter" />                                                            | the funnel of a title                          | Opens the header filter under it (see The header filter)                                                                       |
+| <Kbd keys="down" />                                                             | the search field of the header filter          | Goes down into the list, to its one stop                                                                                       |
+| <Kbd keys="up" /> <Kbd keys="down" /> <Kbd keys="home" /> <Kbd keys="end" />    | the list of the header filter                  | Moves among its boxes; Space checks one, Enter is OK                                                                           |

+| <Kbd keys="esc" /> or <Kbd keys="f2" />                                         | a control of a cell                            | Goes back to the cell                                                                                                          |

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-detail-ids.ts b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-detail-ids.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..9da14b4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/hooks/use-detail-ids.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,25 @@
+import { useCallback, useId, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
+import type { DataGridKey } from '../types';
+
+/**
+ * The id of the detail row of each row key, for the `aria-controls` of its button: the grid's `useId`
+ * and a number the key was given the first time its detail row was in the list, never the key itself,
+ * which may hold spaces or anything else an id list cannot (a key is no label of an element). The
+ * number stays with the key for as long as the grid lives, so opening or closing another detail changes
+ * no id and draws no row. The numbers are given in the order of the list, which a server render and the
+ * first client render share. Each key is given its number once, whatever the number of renders.
+ */
+export function useDetailIds(
+  rows: readonly { kind: string; key: DataGridKey }[],
+): (key: DataGridKey) => string {
+  const base = useId();
+  const numbers = useRef(new Map<DataGridKey, number>());
+  useMemo(() => {
+    for (const row of rows) {
+      if (row.kind === 'detail' && !numbers.current.has(row.key)) {
+        numbers.current.set(row.key, numbers.current.size + 1);
+      }
+    }
+  }, [rows]);
+  return useCallback((key) => `${base}-detail-${numbers.current.get(key) ?? 0}`, [base]);
+}

+  rowHasDetail: ((row: TRow) => boolean) | undefined,

+  );
+  useRenewalWarning(
+    rowHasDetail,
+    renewed,

diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/DetailRow.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/DetailRow.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c2e974d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/DetailRow.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+import { memo } from 'react';
+import type { FlatDetailRow } from '../engine/flatten';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { IndentCell } from './IndentCells';
+
+interface DetailRowProps<TRow> {
+  flat: FlatDetailRow<TRow>;
+  /** The id the button of the master row points at (`aria-controls`). */
+  id: string;
+  /** Whether this row is the active place, the one Tab stop of the grid: a prop, so the keyboard draws only the rows it leaves and enters. */
+  active: boolean;
+  /** The place of the row for a screen reader, in a virtual grid, where the rows are not all drawn. */
+  ariaRowIndex: number | undefined;
+}
+
+function DetailRowImpl<TRow>({ flat, id, active, ariaRowIndex }: DetailRowProps<TRow>) {
+  const { layoutColumns, layoutPins, filler, details } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  // The cells before the column of the buttons (the box, the indents of the groups) are empty, with no band;
+  // one cell goes on from the column of the buttons to the end of the row, the filler column in it.
+  const at = layoutColumns.findIndex((column) => column.service === 'detail');
+  return (
+    <tr
+      id={id}
+      className="flg-table-row flg-data-grid-detail-row"
+      // Under groups the row says the level of its master; without them it says none, as the rows do not.
+      aria-level={flat.level > 1 ? flat.level : undefined}
+      aria-rowindex={ariaRowIndex}
+    >
+      {layoutColumns.slice(0, at).map((column, index) => (
+        <IndentCell key={column.id} pin={layoutPins[index]} />
+      ))}
+      <td
+        colSpan={layoutColumns.length - at + (filler ? 1 : 0)}
+        className="flg-table-cell flg-data-grid-detail-cell"
+        tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
+      >
+        <div className="flg-data-grid-detail-content">{details?.render(flat.row)}</div>
+      </td>
+    </tr>
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * The row under a master row that has its detail open (spec phase 6 §4.3 R1 "Dòng chi tiết"): a place of
+ * the keyboard with one cell, a cell of the grid that holds whatever `renderDetail` draws. The cell
+ * spans every column from the button's on, and what is in it stays in sight when the frame is scrolled
+ * sideways (the stylesheet sticks the content, and `--flg-data-grid-frame-width` is what it is as
+ * wide as). It is memoized: it draws again when its row, whether it is the active place, or something the
+ * whole grid shares (what `renderDetail` is, the pins) changes.
+ */
+export const DetailRow = memo(DetailRowImpl) as typeof DetailRowImpl;
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/parts/DetailToggle.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/parts/DetailToggle.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..7f4ab8d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/parts/DetailToggle.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+import { ChevronIcon } from '../../../internal/icons';
+import type { FlatDataRow } from '../engine/flatten';
+import type { PinPlace } from '../engine/layout';
+import { useGridContext } from '../grid-context';
+import { pinAttributes } from './pin-attributes';
+
+/**
+ * The cell of the column of detail buttons in a data row. The button is the cell's one control (the data
+ * grid pattern of the APG: a cell that holds one simple control gives the focus to it), so it is the Tab
+ * stop when this is the active cell and the cell never is. It says whether the detail is open
+ * (`aria-expanded`) and, while it is, which row is the detail (`aria-controls`); the row is drawn only
+ * while it is open, so the button points at nothing before. A row that has no detail
+ * (`rowHasDetail`) draws the cell empty: the place stays, with nothing to press.
+ *
+ * The press is the button's click, which every way of pressing it makes once (a pointer, Enter, Space),
+ * so a press on it is never the row's (`selectOnRowClick`): a button is a control in a cell.
+ */
+export function DetailToggleCell<TRow>({
+  flat,
+  isActive,
+  expanded,
+  detailId,
+  pin,
+}: {
+  flat: FlatDataRow<TRow>;
+  isActive: boolean;
+  /** Whether the detail row of this row is in the list. */
+  expanded: boolean;
+  /** The id of that detail row, given while it is in the list. */
+  detailId: string | undefined;
+  pin: PinPlace | undefined;
+}) {
+  const { labels, rowHeader, details, textOf } = useGridContext<TRow>();
+  const has = details?.has(flat.row) === true;
+  const text = has && rowHeader ? textOf(flat.row, rowHeader) : '';
+  const name = text === '' ? String(flat.key) : text;
+  return (
+    <td
+      className="flg-table-cell flg-data-grid-cell flg-data-grid-toggle-cell"
+      data-service="detail"
+      tabIndex={-1}
+      {...pinAttributes(pin)}
+    >
+      {has ? (
+        <button
+          type="button"
+          className="flg-data-grid-detail-toggle"
+          aria-label={expanded ? labels.hideDetails(name) : labels.showDetails(name)}
+          aria-expanded={expanded}
+          aria-controls={expanded ? detailId : undefined}
+          tabIndex={isActive ? 0 : -1}
+          onClick={() => details?.toggle(flat.key)}
+        >
+          <ChevronIcon direction={expanded ? 'down' : 'right'} width={16} height={16} />
+        </button>
+      ) : null}
+    </td>
+  );
+}

+    fireEvent.pointerDown(handle('DH-3'), { ...POINTER, buttons: 1, clientX: 10, clientY: 100 });
+    fireEvent.pointerMove(document, { ...POINTER, buttons: 1, clientX: 10, clientY: 140 });
+    runFrames();
+    // The handle, Order, Customer and Qty of one row, and the body that passes the flag.
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(4);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.toolbar).toBe(0);
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('tr[data-drag-source]')).toHaveLength(1);
+    reset();
+    // A move of the pointer draws the chip and the line, and not a row.
+    for (const y of [150, 160, 170, 180]) {
+      fireEvent.pointerMove(document, { ...POINTER, buttons: 1, clientX: 10, clientY: y });
+      runFrames();
+    }
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.body).toBe(0);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+    fireEvent.pointerUp(document, { ...POINTER, buttons: 0, clientX: 10, clientY: 180 });
+    expect(renders.cell).toBe(4);
+    expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('tr[data-drag-source]')).toHaveLength(0);
+  });
+
+  it('draws no row when the menu opens or closes, and only the handle of the row it is about', () => {
+    // jsdom has no Popover API: the menu shows and hides by these stand-ins.
+    HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = () => {};
+    HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = () => {};
+    try {
+      render(reorder());
+      reset();
+      fireEvent.click(handle('DH-4'));
+      expect(handle('DH-4')).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
+      expect(renders.cell).toBe(0);
+      expect(renders.headerCell).toBe(0);
+      expect(renders.body).toBe(0);
+    } finally {
+      Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+      Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+    }
+  });
+
+  it('draws nothing again for a `rowReorder` and a handler written inline that say what they said', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(reorder({ onRowReorder: () => {} }));
+    reset();
+    rerender(reorder({ onRowReorder: () => {} }));
+    expect(renders).toMatchObject({ headerCell: 0, cell: 0 });
+  });
+});
diff --git a/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.row-reorder.test.tsx b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.row-reorder.test.tsx
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..62c3561
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/components/data-grid/DataGrid.row-reorder.test.tsx
@@ -0,0 +1,899 @@
+import { act, createEvent, fireEvent, render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
+import { createRef, useState } from 'react';
+import type { Ref } from 'react';
+import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
+import { resetDevWarnings } from '../../internal/warn';
+import { DataGrid } from './DataGrid';
+import type {
+  DataGridColumn,
+  DataGridGroupItem,
+  DataGridHandle,
+  DataGridKey,
+  DataGridProps,
+  DataGridRowDrop,
+} from './index';
+
+// Moving rows (spec phase 6 §3.6, §3.8, §4.3 R1 "Kéo dòng", §6.3 "Kéo dòng"): the column of handles, what turns
+// it off, the keys, the row menu, the drag and the drop, the sentence, and the way the focus and the page
+// follow a row. What needs a layout engine or a real pointer to be true (the box of the line and of the chip,
+// the cursor, a touch, the focus after a move in each engine) is proven in the stories
+// (`DataGridGrouping.stories.tsx`).
+
+// The animation frames the drag asks for (the coalesced moves, the auto-scroll), run by hand.
+let frames: Map<number, FrameRequestCallback>;
+let nextFrame: number;
+const runFrames = () => {
+  const due = [...frames.values()];
+  frames.clear();
+  act(() => due.forEach((callback) => callback(0)));
+};
+
+// How many times a popover was shown, and which are showing: the menu shows and hides by these stand-ins.
+let showing: Set<Element>;
+
+const ROW_HEIGHT = 33;
+const HEAD_HEIGHT = 32;
+const DETAIL_HEIGHT = 100;
+const FRAME_HEIGHT = 300;
+
+beforeEach(() => {
+  resetDevWarnings();
+  frames = new Map();
+  nextFrame = 1;
+  showing = new Set();
+  vi.stubGlobal('requestAnimationFrame', (callback: FrameRequestCallback) => {
+    frames.set(nextFrame, callback);
+    return nextFrame++;
+  });
+  vi.stubGlobal('cancelAnimationFrame', (id: number) => frames.delete(id));
+  // jsdom has no layout, so every element would count as hidden to the code that looks for the controls of
+  // a cell, and no Popover API.
+  HTMLElement.prototype.checkVisibility = () => true;
+  HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover = function showPopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.add(this);
+  };
+  HTMLElement.prototype.hidePopover = function hidePopover(this: HTMLElement) {
+    showing.delete(this);
+  };
+  const matches = Element.prototype.matches;
+  vi.spyOn(Element.prototype, 'matches').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: Element,
+    selector: string,
+  ) {
+    return selector === ':popover-open' ? showing.has(this) : matches.call(this, selector);
+  });
+  const box = (left: number, top: number, right: number, bottom: number) =>
+    ({
+      left,
+      top,
+      right,
+      bottom,
+      x: left,
+      y: top,
+      width: right - left,
+      height: bottom - top,
+      toJSON: () => ({}),
+    }) as DOMRect;
+  // jsdom has no layout. The rows of the body are laid out here one under the other in the order the DOM
+  // has them (a data row 33px, a detail row 100px, so a move shows), under a heading 32px tall, in a frame
+  // 300px tall and 504px wide.
+  vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'getBoundingClientRect').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: HTMLElement,
+  ) {
+    if (this.matches('.flg-data-grid-frame, .flg-data-grid-main'))
+      return box(0, 0, 504, FRAME_HEIGHT);
+    if (this.matches('thead')) return box(0, 0, 504, HEAD_HEIGHT);
+    if (this.matches('tbody > tr')) {
+      let top = HEAD_HEIGHT;
+      for (const row of Array.from((this.parentElement as HTMLElement).children)) {
+        const height = row.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-detail-row')
+          ? DETAIL_HEIGHT
+          : ROW_HEIGHT;
+        if (row === this) return box(0, top, 504, top + height);
+        top += height;
+      }
+    }
+    return box(0, 0, 0, 0);
+  });
+  vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, 'offsetWidth', 'get').mockImplementation(function (
+    this: HTMLElement,
+  ) {
+    return this.matches('.flg-data-grid-main') ? 504 : 0;
+  });
+  for (const [name, value] of [
+    ['clientWidth', 504],
+    ['clientHeight', FRAME_HEIGHT],
+  ] as const) {
+    vi.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, name, 'get').mockReturnValue(value);
+  }
+});
+afterEach(() => {
+  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'checkVisibility');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'showPopover');
+  Reflect.deleteProperty(HTMLElement.prototype, 'hidePopover');
+  vi.restoreAllMocks();
+  vi.useRealTimers();
+  document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-flg-grid-cursor');
+});
+
+interface Order {
+  id: string;
+  status: string;
+  qty: number;
+}
+
+const ORDERS: Order[] = [
+  { id: 'DH-1', status: 'Delivered', qty: 5 },
+  { id: 'DH-2', status: 'Delivered', qty: 3 },
+  { id: 'DH-3', status: 'Processing', qty: 2 },
+  { id: 'DH-4', status: 'Processing', qty: 4 },
+  { id: 'DH-5', status: 'New', qty: 1 },
+];
+
+const COLUMNS: DataGridColumn<Order>[] = [
+  { field: 'id', caption: 'Order', rowHeader: true, width: 120 },
+  { field: 'status', caption: 'Status', width: 120 },
+  { field: 'qty', caption: 'Qty', dataType: 'number', width: 80 },
+];
+
+const BY_STATUS: DataGridGroupItem[] = [{ field: 'status', direction: 'asc' }];
+
+function Orders({
+  gridRef,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & { gridRef?: Ref<DataGridHandle> }) {
+  return (
+    <DataGrid
+      ref={gridRef}
+      data={ORDERS}
+      rowKey="id"
+      columns={COLUMNS}
+      caption="Orders"
+      paging={false}
+      rowReorder
+      onRowReorder={() => {}}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * A grid whose parent does what the callback asks: it moves the row in its own `data`. `keep: false`
+ * is a parent that never changes it.
+ */
+function Moving({
+  onMove,
+  keep = true,
+  start = ORDERS,
+  gridRef,
+  ...props
+}: Partial<DataGridProps<Order>> & {
+  onMove?: (from: DataGridKey, to: DataGridKey, position: DataGridRowDrop) => void;
+  keep?: boolean;
+  start?: Order[];
+  gridRef?: Ref<DataGridHandle>;
+}) {
+  const [data, setData] = useState(start);
+  return (
+    <Orders
+      gridRef={gridRef}
+      data={data}
+      onRowReorder={(from, to, position) => {
+        onMove?.(from, to, position);
+        if (!keep) return;
+        setData((rows) => {
+          const moved = rows.find((row) => row.id === from)!;
+          const others = rows.filter((row) => row.id !== from);
+          const at = others.findIndex((row) => row.id === to) + (position === 'after' ? 1 : 0);
+          return [...others.slice(0, at), moved, ...others.slice(at)];
+        });
+      }}
+      {...props}
+    />
+  );
+}
+
+const grid = () => screen.getByRole('grid') as HTMLTableElement;
+const titles = () =>
+  Array.from(grid().tHead!.rows[0]!.cells).filter(
+    (cell) => !cell.classList.contains('flg-data-grid-filler'),
+  );
+const dataRows = () =>
+  Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLTableRowElement>('tbody > tr.flg-data-grid-row'));
+const ids = () => dataRows().map((row) => row.cells[1]!.textContent);
+const handle = (name: string) => screen.getByRole('button', { name: `Reorder ${name}` });
+const handles = () => screen.getAllByRole('button', { name: /^Reorder DH-/ });
+const stops = () => Array.from(grid().querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[tabindex="0"]'));
+const menu = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-row-menu');
+const items = () => Array.from(menu()?.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('[role="menuitem"]') ?? []);
+const item = (name: string) => items().find((candidate) => candidate.textContent === name)!;
+const isOff = (element: HTMLElement) => element.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true';
+const region = () => document.querySelector('[aria-live="polite"]')!;
+const chip = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-drag-chip');
+const line = () => document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('.flg-data-grid-drop-line');
+const html = () => document.documentElement;
+// The live region says it a tick after: the timers are the test's, and the frames stay the stub's.
+const fakeTimers = () => vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ['setTimeout', 'clearTimeout'] });
+const tick = () => act(() => void vi.advanceTimersByTime(0));
+const focusOn = (element: HTMLElement) => act(() => element.focus());
+
+const keyDown = (element: HTMLElement, key: string, init: KeyboardEventInit = {}): boolean => {
+  const event = createEvent.keyDown(element, { key, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, ...init });
+  act(() => {
+    fireEvent(element, event);
+  });
+  return event.defaultPrevented;
+};
+const modShift = { ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true };
+
+// The keys of the platform: ⌘ on Apple and Ctrl elsewhere.
+const apple = () => vi.spyOn(navigator, 'platform', 'get').mockReturnValue('MacIntel');
+const windows = () => vi.spyOn(navigator, 'platform', 'get').mockReturnValue('Win32');
+
+const POINTER = { pointerId: 1, isPrimary: true, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0 };
+const press = (element: Element, y: number, init: PointerEventInit = {}) =>
+  fireEvent.pointerDown(element, { ...POINTER, buttons: 1, clientX: 10, clientY: y, ...init });
+const move = (y: number, init: PointerEventInit = {}) =>
+  fireEvent.pointerMove(document, { ...POINTER, buttons: 1, clientX: 10, clientY: y, ...init });
+const release = (y: number, init: PointerEventInit = {}) =>
+  fireEvent.pointerUp(document, { ...POINTER, buttons: 0, clientX: 10, clientY: y, ...init });
+
+/** The y of the row `at` (from 0) among rows that are all closed: its top, its middle and its bottom. */
+const top = (at: number) => HEAD_HEIGHT + at * ROW_HEIGHT;
+const middle = (at: number) => top(at) + ROW_HEIGHT / 2;
+
+/** A drag of the handle of `name` to the pointer at `y`, released there. */
+function drag(name: string, y: number) {
+  press(handle(name), middle(0));
+  move(y);
+  runFrames();
+  release(y);
+}
+
+/** A press and a click on a button, as a mouse makes them. */
+function click(button: HTMLElement) {
+  fireEvent.pointerDown(button, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 1 });
+  fireEvent.mouseDown(button);
+  fireEvent.pointerUp(button, { pointerId: 1, pointerType: 'mouse', button: 0, buttons: 0 });
+  fireEvent.click(button, { detail: 1 });
+}
+
+describe('the column of handles', () => {
+  it('has no column and no handle without rowReorder, or with a value that is not true', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders rowReorder={false} />);
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Reorder / })).toBeNull();
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('[data-service="drag"]')).toHaveLength(0);
+    rerender(<Orders rowReorder={'yes' as never} />);
+    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /^Reorder / })).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('adds a column of 28px with one handle for each row, named after the row header', () => {
+    render(<Orders />);
+    expect(grid().querySelectorAll('col')[0]).toHaveStyle({ width: '28px' });
+    expect(handles().map((button) => button.getAttribute('aria-label'))).toEqual(
+      ORDERS.map((order) => `Reorder ${order.id}`),
+    );
+    for (const button of handles()) {
+      expect(button).toHaveAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'menu');
+      expect(button).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
+      expect(button).not.toHaveAttribute('aria-disabled');
+      expect(button.closest('td')).toHaveAttribute('data-service', 'drag');
+    }
+    // The title has the words, hidden, and no control: it is a place of the keyboard.
+    const head = titles()[0]!;
+    expect(head).toHaveTextContent('Reorder');
+    expect(head.querySelector('button')).toBeNull();
+  });
+
+  it('comes after the column of boxes and before the data, and is one place of the keyboard', () => {
+    render(<Orders selectionMode="multiple" />);
+    const cells = Array.from(dataRows()[0]!.cells);
+    expect(cells[0]).toHaveAttribute('data-service', 'select');
+    expect(cells[1]).toHaveAttribute('data-service', 'drag');
+    expect(cells[2]).toHaveTextContent('DH-1');
+    // One Tab stop in all, and it is not the handle of a row until the keyboard is there.
+    expect(stops()).toHaveLength(1);
+  });
+
+  it('names a handle after the key when the row has no header text', () => {
+    render(<Orders columns={COLUMNS.map((column) => ({ ...column, rowHeader: false }))} />);
+    expect(handle('DH-3')).toBeInTheDocument();
+  });
+
+  it('warns once, after the commit, when there is no onRowReorder, and a move calls nothing', () => {
+    const warn = vi.spyOn(console, 'warn').mockImplementation(() => {});
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders onRowReorder={undefined} />);
+    rerender(<Orders onRowReorder={undefined} />);
+    expect(
+      warn.mock.calls.filter(([message]) => String(message).includes('rowReorder has no')),
+    ).toHaveLength(1);
+    expect(warn).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.stringContaining('rowReorder has no onRowReorder'));
+    // The handles are drawn, enabled, and a key says and calls nothing.
+    expect(isOff(handle('DH-2'))).toBe(false);
+    const cell = dataRows()[1]!.cells[2]!;
+    focusOn(cell);
+    expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', modShift)).toBe(true);
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('');
+    expect(ids()).toEqual(ORDERS.map((order) => order.id));
+  });
+});
+
+describe('a grid that sorts or groups', () => {
+  it('turns the handles off while it sorts, and on again when the sort goes', () => {
+    const { rerender } = render(<Orders defaultSort={[{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }]} />);
+    for (const button of handles()) expect(isOff(button)).toBe(true);
+    rerender(<Orders sort={[]} />);
+    for (const button of handles()) expect(isOff(button)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('turns the handles off while it groups', () => {
+    render(<Orders defaultGrouping={BY_STATUS} />);
+    expect(handles()).toHaveLength(5);
+    for (const button of handles()) expect(isOff(button)).toBe(true);
+  });
+
+  it('keeps the handles on for a filter, which moves rows among the ones it keeps', () => {
+    const onMove = vi.fn();
+    render(
+      <Moving
+        onMove={onMove}
+        defaultFilter={{ columns: { status: { operator: '=', value: 'Processing' } } }}
+      />,
+    );
+    expect(handles()).toHaveLength(2);
+    for (const button of handles()) expect(isOff(button)).toBe(false);
+    // DH-3 is the first of the two: it cannot go up, and DH-4 goes up before it, not before DH-2.
+    const first = dataRows()[0]!.cells[2]!;
+    focusOn(first);
+    expect(keyDown(first, 'ArrowUp', modShift)).toBe(true);
+    expect(onMove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    const second = dataRows()[1]!.cells[2]!;
+    focusOn(second);
+    keyDown(second, 'ArrowUp', modShift);
+    expect(onMove).toHaveBeenCalledWith('DH-4', 'DH-3', 'before');
+  });
+
+  it('shows why in a tooltip on focus, and stays focusable', () => {
+    vi.useFakeTimers();
+    render(<Orders defaultSort={[{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }]} />);
+    const button = handle('DH-2');
+    expect(button).not.toHaveAttribute('disabled');
+    fireEvent.keyDown(document, { key: 'Tab' });
+    vi.spyOn(button, 'matches').mockImplementation((selector) => selector === ':focus-visible');
+    fireEvent.focus(button);
+    act(() => void vi.advanceTimersByTime(600));
+    // The text is always in the DOM, for the description (a handle's own, for each row); it is open when
+    // the browser shows it, and only the focused handle's is.
+    const tips = screen.getAllByRole('tooltip', { hidden: true });
+    expect(tips).toHaveLength(5);
+    const tip = document.getElementById(button.getAttribute('aria-describedby')!)!;
+    expect(tips.filter((one) => showing.has(one))).toEqual([tip]);
+    expect(tip).toHaveTextContent('Clear sorting and grouping to reorder rows');
+    expect(button).toHaveAccessibleDescription('Clear sorting and grouping to reorder rows');
+  });
+
+  it('does not open the menu, and starts no drag, from a handle that is off', () => {
+    const onMove = vi.fn();
+    render(<Moving onMove={onMove} defaultSort={[{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }]} />);
+    click(handle('DH-2'));
+    expect(menu()?.matches(':popover-open') ?? false).toBe(false);
+    expect(handle('DH-2')).toHaveAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
+    press(handle('DH-2'), middle(1));
+    move(middle(4));
+    runFrames();
+    expect(chip()).toBeNull();
+    release(middle(4));
+    expect(onMove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+});
+
+describe('the keys on a cell of a row', () => {
+  it.each([
+    [
+      'Windows and Linux',
+      windows,
+      { ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true },
+      { metaKey: true, shiftKey: true },
+    ],
+    ['Apple', apple, { metaKey: true, shiftKey: true }, { ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true }],
+  ])(
+    'move the row up and down one place, with the arguments of the move, on %s',
+    (_name, platform, mod, other) => {
+      platform();
+      const onMove = vi.fn();
+      render(<Orders onRowReorder={onMove} />);
+      const cell = dataRows()[2]!.cells[2]!;
+      focusOn(cell);
+      expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', mod)).toBe(true);
+      expect(onMove).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('DH-3', 'DH-2', 'before');
+      expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowDown', mod)).toBe(true);
+      expect(onMove).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('DH-3', 'DH-4', 'after');
+      expect(onMove).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+      // The modifier of the other platform is no modifier here.
+      expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', other)).toBe(false);
+      expect(onMove).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
+    },
+  );
+
+  it('are cancelled at an edge and call nothing', () => {
+    const onMove = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onRowReorder={onMove} />);
+    const first = dataRows()[0]!.cells[1]!;
+    focusOn(first);
+    expect(keyDown(first, 'ArrowUp', modShift)).toBe(true);
+    const last = dataRows()[4]!.cells[1]!;
+    focusOn(last);
+    expect(keyDown(last, 'ArrowDown', modShift)).toBe(true);
+    expect(onMove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('');
+  });
+
+  it('are the keys of the handle too', () => {
+    const onMove = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onRowReorder={onMove} />);
+    const button = handle('DH-2');
+    focusOn(button);
+    expect(keyDown(button, 'ArrowDown', modShift)).toBe(true);
+    expect(onMove).toHaveBeenCalledWith('DH-2', 'DH-3', 'after');
+  });
+
+  it('are not taken without the modifier, with Alt, or on a title', () => {
+    const onMove = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onRowReorder={onMove} />);
+    const cell = dataRows()[2]!.cells[2]!;
+    focusOn(cell);
+    expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', { shiftKey: true })).toBe(false);
+    expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', { ctrlKey: true, shiftKey: true, altKey: true })).toBe(false);
+    const title = titles()[2]!;
+    focusOn(title);
+    keyDown(title, 'ArrowDown', modShift);
+    expect(onMove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it("are not the grid's when it does not reorder rows", () => {
+    render(<Orders rowReorder={false} />);
+    const cell = dataRows()[2]!.cells[1]!;
+    focusOn(cell);
+    expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', modShift)).toBe(false);
+  });
+
+  it('are cancelled while the grid sorts, call nothing and say why once for a press', () => {
+    fakeTimers();
+    const onMove = vi.fn();
+    render(<Orders onRowReorder={onMove} defaultSort={[{ field: 'qty', direction: 'asc' }]} />);
+    const cell = dataRows()[2]!.cells[1]!;
+    focusOn(cell);
+    expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', modShift)).toBe(true);
+    tick();
+    expect(region()).toHaveTextContent('Clear sorting and grouping to reorder rows');
+    expect(keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', { ...modShift, repeat: true })).toBe(true);
+    expect(onMove).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
+  });
+
+  it('say where the row went, among the rows after the filter, before the app answers', () => {
+    fakeTimers();
+    render(<Moving keep={false} />);
+    const cell = dataRows()[3]!.cells[1]!;
+    focusOn(cell);
+    keyDown(cell, 'ArrowUp', modShift);
